key: Immune to **poisoned** status and additionally, when an effect (such as an Arcanum, a potion or a spell) would cause an undead creature to recover Hit Points, whoever controls that effect may instead have the undead lose half as many Hit Points.
en: Immune to **poisoned** status and additionally, when an effect (such as an Arcanum, a potion or a spell) would cause an undead creature to recover Hit Points, whoever controls that effect may instead have the undead lose half as many Hit Points.
it: Immune allo status **avvelenato** e inoltre, quando un effetto (come un Arcanum, una pozione o un incantesimo) permetterebbe a un non morto di recuperare PV, chi controlla l'effetto può invece decidere di far perdere al non morto un ammontare di Punti Vita pari a metà dell'ammontare che avrebbe dovuto recuperare.
de: Immun gegen den Statuseffekt **Vergiftet**. Wenn ein Effekt (wie ein Arkanum, ein Trank oder ein Zauber) dazu führen würde, dass ein untotes Wesen Lebenspunkte wiederherstellt, kann der Verursacher des Effekt bestimmen das das untote Wesen stattdessen halb so viele Lebenspunkte verliert.
fr: Immunisé contre l'état **Empoisonné** de plus, lorsqu'un effet (comme un arcanum, une potion ou un sort) permet à une créature morte-vivante de récupérer des points de vie, quiconque contrôle cet effet peut faire perdre  jusqu'à la moitié de ces PV au mort-vivant.
es: Inmune a **Envenenado** y además, cuando un efecto (como un arcano, una poción o un hechizo) fuese a hacer que una criatura no muerta recuperase puntos de vida, quien controle ese efecto puede hacer que en su lugar pierda la mitad de PV.
pt-BR: Imune ao status **envenenado** e adicionalmente, quando um efeito (como um Arcanum, uma poção ou um feitiço) faria com que uma criatura morta-viva recuperasse Pontos de Vida, quem controla esse efeito pode, em vez disso, fazer com que os mortos-vivos percam metade dos Pontos de Vida.
ru: Immune to **poisoned** status and additionally, when an effect (such as an Arcanum, a potion or a spell) would cause an undead creature to recover Hit Points, whoever controls that effect may instead have the undead lose half as many Hit Points.
pl: Odporność na stan **Zatrucie**. Ponadto, jeśli jakiś efekt (np. Arkanum, mikstura lub zaklęcie) miałby przywrócić nieumarłemu Punkty Życia, ktokolwiek kontroluje ten efekt może zamiast tego sprawić, że nieumarły straci połowę wartości Punktów Życia.
zh-CN: 免疫**中毒**。此外，当一个效果（例如奥灵、药剂或法术）使不死生物恢复生命值时，控制该效果的角色可以改为使该不死生物失去恢复量一半的生命值。

key: You may perform the **Inventory** action to rapidly craft a **potion** with powerful but somewhat unpredictable effects. When you do so, choose one type of **mix** among those you have unlocked (**basic**, **advanced** or **superior**) and spend the appropriate amount of Inventory Points.
en: You may perform the **Inventory** action to rapidly craft a **potion** with powerful but somewhat unpredictable effects. When you do so, choose one type of **mix** among those you have unlocked (**basic**, **advanced** or **superior**) and spend the appropriate amount of Inventory Points.
it: Puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** per miscelare rapidamente una **pozione** dagli effetti potenti ma imprevedibili. Quando lo fai, scegli un tipo di **mix** tra quelli a tua disposizione (**base**, **avanzato** o **superiore**) spendendo l’ammontare di Punti Inventario corrispondenti.
de: Du darfst die **Inventar**aktion nutzen, um schnell einen **Trank** mit starken, aber etwas unvorhersehbaren Effekten herzustellen. Wenn du dies tust, wähle einen Typ *Mix* von den von dir freigeschalteten (**Basis**, **Fortgeschritten** oder **Überlegen**) und zahle die entsprechende Anzahl Inventarpunkte.
fr: Vous pouvez réaliser l'action **inventaire** pour rapidement créer une **potion** avec un effet puissant mais quelque peu imprévisible. Quand vous faites ceci, choisissez un type de **mélange** parmi ceux que vous avez déverrouillé (**basique**, **avancé** ou supérieur**) et dépensez le nombre de PI approprié.
es: Puedes usar la acción **inventario** para crear rápidamente una **poción** con efectos poderosos pero algo inpredecibles. Al hacerlo, elige un tipo de **mezcla** entre los que tienes desbloqueados (**básico**, **avanazado** o **superior**) y gasta la cantidad adecuada de puntos de inventario.
pt-BR: Você pode realizar a ação **Inventário** para criar rapidamente uma **poção** com efeitos poderosos, mas um tanto imprevisíveis. Ao fazer isso, escolha um tipo de **mix** entre aqueles que você desbloqueou (**básico**, **avançado** ou **superior**) e gaste a quantidade apropriada de pontos de inventário.
ru: You may perform the **Inventory** action to rapidly craft a **potion** with powerful but somewhat unpredictable effects. When you do so, choose one type of **mix** among those you have unlocked (**basic**, **advanced** or **superior**) and spend the appropriate amount of Inventory Points.
pl: You may perform the **Inventory** action to rapidly craft a **potion** with powerful but somewhat unpredictable effects. When you do so, choose one type of **mix** among those you have unlocked (**basic**, **advanced** or **superior**) and spend the appropriate amount of Inventory Points.
zh-CN: 你可以通过**消耗物资**行动快速制作一瓶强效但效果难以预测的**药剂**。如果你这样做，选择一种你已解锁的**混合剂**（**基础**、**进阶**或**顶级**），并消耗相应的物资点。

key: When you create a mix, roll the amount of twenty-sided dice indicated by that mix, then assign one of those rolls to the **target** table and one to the **effect** table . Discard all remaining dice, then describe the effects of the mix!
en: When you create a mix, roll the amount of twenty-sided dice indicated by that mix, then assign one of those rolls to the **target** table and one to the **effect** table . Discard all remaining dice, then describe the effects of the mix!
it: Quando crei un mix, tira l’ammontare di dadi a venti facce indicato dalla descrizione, poi assegna uno di essi all’**area** e un altro all’**effetto**. Scarta i dadi rimanenti, poi descrivi l’effetto del mix!
de: Wenn du eine Mischung herstellst, werfe die Anzahl W20, die die Mischung angibt. Dann weise einen der Würfel der **Ziel**tabelle und einen der **Effekt**tabelle zu. Verwerfe die übrigen Würfel und beschreibe die Effekte der Mischung!
fr: Quand vous créez un mélange, lancez le nombre indiqué de dé à 20 faces indiqué par ce mélange, puis assignez un de ces jets à la table des **cibles** et un à la table des **effets**. Défaussez les dés restants, puis decrivez les effets de ce mélange!

pt-BR: Ao criar uma mistura, jogue a quantidade de dados de vinte lados indicada por essa mistura e, em seguida, atribua uma dessas jogadas à tabela de **alvo** e outra à tabela de **efeito** . Descarte todos os dados restantes e descreva os efeitos da mistura!
ru: When you create a mix, roll the amount of twenty-sided dice indicated by that mix, then assign one of those rolls to the **target** table and one to the **effect** table . Discard all remaining dice, then describe the effects of the mix!
pl: When you create a mix, roll the amount of twenty-sided dice indicated by that mix, then assign one of those rolls to the **target** table and one to the **effect** table . Discard all remaining dice, then describe the effects of the mix!

key: When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special **infusion** and apply the corresponding effect to that attack (if the attack had the **multi** property, apply the effects of the infusion to each target).
en: When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special **infusion** and apply the corresponding effect to that attack (if the attack had the **multi** property, apply the effects of the infusion to each target).
it: Quando colpisci uno o più bersagli con un attacco, puoi spendere 2 Punti Inventario per creare un’**infusione** speciale e applicare l’effetto corrispondente a quell’attacco (se l’attacco ha la proprietà **multi**, gli effetti dell’infusione si applicano a ciascun bersaglio).
de: Wenn du erfolgreich ein oder mehr Ziele mit einem Angriff triffst, darfst du 2 Inventarpunkte ausgeben, um eine spezielle **Infusion** herzustellen und den entsprechenden Effekt auf den Angriff anzuwenden. (Falls der Angriff die **Multi** Eigenschaft hat, wende die Effekte der Infusion auf jedes der Ziele an.)
fr: Quand une de vos attaques touche une ou plusieurs cibles, vous pouvez dépenser 2 points d’inventaire pour produire une inoculation **spéciale** et en appliquer l’effet à l’attaque en question (si celle-ci disposait de la propriété **multi**, les effets de l’inoculation s’appliquent à chaque cible)
es: Cuando golpeas exitosamente a uno o mas objetivos con un ataque, puedes usar 2 puntos de inventario para producir una **infusión** especial y aplicar el efecto correspondiente a ese ataque. (Si el ataque tenia la porpiedad de **multi**, aplica los efectos de la infusión a cada uno de los objetivos).
pt-BR: Ao atingir com sucesso um ou mais alvos com um ataque, você pode gastar 2 Pontos de Inventário para produzir uma **infusão** especial e aplicar o efeito correspondente a esse ataque (se o ataque tiver a propriedade **multi**, aplique o efeitos da infusão para cada alvo).
ru: When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special **infusion** and apply the corresponding effect to that attack (if the attack had the **multi** property, apply the effects of the infusion to each target).
pl: When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special **infusion** and apply the corresponding effect to that attack (if the attack had the **multi** property, apply the effects of the infusion to each target).
zh-CN: 当你的攻击命中一个或多个目标时，你可以消耗2点物资点生成一项特殊的**注魔**效果，并将该效果附加在本次攻击中（如果本次攻击具有**多重攻击**特性，则该**注魔**物品的效果会影响所有目标）。

key: You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon.
en: You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon.
it: Non puoi applicare più di un’infusione al medesimo attacco; creare e applicare l’infusione sono entrambe parte della stessa azione con cui attacchi.
de: Du kannst nicht mehr als eine Infusion auf den selben Angriff anwenden; Herstellen und verwenden einer Infusion sind beides Teil der Aktion, die du für deinen Angriff mit der Waffe verwendest.
fr: Vous ne pouvez pas appliquer plus d’une inoculation à la même attaque ; produire et utiliser l’inoculation font tous deux partie de l’action utilisée pour attaquer avec l’arme.
es: No puedes aplicar mas de una infusión a un mismo ataque; producir y usar una infusión son ambas partes de la acción que se uso para atacar con el arma.
pt-BR: Você não pode aplicar mais de uma infusão no mesmo ataque; produzir e usar uma infusão fazem parte da ação que você usou para atacar com a arma.
ru: You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon.
pl: You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon.
zh-CN: 你在一次攻击中至多只能应用一项注魔效果，制作和使用注魔装置都是用武器进行的攻击行动的一部分。

it: Scegli un’opzione: recuperi un ammontare di Punti Vita pari a metà dei PV persi dal bersaglio dell’attacco; **oppure** recuperi un ammontare di Punti Mente pari a metà dei PV persi dal bersaglio dell’attacco. Questa infusione può essere applicata solo ad attacchi che hanno un **singolo** bersaglio.
de: Choose one option: you recover an amount of HP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack; **or** you recover an amount of MP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack. This infusion can only be used if the attack targeted **a single** creature.
fr: Choisissez une option : vous récupérez un nombre de PV égal à la moitié des PV perdus par la cible de l'attaque, ou vou récupérez un nombre de PM égal à la moitié des PV perdus par la cible de l'attaque. Cette inoculation ne peut être utilisée que si l'attaque visait une **seule** créature.
es: Elige una opción: Recupera una cantidad de PV igual a la mitad de la perdida de PV que sufrio el objetivo del ataque; **o** recupera una cantida de PM igual a la mitad de la perdida de PV que sufrio el objetivo del ataque. Esta infusión solo puede ser usada si el objetivo del ataque fue una criatura **singular**
pt-BR: Escolha uma opção: você recupera uma quantidade de PV igual à metade da perda de PV sofrida pelo alvo do ataque; **ou** você recupera uma quantidade de PM igual à metade da perda de PV sofrida pelo alvo do ataque. Esta infusão só pode ser usada se o ataque tiver como alvo **uma única** criatura.
ru: Choose one option: you recover an amount of HP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack; **or** you recover an amount of MP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack. This infusion can only be used if the attack targeted **a single** creature.
pl: Choose one option: you recover an amount of HP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack; **or** you recover an amount of MP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack. This infusion can only be used if the attack targeted **a single** creature.
zh-CN: 从以下选项中选择一项：你恢复等同于【本次攻击的目标失去的生命值一半】的生命值；**或**你恢复等同于【本次攻击的目标失去的生命值一半】的精神值。此注魔只有在攻击目标为**单个**生物时才能使用。

en: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose a **construct** or **elemental** enemy you can see that does not possess independent intelligence and is suffering from **one or more status effects**. If you do so, that enemy recovers from all status effects, then the Game Master reveals its **entire profile** and you may force it to immediately perform an action of your choice; during that action, the creature is treated as an ally of your group.
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 10 Punti Mente per eseguire un Test Contrapposto di **【 INT + INT】** contro un **costrutto** di rango **soldato** a te visibile nelle vicinanze (il Game Master deve dirti quali bersagli sono validi). Se hai successo, prendi il controllo della creatura fino al termine della scena (il GM ti rivela il suo profilo). Puoi controllare un solo **costrutto** alla volta, ma puoi liberarlo quando preferisci; il **costrutto** si libera anche non appena tu o un tuo alleato gli fate del male. Una volta libero, il **costrutto** ha il pieno controllo delle proprie azioni e potrebbe rivoltartisi contro.
de: You may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to perform an Opposed **【 INS + INS】** Check against a nearby **soldier**-rank construct you can see (the Game Master must tell you who is a valid target). If you succeed, you gain control of the creature until the end of the scene (the Game Master gives you its profile). You may only control one **construct** at any given time, but may set it free whenever you want; the **construct** is also set free as soon as it is harmed by you or by one of your allies. Once free, the **construct** is again in control of its actions and might turn against you.
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 10 Points de Magie pour effectuer un test d'**【 INT + INT】**opposé contre une **créature artificielle** de rang **soldat** proche que vous pouvez voir (le meneur de jeu doit vous dire qui constitue une cible valide). En cas de réussite, vous prenez le contrôle de la créature jusqu'à la fin de la scène (le meneur de jeu vous donne son profil). Vous ne pouvez contrôler qu'une **créature artificielle** à la fois, mais vous pouvez la libérer dès que vous le souhaitez. La **créature artificielle** est également libérée dès que vous ou un de vos alliés lui faites du mal. Une fois libérée, la **créature artificielle** reprend le contrôle de ses actes et peut se retourner contre vous.
es: Puedes usar una acción y usar 10 PM para realizar una Prueba ** 【PER + PER】 ** Opuesta en contra de un constructo de rango **soldado** que puedas ver (El Maestro de juego tiene que decirte quien seria un objetivo valido). En caso de tener exito, ganas el control de la criatura hasta el final de la escena (el Maestro de juego te da su perfil). Solo puedes controlar un **constructo** al mismo tiempo, pero lo puedes liberar en cualquier momento; el **constructo** tambien se liberara en el caso que tu o uno de tus aliados lo hiera. Una vez liberado, el **constructo** vuelve a tener control de sus acciones y es posible que te ataque.
pt-BR: Durante um conflito, você pode usar uma ação e gastar 10 Pontos de Mente para escolher um inimigo do tipo **constructo** ou **elemental** que você possa ver, que não possua inteligência independente **e** que esteja sofrendo de **um ou mais efeitos de condição**. Se o fizer, esse inimigo se recupera de todos os efeitos de estado; em seguida, o Narrador revela seu **perfil completo** e você pode forçá-lo a realizar imediatamente uma ação à sua escolha; durante essa ação, a criatura é tratada como um aliado do seu grupo.
ru: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose a **construct** or **elemental** enemy you can see that does not possess independent intelligence and is suffering from **one or more status effects**. If you do so, that enemy recovers from all status effects, then the Game Master reveals its **entire profile** and you may force it to immediately perform an action of your choice; during that action, the creature is treated as an ally of your group.
pl: You may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to perform an Opposed **【 INS + INS】** Check against a nearby **soldier**-rank construct you can see (the Game Master must tell you who is a valid target). If you succeed, you gain control of the creature until the end of the scene (the Game Master gives you its profile). You may only control one **construct** at any given time, but may set it free whenever you want; the **construct** is also set free as soon as it is harmed by you or by one of your allies. Once free, the **construct** is again in control of its actions and might turn against you.
zh-CN: 在冲突场景中，作为一次行动，你可以消耗10点精神值，并选择一个物种类型为**构装体**或**元素**的敌人。你需要能看见这个敌人，此外该敌人需不具备独立心智，且正处于至少一个异常状态中。如果你这样做，该敌人解除**所有异常状态**，然后游戏主持人会为你揭示该敌人的**全部数据**。你可以迫使该敌人立即执行一次类型由你选择的行动（不占用敌人常规的回合行动次数），在此次行动中该敌人将被视为你的盟友。

en: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magicannon** (see below) and destroy any **magicannon** you previously created. If you do so and both your **hand slots** are empty, you may immediately equip the newly created **magicannon** and perform a **free attack** with it. Whenever you create a **magicannon**, choose what type of damage it deals among **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, **ice**, or **physical**.
it: Puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** e spendere 2 Punti Inventario per creare un’arma della Categoria **da fuoco** chiamata **magicannone**. Il tuo magicannone va in pezzi non appena ne crei un altro. Quando crei un magicannone, scegli il tipo di danno che infligge (**aria, fisico, fulmine, fuoco, ghiaccio** oppure **terra**).
de: You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **firearm** weapon known as a **magicannon**. The magicannon will crumble to pieces as soon as you use create a new magicannon. When you create a magicannon, choose the type of damage it deals (**air, bolt, earth, fire, ice,** or **physical**).
fr: Vous pouvez effectuer l'action **Inventaire** et dépenser 2 Points d'Inventaire pour créer une **arme à feu** connue sous le nom de **magicanon**. Le magicanon tombe en morceaux dès que vous créez un nouveu magicanon. Quand vous créez un magicanon, choisissez le type de dégâts qu'il inflige (**air**, **foudre**, **terre**, **feu**, **glace** ou **physiques**).
es: Puedes realizar la acción Inventario y gastar 2 puntos de inventario para crear un **arma de fuego** conocida como **magicañón**. El magicañón se hará pedazosa en cuanto crees un nuevo magicañón. Cuando creas un magicañón, elige el tipo de daño que hace (**aire, electricidad, tierra, fuego, hielo** o **físico**).
pt-BR: Você pode realizar a ação **Inventário** e gastar 2 Pontos de Inventário para criar um **Magicanhão** (veja abaixo) e destruir qualquer **Magicanhão** que você tenha criado anteriormente. Se fizer isso e seus **espaços de mão** estiverem vazios, você pode equipar imediatamente o **magicanhão** recém-criado e realizar um **ataque livre** com ele. Sempre que criar um **magicanhão**, escolha o tipo de dano que ele causa entre **ar**, **raio**, **terra**, **fogo**, **gelo** ou **físico**.
ru: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magicannon** (see below) and destroy any **magicannon** you previously created. If you do so and both your **hand slots** are empty, you may immediately equip the newly created **magicannon** and perform a **free attack** with it. Whenever you create a **magicannon**, choose what type of damage it deals among **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, **ice**, or **physical**.
pl: You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **firearm** weapon known as a **magicannon**. The magicannon will crumble to pieces as soon as you use create a new magicannon. When you create a magicannon, choose the type of damage it deals (**air, bolt, earth, fire, ice,** or **physical**).
zh-CN: 你可以执行**消耗物资**行动并消耗2点物资点，制作一件名为**魔法加农炮**的枪械（见下表），并摧毁你此前已制作的所有**魔法加农炮**。如果你这样做，且你的两个**手部栏位**均为空，你还可以立即将新制作的**魔法加农炮**装备，并使用它进行一次**顺势攻击**。在制作**魔法加农炮**时，你还需选择它造成的伤害类型（**风**/**雷**/**冰**/**火**/**土**/**物理**）。

en: You develop three magisphere prototypes; each of them can replicate a spell chosen from the following lists: **Elementalist**, **Entropist** and **Spiritist**. The spells you choose may come from the same list or different lists.
it: Sviluppi tre prototipi di magisfera, ciascuno dei quali replica un incantesimo scelto dalle liste seguenti: **Elementalista**, **Entropista** e **Spiritista**. Gli incantesimi che scegli possono provenire dalla stessa lista o da liste differenti.
de: You develop three magisphere prototypes; each of them can replicate a spell chosen from the following lists: **Elementalist**, **Entropist** and **Spiritist**. The spells you choose may come from the same list or different lists.
fr: Vous développez trois prototypes de magisphères : chacun peut reproduire un sort choisi parmi les listes des classes suivantes : **Élémentaliste**, **Entropiste** et **Spirite**. Les sorts que vous choisissez peuvent tous venir de la même ou relever de listes différentes.
es: Desarrollas tres prototipos de magiesferas. Cada una puede replicar un hechizo que elijas de las siguientes listas: **Elementalista**, **Entropista** y **Espiritista**. Los hechizos que elijas puedes provenir de la misma lista o diferentes.
pt-BR: Você desenvolve três protótipos de magisfera; cada um deles pode replicar um feitiço escolhido nas seguintes listas: **Elementalista**, **Entropista** e **Espíritista**. Os feitiços que você escolher podem vir da mesma lista ou de listas diferentes.
ru: You develop three magisphere prototypes; each of them can replicate a spell chosen from the following lists: **Elementalist**, **Entropist** and **Spiritist**. The spells you choose may come from the same list or different lists.
pl: You develop three magisphere prototypes; each of them can replicate a spell chosen from the following lists: **Elementalist**, **Entropist** and **Spiritist**. The spells you choose may come from the same list or different lists.
zh-CN: 你设计出了一个能够容纳三种不同法术的法球，这些法术需来自**元素使**、**熵术士**和**御魂使**的法术列表，且可以来自相同或不同职业的法术列表。容纳于法球中的法术不视为被你“习得”或“知晓”。

en: You also develop two more prototypes upon reaching **level 20**, and another two upon reaching **level 40** (the same applies if you already reached those levels).
it: Sviluppi altri due prototipi quando raggiungi il **livello 20**, e due ulteriori quando raggiungi il **livello 40** (vale anche se il tuo personaggio ha già raggiunto quei livelli).
de: You also develop two more prototypes upon reaching **level 20**, and another two upon reaching **level 40** (the same applies if you already reached those levels).
fr: Vous développez aussi deux prototypes de plus en arrivant au **niveau 20**, et deux autres au **niveau 40** (il en va de même si vous avez déjà atteint ces niveaux).
es: Puedes desarrollar dos prototipos más al alcanzar **nivel 20** y otros dos más al alcanzar **nivel 40** (esto se aplica también si ya has alcanzado dichos niveles).
pt-BR: Você também desenvolve mais dois protótipos ao atingir o **nível 20** e outros dois ao atingir o **nível 40** (o mesmo se aplica se você já atingiu esses níveis).
ru: You also develop two more prototypes upon reaching **level 20**, and another two upon reaching **level 40** (the same applies if you already reached those levels).
pl: You also develop two more prototypes upon reaching **level 20**, and another two upon reaching **level 40** (the same applies if you already reached those levels).
zh-CN: 你将在**等级达到20级**时设计出一种新的法球，并在**等级达到40级**时再设计出一种新的法球（如果在你习得此技能时已满足相应的等级需求，也能立即进行法球的设计）。

en: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magisphere** and immediately perform the **Spell** action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a prototype for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks) and the magisphere is destroyed upon use.
it: Puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** e spendere 2 Punti Inventario per creare una **magisfera** ed eseguire gratuitamente l’azione di **Incantesimo**, lanciando un incantesimo tra quelli per cui hai sviluppato un prototipo. L’incantesimo segue le normali regole (inclusi il costo in PM e il Test di Magia) e la magisfera si distrugge dopo l’uso.
de: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magisphere** and immediately perform the **Spell** action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a prototype for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks) and the magisphere is destroyed upon use.
fr: Vous pouvez effectuer l'action **Inventaire** et dépenser 2 Points d'Inventaire pour créer une **magisphère** et aussitôt réaliser gratuitement l'action **Sort**, lançant ainsi l'un des sorts pour lequel vous avez développé un prototype. Le sort obéit aux règles ordinaires (y compris pour ce qui concerne le coût en PM et les tests de magie), et la magisphère est détruite après utilisation.
es: Puedes usar la acción **inventario** y gastar 2 puntos de inventario para crear una **magiesfera** e inmediatamente realizar la acción **Hechizo** de forma gratuita, lanzando uno de los hechizos para los que has desarrollado un prototipo. El hechizo sigue las reglas habituales (incluyendo costes de MP y pruebas mágicas requeridas), y la magiesfera se destruye al usarla.
pt-BR: Você pode realizar a ação **Inventário** e gastar 2 Pontos de Inventário para criar uma **magisfera** e imediatamente realizar a ação **Feitiço** gratuitamente, lançando um dos feitiços para os quais você desenvolveu um protótipo. O feitiço segue as regras normais (incluindo custos de MP e Testes de Magia) e a magisfera é destruída ao ser usada.
ru: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magisphere** and immediately perform the **Spell** action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a prototype for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks) and the magisphere is destroyed upon use.
pl: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **magisphere** and immediately perform the **Spell** action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a prototype for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks) and the magisphere is destroyed upon use.
zh-CN: 你可以执行**消耗物资**行动并消耗2点物资点，以执行一次类型为**施法**的顺势行动，所施放的法术需来自你设计的任一**法球**中所容纳的法术。该法术遵循常规的**施法**规则（包括精神值消耗和**施法**检定）。

key: Do you want to create a new Magicannon? Creating a new Magicannon will replace any current Magicannon.
en: Do you want to create a new Magicannon? Creating a new Magicannon will replace any current Magicannon.
it: Vuoi creare un nuovo Magicannone? Eventuali Magicannoni già creati verranno distrutti.
de: Do you want to create a new Magicannon? Creating a new Magicannon will replace any current Magicannon.
fr: Voulez-vous créer un nouveau Magicanon ? Créer un nouveau Magicanon remplacera tout Magicanon actuel.
es: ¿Quieres creer un nuevo magicañón? Al crearlo, reemplazarás el magicañón actual.
pt-BR: Você quer criar um novo Magicanhão? A criação de um novo Magicanhão substituirá qualquer Magicanhão atual.
ru: Do you want to create a new Magicannon? Creating a new Magicannon will replace any current Magicannon.
pl: Do you want to create a new Magicannon? Creating a new Magicannon will replace any current Magicannon.
zh-CN: 要制作新的魔法加农炮吗？新制作的魔法加农炮会替换当前的魔法加农炮。
制作后装备魔法加农炮

en: Roll a die based on the **relevant attribute** for this spell once for every **X Mind Points** spent while casting it, where X is specified by the spell, then keep the **single** die you prefer: the number on that die determines the effects of this spell. Some effects rolled by the spell may require an additional roll of a d6 die. You may always treat the **Target** as **'Special'** and the **Duration** as **'Instantaneous'**.
it: Tira un dado basato sulla **caratteristica rilevante** per questo incantesimo una volta per ogni **X Punti Mente** spesi durante il lancio, dove X è specificato dall'incantesimo, quindi conserva il **singolo** dado che preferisci: il numero su quel dado determina l'effetto di questo incantesimo. Alcuni effetti dell'incantesimo potrebbero richiedere un tiro aggiuntivo di un dado d6. Considera sempre il **Bersaglio** come **'Speciale'** e la **Durata** come **'Istantanea'**.
de: Roll a die based on the **relevant attribute** for this spell once for every **X Mind Points** spent while casting it, where X is specified by the spell, then keep the **single** die you prefer: the number on that die determines the effects of this spell. Some effects rolled by the spell may require an additional roll of a d6 die. You may always treat the **Target** as **'Special'** and the **Duration** as **'Instantaneous'**.
fr: Lancez un dé basé sur l'**attribut pertinent** pour ce sort une fois pour chaque tranche de **X Points de Magie** dépensés pour le lancer, où X est spécifié par le sort, puis gardez un **seul** dé de votre choix : le résultat de ce dé détermine les effets de ce sort. Certains effets du sort peuvent nécessiter de lancer un d6 supplémentaire. Vous pouvez toujours considérer la **Cible** comme **Spécial** et la **Durée** comme **Instantannée**.
es: Lanza un dado del **atributo correspondiente** para este hechizo por cada **X puntos de mente** gastados al lanzarlo, donde X es un valor especificado por el hechizo y después quédate con la cifra que prefieras: el número en ese dado determina los efectos del hechizo. Algunos efectos del hechizo podrían requerir un lanzamiento de un d6 adicional. Siempre puedes marcar el **objetivo** como **especial** y la **duración** como **instantánea**.

Alguns efeitos lançados pelo feitiço podem exigir uma jogada adicional de um dado d6. Você sempre pode tratar o **Alvo** como **'Especial'** e a **Duração** como **'Instantâneo'**.

Some effects rolled by the spell may require an additional roll of a d6 die. You may always treat the **Target** as **'Special'** and the **Duration** as **'Instantaneous'**.
pl: Roll a die based on the **relevant attribute** for this spell once for every **X Mind Points** spent while casting it, where X is specified by the spell, then keep the **single** die you prefer: the number on that die determines the effects of this spell. en: When you sing a **verse**, you combine a **volume**, a **key** and a **tone** you learned. These three aspects determine the **verse**’s MP cost, targets and effect.
it: Quando canti un **verso**, combini un tipo di **volume**, una **chiave** e un **tono** tra quelli che hai imparato. Questi aspetti determinano il costo in PM, i bersagli e l’effetto del **verso**.
de: When you sing a **verse**, you combine a **volume**, a **key** and a **tone** you learned. These three aspects determine the **verse**’s MP cost, targets and effect.
fr: Quand vous chantez un **couplet**, vous associez un **volume**, une **clef** et un **ton** que vous avez appris. Ces trois aspects déterminent le coût en MP, les cibles et l'effet du **couplet**.

ru: When you sing a **verse**, you combine a **volume**, a **key** and a **tone** you learned. These three aspects determine the **verse**’s MP cost, targets and effect.
pl: When you sing a **verse**, you combine a **volume**, a **key** and a **tone** you learned. These three aspects determine the **verse**’s MP cost, targets and effect.
zh-CN: 当你咏唱**乐章**时，需要将已习得的**音量**、**调式**与**音色**进行组合。这三个要素共同决定**乐章**的精神值消耗、目标及效果。

es: The **volume** determines the sound intensity of your **verse** (and the creatures you can reach with it).
pt-BR: O **Volume** determina a intensidade sonora do seu **verso** (e as criaturas que você pode alcançar com ele).
ru: The **volume** determines the sound intensity of your **verse** (and the creatures you can reach with it).
pl: The **volume** determines the sound intensity of your **verse** (and the creatures you can reach with it).
zh-CN: **音量**决定了你的**乐章**的声音强度（和你能用它波及的生物）。

en: Each **tone** determines the general effects of your **verse**.

es: Each **tone** determines the general effects of your **verse**.
pt-BR: Cada **Tom** determina os efeitos gerais do seu **verso**.
ru: Each **tone** determines the general effects of your **verse**.
pl: Each **tone** determines the general effects of your **verse**.
zh-CN: 每个**音色**决定了你的**乐章**的基础效果。

en: Each **key** has an associated **damage type, status effect, Attribute** and **recovery**. These modify the effects determined by the **tone** of your **verse**.
it: Ciascuna **chiave** ha un **tipo** di danno, uno **status**, una **Caratteristica** e una forma di **recupero** associati a essa, modificando così l’effetto determinato dal **tono** del **verso**.
de: Each **key** has an associated **damage type, status effect, Attribute** and **recovery**. These modify the effects determined by the **tone** of your **verse**.
fr: À chaque **clef** correspondent un **type de dégâts**, un **effet d'état**, un **attribut** et une **récupération**. Tous modifient les effets déterminés par le **ton** du **couplet**.
es: Each **key** has an associated **damage type, status effect, Attribute** and **recovery**. These modify the effects determined by the **tone** of your **verse**.
pt-BR: Cada **Escala** tem um **tipo de dano, efeito de status, Atributo** e **recuperação** associados. Eles modificam os efeitos determinados pelo **tom** do seu **verso**.
ru: Each **key** has an associated **damage type, status effect, Attribute** and **recovery**. These modify the effects determined by the **tone** of your **verse**.
pl: Each **key** has an associated **damage type, status effect, Attribute** and **recovery**. These modify the effects determined by the **tone** of your **verse**.
zh-CN: 每个**调式**关联特定的**伤害类型、异常状态、属性**和**恢复效果**。这些要素会修正由**音色**决定的**乐章**效果。

en: Each target recovers【**key recovery**】equal to【**10 + twice your current Willpower die size**】. This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**. If this tone causes MP recovery, it has **no effect** on the character who sings it.
it: Ciascun bersaglio recupera【 **recupero della chiave**】 pari a【 **10 + il doppio della tua taglia di dado attuale di Volontà**】. Questo ammontare aumenta di 10 se sei di **livello 20 o superiore**, oppure di 20 se sei di **livello 40 o superiore**. Se questo tono causa il recupero di PM, **non ha effetto** sul personaggio che lo canta.
de: Each target recovers【**key recovery**】equal to【**10 + twice your current Willpower die size**】. This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**. If this tone causes MP recovery, it has **no effect** on the character who sings it.
fr: Chaque cible récupère un nombre de【**récupération de la clef**】égal à【**10 + le double de votre taille de dé de Volonté actuelle**】. Ce total augmente de 10 si vous êtes de **niveau 20 ou plus**, ou de 20 si vous êtes de **niveau 40 ou plus**. Si ce ton entraîne une récupération de PM, il n'a **aucun effet** sur le personnage qui chante.
es: Each target recovers【**key recovery**】equal to【**10 + twice your current Willpower die size**】. This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**. If this tone causes MP recovery, it has **no effect** on the character who sings it.
pt-BR: Cada alvo recupera【**recuperação de tom**】igual a【**10 + duas vezes o tamanho atual do seu dado de Vontade**】. Essa quantidade aumenta em 10 se você for **nível 20 ou superior**, ou em 20 se você for **nível 40 ou superior**. Se esse tom causar recuperação de PM, ele **não tem efeito** no personagem que o canta.
ru: Each target recovers【**key recovery**】equal to【**10 + twice your current Willpower die size**】. This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**. If this tone causes MP recovery, it has **no effect** on the character who sings it.
pl: Each target recovers【**key recovery**】equal to【**10 + twice your current Willpower die size**】. This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**. If this tone causes MP recovery, it has **no effect** on the character who sings it.
zh-CN: 每个目标恢复等同于**【10+你当前意志骰等级×2】**的**【调式恢复类型】**。若你**等级大于等于20级**，此数值额外增加10点；若你**等级大于等于40级**，则改为额外增加20点。如果该音色能恢复精神值，则对进行演唱的角色自身**无效**。

en: Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes【**key Attribute**】and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.
it: Fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, quando un bersaglio ha successo su un Test per riempire o svuotare un Orologio, se quel Test includeva【 **Caratteristica della chiave**】, quell’alleato può riempire o svuotare una sezione aggiuntiva di quell’Orologio.
de: Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes【**key Attribute**】and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.
fr: Jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour, lorsqu'une cible réussit un test qui comprend【**attribut de la clef**】et que celui-ci permet de faire avancer ou reculer un Cadran, elle peut en remplir ou en effacer une section supplémentaire.
es: Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes【**key Attribute**】and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.
pt-BR: Até o início do seu próximo turno, quando um alvo for bem-sucedido em um Teste que inclui【**Atributo-chave**】e esse Teste permitir que ele avance ou volte um Relógio, ele poderá preencher ou apagar uma seção adicional desse Relógio.
ru: Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes【**key Attribute**】and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.
pl: Until the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes【**key Attribute**】and that Check allows them to advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.
zh-CN: 直到你的下个回合开始，当一个目标成功进行了一次包含【调式**属性**】的检定，且该检定能使得他推进或倒转命刻时，他可以额外填充或擦除该命刻的一格。

en: You deal an amount of 【**key type**】 damage equal to **twice** your current **Willpower** die to each target. This tone deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 20 or higher**, or 10 extra damage if you are **level 40 or higher**.
it: Ciascun bersaglio subisce danni da【 **tipo della chiave**】 pari al **doppio** della tua taglia di dado attuale di **Volontà**. Questo tono infligge 10 danni extra se sei di **livello 20 o superiore**, oppure 20 danni extra se sei di **livello 40 o superiore**.
de: You deal an amount of 【**key type**】 damage equal to **twice** your current **Willpower** die to each target. This tone deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 20 or higher**, or 10 extra damage if you are **level 40 or higher**.
fr: Chaque cible subit un nombre de dégâts de【**type de la clef**】égal au **double** de votre taille de dé de **Volonté** actuelle. Ce total augmente de 10 si vous êtes de **niveau 20 ou plus**, ou de 20 si vous êtes de **niveau 40 ou plus**.
es: You deal an amount of 【**key type**】 damage equal to **twice** your current **Willpower** die to each target. This tone deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 20 or higher**, or 10 extra damage if you are **level 40 or higher**.
pt-BR: Você dá um total de dano do tipo 【**key type**】 igual ao **dobro** do seu dado de **Vontade** para cada Alvo. Esse Tom dá 5 pontos de dano extras se você estiver no **nível 20 ou superior**, ou 10 pontos de dano extra se você estiver no **nível 40 ou superior**.
ru: You deal an amount of 【**key type**】 damage equal to **twice** your current **Willpower** die to each target. This tone deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 20 or higher**, or 10 extra damage if you are **level 40 or higher**.
pl: You deal an amount of 【**key type**】 damage equal to **twice** your current **Willpower** die to each target. This tone deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 20 or higher**, or 10 extra damage if you are **level 40 or higher**.
zh-CN: 你对每个目标造成等同于【你当前**意志**骰等级**×2**】的【**调式**伤害类型】的伤害。若你**等级大于等于20级**，此音色造成5点额外伤害；若你**等级大于等于40级**，则改为造成10点额外伤害。

en: Each target suffers 【**key status effect**】. Each target also loses Resistance to 【**key type**】 damage (if they have it) until the start of your next turn, and cannot gain Resistance to that damage type.
it: Ciascun bersaglio subisce lo status【 **status della chiave**】. Inoltre, ciascun bersaglio perde la Resistenza al danno da【 **tipo della chiave**】 (se la possedeva) fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: Each target suffers 【**key status effect**】. Each target also loses Resistance to 【**key type**】 damage (if they have it) until the start of your next turn, and cannot gain Resistance to that damage type.

en: Each target treats their【**key Attribute**】as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the start of your next turn.
it: Ciascun bersaglio considera la propria taglia di dado di 【**Caratteristica della chiave**】incrementata di una taglia (fino a un massimo di **d12**) fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: Each target treats their【**key Attribute**】as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the start of your next turn.
fr: Chaque cible fait comme si le dé de son【**attribut de la clef**】était supérieur d'un cran (jusqu'à un maximum de **d12**) jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.
es: Each target treats their【**key Attribute**】as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Cada alvo trata seu 【**Atributo-chave**】como se tivesse um tamanho de dado maior (até um máximo de **d12**) até o início do seu próximo turno.
ru: Each target treats their【**key Attribute**】as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the start of your next turn.
pl: Each target treats their【**key Attribute**】as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the start of your next turn.

en: The first time each target suffers damage before the start of your next turn, that damage becomes【**key type**】. This can trigger once for each target of the verse, separately.

en: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **symbol** you have learned and choose one option: apply that **symbol** to yourself; or apply that **symbol** to an ally you can see; **or** perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply a copy of the chosen **symbol** to each enemy hit by the attack.
it: Puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** e spendere 2 Punti Inventario per creare un **simbolo** tra quelli che conosci e scegliere un’opzione: imprimi il **simbolo** su te stesso; **oppure** imprimi il **simbolo** su un alleato a te visibile; **oppure** esegui un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata. L’attacco non infligge danno, ma imprimi una copia del **simbolo** su ciascun nemico colpito.
de: You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **symbol** you have learned and choose one option: apply that **symbol** to yourself; or apply that **symbol** to an ally you can see; **or** perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply a copy of the chosen **symbol** to each enemy hit by the attack.
fr: Vous pouvez réaliser l'action **Inventaire** et dépenser 2 Points d'Inventaire pour créer un **symole** que vous avez appris et choisir une option : **soit** appliquer à vous-même ce **symbole**, **soit** l'appliquer sur un allié que vous voyez, **soit** effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme dont vous êtes équipé. Cette attaque n'inflige aucun dégât, mais vous appliquez une copie du **symbole** choisi à chque ennemi touché.

Este ataque não causa dano, mas você aplica uma cópia do **símbolo** escolhido a cada inimigo atingido pelo ataque.

zh-CN: 你可以执行**消耗物资**行动，并消耗2点物资点，以创造一个你已习得的**符印**，并选择一项：将该**符印**施加于自身；**或**将该**符印**施加于一名你能看见的盟友；**或**使用你已装备的一件武器执行一次**顺势攻击**。这次攻击不造成伤害，但你会将本次创造的**符印**的复制品施加于每个被攻击命中的敌人（每份复制品都会作为一个独立的**符印**计入你激活的**符印**上限，上限为【技能等级+1】）。

en: The **current** Attribute die sizes of the creature bearing this **symbol** can **never** be **higher** than that creature’s corresponding **base** Attribute die sizes (this does **not** end any spells or effects, but it will negate their influence over the creature’s Attributes).
it: Le taglie di dado **attuali** delle Caratteristiche della creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** non possono **mai** essere **superiori** alle rispettive taglie di dado **base** (ciò **non** termina eventuali incantesimi o effetti, ma nega il loro impatto sulle Caratteristiche).
de: The **current** Attribute die sizes of the creature bearing this **symbol** can **never** be **higher** than that creature’s corresponding **base** Attribute die sizes (this does **not** end any spells or effects, but it will negate their influence over the creature’s Attributes).
fr: Les tailles de dés **actuelles** des attributs de la créature qui porte ce **symbole** ne peuvent **jamais dépasser** leur valeur de **base** (ceci n'**interrompt** pas les sorts et les effets, mais annule leur influence sur les attriuts de la créature).

zh-CN: 带有该**符印**的生物的**当前**属性骰等级**不可高于**这些属性的**基础**骰等级（此效果**不**会导致其他提升属性骰等级的法术或效果终止，但会抵消它们对该生物各项属性的影响）。

en: When the creature bearing this **symbol** needs to spend Inventory Points during a conflict, they may instead destroy this **symbol** to spend no Inventory Points.
it: Quando la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** deve spendere Punti Inventario durante un conflitto, essa può distruggere questo **simbolo** per non spendere alcun Punto Inventario.

en: When the creature bearing this **symbol** recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points during conflicts, instead they only recover **half** the normal amount of Hit Points and/or Mind Points, respectively.
it: Quando la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** recupera Punti Vita o Punti Mente durante un conflitto, essa recupera **metà** del normale ammontare di Punti Vita o Punti Mente.
de: When the creature bearing this **symbol** recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points during conflicts, instead they only recover **half** the normal amount of Hit Points and/or Mind Points, respectively.

en: After the creature bearing this **symbol** makes a Check, if you are able to see them, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to force that creature to reroll both dice. You may only do so once per Check, and only if the Result was not a **critical success** or **fumble**.
it: Dopo che la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** effettua un Test, se sei in grado di vederla, puoi spendere 1 Punto Fabula per farle ritirare entrambi i dadi. Puoi farlo soltanto una volta per Test, e soltanto se il Risultato non era un **successo critico** o **fallimento critico**.
de: After the creature bearing this **symbol** makes a Check, if you are able to see them, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to force that creature to reroll both dice. You may only do so once per Check, and only if the Result was not a **critical success** or **fumble**.
fr: Après que la créature qui porte ce **symbole** a effectué un test, si vous pouvez la voir, vous pouvez dépenser 1 Point Faula pour la forcer à relancer les deux dés. Vous ne pouvez recourir à cette méthode qu'une fois par test et uniquement si le résultat n'était **ni réussite critique ni échec critique**.
es: After the creature bearing this **symbol** makes a Check, if you are able to see them, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to force that creature to reroll both dice. You may only do so once per Check, and only if the Result was not a **critical success** or **fumble**.
pt-BR: Após a criatura que carrega este **símbolo** fazer um Teste, se você for capaz de vê-la, você pode gastar 1 Ponto de Fabula para forçar aquela criatura a rolar novamente ambos os dados. Você só pode fazer isso uma vez por Teste, e somente se o Resultado não for um **sucesso crítico** ou **falha crítica**.
ru: After the creature bearing this **symbol** makes a Check, if you are able to see them, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to force that creature to reroll both dice. You may only do so once per Check, and only if the Result was not a **critical success** or **fumble**.
pl: After the creature bearing this **symbol** makes a Check, if you are able to see them, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to force that creature to reroll both dice. You may only do so once per Check, and only if the Result was not a **critical success** or **fumble**.
zh-CN: 当带有该**符印**的生物进行检定时，若你能看见该生物，可消耗1点物语点强制其重掷两枚骰子。每次检定仅可执行该效果一次，且进行重掷的检定结算值不得为**大成功**或**大失败**。

en: When you create this **symbol**, choose a damage type: **air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light**, or **poison**. When the creature bearing this **symbol** deals damage to one or more creatures, if you can see the creature bearing this **symbol**, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **one third of the total damage being inflicted to those creatures**. (including any sources of extra damage). If you do, all damage dealt this way changes type to the type chosen when you created this **symbol**.
it: Quando crei questo **simbolo**, scegli un tipo di danno tra: **aria, fulmine, fuoco, ghiaccio, luce, ombra, terra** e **veleno**. Quando la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** infligge danno a una o più creature, se sei in grado di vederla, puoi spendere un ammontare di Punti Mente pari **a un terzo del danno totale che sta infliggendo a quelle creature** (incluse eventuali fonti di danno extra). Se lo fai, tutto il danno inflitto in questo modo diventa del tipo scelto quando hai creato questo **simbolo**.
de: When you create this **symbol**, choose a damage type: **air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light**, or **poison**. When the creature bearing this **symbol** deals damage to one or more creatures, if you can see the creature bearing this **symbol**, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **one third of the total damage being inflicted to those creatures**. (including any sources of extra damage). If you do, all damage dealt this way changes type to the type chosen when you created this **symbol**.
fr: Quand vous créez ce **symbole**, choisissez un type de dégâts : **air, foudre, ténèbres, terre, feu, glace, lumière** ou **poison**. Quand la créature qui porte ce **symbole** inflige des dégâts à une ou plusieurs créatures et que vous pouvez la voir, vous pouvez dépenser un nombre de Points de Magie égal à **un tiers des dégâts totaux infligés** (y compris toutes les sources de dégâts supplémentaires). Dans ce cas, les dégâts adoptent le type choisi lorsque vous avez créé le **symbole**.
es: When you create this **symbol**, choose a damage type: **air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light**, or **poison**. When the creature bearing this **symbol** deals damage to one or more creatures, if you can see the creature bearing this **symbol**, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **one third of the total damage being inflicted to those creatures**. (including any sources of extra damage). If you do, all damage dealt this way changes type to the type chosen when you created this **symbol**.
pt-BR: Ao criar este **símbolo**, escolha um tipo de dano: **ar, raio, escuridão, terra, fogo, gelo, luz** ou **veneno**. Quando a criatura que carrega este **símbolo** causa dano a uma ou mais criaturas, se você puder ver a criatura que carrega este **símbolo**, você pode gastar uma quantidade de Pontos Mentais igual a **um terço do dano total sendo infligido a essas criaturas**. (incluindo quaisquer fontes de dano extra). Se você fizer isso, todo o dano causado dessa forma muda de tipo para o tipo escolhido quando você criou este **símbolo**.

(including any sources of extra damage). If you do, all damage dealt this way changes type to the type chosen when you created this **symbol**.

zh-CN: 当你创造此**符印**时，选择一种伤害类型：**风系**、**雷系**、**暗系**、**土系**、**火系**、**冰系**、**光系**或**毒系**。当带有该**符印**的生物对一个或多个生物造成伤害时，若你能看见带有此**符印**的生物，你可以消耗等同于**对那些生物造成的总伤害量的三分之一**的精神值（包括任何额外伤害）。如果你这样做，以此方式造成的所有伤害的类型变为创造此**符印**时选择的类型。

en: As long as the creature bearing this **symbol** is in **Crisis**, any of that creature’s enemies who are able to see them must include them among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if possible.
it: Finché la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo è in Crisi**, i suoi nemici in grado di vederla devono **sempre** includerla tra i bersagli dei propri attacchi e incantesimi offensivi (⚡), se possibile.
de: As long as the creature bearing this **symbol** is in **Crisis**, any of that creature’s enemies who are able to see them must include them among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if possible.
fr: Tant que la créature qui porte ce **symbole** est en **Crise**, tous ses ennemis capables de la voir doivent l'inclure parmi les cibles de leurs attaques et sorts offensifs (⚡) si c'est possible.
es: As long as the creature bearing this **symbol** is in **Crisis**, any of that creature’s enemies who are able to see them must include them among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if possible.
pt-BR: Enquanto a criatura que carrega este **símbolo** estiver em **Crise**, qualquer inimigo daquela criatura que for capaz de vê-la deve incluí-la entre os alvos de seus ataques e magias ofensivas (⚡), se possível.
ru: As long as the creature bearing this **symbol** is in **Crisis**, any of that creature’s enemies who are able to see them must include them among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if possible.
pl: As long as the creature bearing this **symbol** is in **Crisis**, any of that creature’s enemies who are able to see them must include them among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if possible.
zh-CN: 如果带有该**符印**的生物处于**危机状态**，那么该生物的敌人只要能看见他，就必须将他选为攻击或攻击性法术（OO）的目标（如果条件允许）。

en: When you create this **symbol**, choose a status effect: **dazed, shaken, slow**, or **weak**. Then, choose one option: the creature bearing this **symbol** gains immunity to the chosen status effect; or the creature bearing this **symbol** loses immunity to the chosen status effect and cannot gain it.
it: Quando crei questo **simbolo**, scegli uno tra status: **confuso, debole, lento** e **scosso**; poi, scegli un’opzione: la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** ottiene immunità allo status scelto; **oppure** la creatura su cui è impresso questo **simbolo** perde immunità allo status scelto e non può ottenerla.
de: When you create this **symbol**, choose a status effect: **dazed, shaken, slow**, or **weak**. en: On your turn during a conflict scene, if you have no **martial armor** equipped, you may spend 10 Mind Points to **perform a dance** you have learned. es: Choose an ally that is able to see you and has a Bond towards you: you and that ally both recover an amount of Hit Points equal to your current **Dexterity** die size. The restored amount increases by 5 Hit Points if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 10 Hit Points if you are **level 40 or higher**.
pt-BR: Escolha um aliado que seja capaz de ver você e tenha um Vínculo com você: você e esse aliado recuperam uma quantidade de Pontos de Vida igual ao tamanho atual do seu dado de **Destreza**. en:
You deal 30 **(choose type)** damage to every enemy you can see.
This spell should only be given to **champion** and **elite** enemies of **level 30 or higher**, which should only cast it once per turn during **their last turn of the round** (this creates a predictable pattern that Players can anticipate).
it: Il PNG sceglie un qualsiasi numero di creature a lui visibili: ciascuna subisce 30 danni da **(scegliere il tipo)**. Questo incantesimo può essere lanciato solo **una volta per turno**. Questo incantesimo dovrebbe essere scelto solo per PNG di rango **élite** e **campione** di **livello 30 o più**. Inoltre, tali creature dovrebbero poterlo lanciare solo **nel loro ultimo turno del round**.

en: After you willingly **dismiss** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict (see next page), if that Arcanum had not been **summoned** during this same turn and you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may immediately perform the **Spell** action for free. The spell you cast this way must have a **total Mind Point cost of**【**SL × 5**】**or lower** (you must still pay the spell's MP cost).
it: Dopo aver **congedato** volontariamente un Arcanum nel tuo turno durante un conflitto (vedi prossima pagina), se quell’Arcanum non era stato **evocato** durante il medesimo turno e hai un’arma della Categoria **arcana** equipaggiata, puoi eseguire gratuitamente l’azione di **Incantesimo**. L’incantesimo che lanci in questo modo deve avere un **costo totale in Punti Mente pari o inferiore a【 LA × 5】** (devi comunque pagarne il costo in Punti Mente).
de: After you willingly **dismiss** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict (see next page), if that Arcanum had not been **summoned** during this same turn and you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may immediately perform the **Spell** action for free. fr: Après avoir volontairement **renvoyé** un Arcanum durant votre tour de jeu lors d’un conflit (page suivante), si l’Arcanum en question n’avait pas été **invoqué** au même tour et si vous êtes équipé d’une arme **arcanique**, vous pouvez aussitôt réaliser gratuitement l’action **sort**. Le coût du sort que vous lancez de la sorte doit être **inférieur ou égal à 【NC × 5】 Points de Magie** (et vous devez toujours le payer).
es: After you willingly **dismiss** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict (see next page), if that Arcanum had not been **summoned** during this same turn and you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may immediately perform the **Spell** action for free. en: After you **willingly dismiss** an Arcanum you are **merged** with, if you are in **Crisis**, you may have yourself and every ally present on the scene recover **【SL × 5】** Hit Points.
it: Dopo che **congedi volontariamente** un Arcanum con cui sei fuso, se sei in Crisi, puoi far sì che tu e ciascun alleato presente nella scena recuperiate **【 LA × 5】** Punti Vita.
de: After you **willingly dismiss** an Arcanum you are **merged** with, if you are in **Crisis**, you may have yourself and every ally present on the scene recover **【SL × 5】** Hit Points.
fr: Après avoir **volontairement renvoyé** un Arcanum avec lequel vous avez **fusionné**, si vous êtes en **Crise**, vous et chaque allié présent dans la scène pouvez regagnez **【NC × 5】** Points de Vie.
es: After you **willingly dismiss** an Arcanum you are **merged** with, if you are in **Crisis**, you may have yourself and every ally present on the scene recover **【SL × 5】** Hit Points.
pt-BR: Após você **dispensar voluntariamente** um Arcano com o qual você foi **fundido**, se você estiver em **Crise**, você pode fazer com que você e todos os aliados presentes na cena recuperem **【NP × 5】** Pontos de Vida.

zh-CN: **主动遣散**与你**融合**的奥灵后，若你处于**危机状态**，你可以使自己和场景中的所有盟友恢复【**SL×5**】点生命值。

en: You may **bind** Arcana to your soul and **summon** them later. The Game Master will tell you the details of each binding process when you first encounter the Arcanum in question. You may use an action and spend 40 mp to **summon** an Arcanum you have bound: the details of this process are explained on the next page. If you take this Skill at character creation, you begin play with one Arcanum of your choice already bound to you, chosen from the list on the next pages. Other than that, you may only obtain new Arcana through exploration and story progression.
it: Puoi **vincolare** gli Arcana alla tua anima per **evocarli** in seguito. Quando incontri un nuovo Arcanum, il Game Master ti svela cosa dovrai fare per vincolarlo. Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 40 Punti Mente per **evocare** un Arcanum che hai vincolato: i dettagli di questo processo sono spiegati nella prossima pagina. Se acquisisci questa Abilità durante la creazione del personaggio, inizi il gioco con un Arcanum già vincolato, scelto tra quelli descritti nelle prossime pagine. Dopodiché, puoi ottenere nuovi Arcana soltanto con l’esplorazione e il progredire della storia.
de: You may **bind** Arcana to your soul and **summon** them later. The Game Master will tell you the details of each binding process when you first encounter the Arcanum in question. You may use an action and spend 40 mp to **summon** an Arcanum you have bound: the details of this process are explained on the next page. If you take this Skill at character creation, you begin play with one Arcanum of your choice already bound to you, chosen from the list on the next pages. Other than that, you may only obtain new Arcana through exploration and story progression.
fr: Vous pouvez **lier** les Arcana à votre âme et les **invoquer** plus tard. Le meneur de jeu vous expliquera les détails de chaque processus visant à lier un Arcanum chaque fois que vous le rencontrez pour la première fois. Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 40 Points de Magie pour **invoquer** un Arcanum que vous avez lié : les détails de l’opération figurent page suivante. Si vous prenez cette compétence à la création de personnage, vous commencez la partie avec un Arcanum de votre choix déjà lié, à choisir dans la liste des pages suivantes. En dehors de cela, vous ne pouvez obtenir de nouveaux Arcana que par l’exploration et le déroulement du récit.

If you take this Skill at character creation, you begin play with one Arcanum of your choice already bound to you, chosen from the list on the next pages. Other than that, you may only obtain new Arcana through exploration and story progression.
pt-BR: Você pode vincular Arcanos à sua alma e invocá-los mais tarde. O Mestre do Jogo lhe contará os detalhes de cada processo de vinculação quando você encontrar pela primeira vez o Arcano em questão. Você pode usar uma ação e gastar 40 PM para invocar um Arcano que você vinculou: os detalhes desse processo são explicados na próxima página. Se você escolher este Poder na criação do personagem, você começará o jogo com um Arcano de sua escolha já vinculado a você, escolhido na lista nas próximas páginas. Fora isso, você só poderá obter novos Arcanos por meio da exploração e progressão da história.

zh-CN: 你可以将奥灵与自己的灵魂缔结**契约**，以便在此后**召唤**。当你首次邂逅某个奥灵时，游戏主持人将会告诉你**契约**流程的细节。作为一次行动，你可以消耗40点精神值**召唤**一个已缔结**契约**的奥灵，下页中的内容会对此流程进行详细说明。如果你在创建角色时选择了这项技能，可以从下一页的列表中任选一个奥灵，视为已与你缔结**契约**。若非如此，你便只能在探索和剧情推进的过程中邂逅新的奥灵。

en: You may **bind** Arcana to your soul and **summon** them later. When you encounter a new Arcanum, the Game Master will reveal what you must do in order to bind them.\nYou may use an action and spend 30 Mind Points to **summon** the power of one of the Arcana you have previously bound.\nIf you take this Skill at character creation, you begin play with one Arcanum bound to you (you may **choose it** from the sample Arcana or **create it** with your group). Any further Arcana must be obtained through exploration and story progression.
it: Puoi **vincolare** gli Arcana alla tua anima per **evocarli** in seguito. Quando incontri un nuovo Arcanum, il Game Master ti svela cosa dovrai fare per vincolarlo.\nPuoi usare un'azione e spendere 30 Punti Mente per **evocare** il potere di uno degli Arcana che hai vincolato in precedenza (vedi prossima pagina).\nSe acquisisci questa Abilità durante la creazione del personaggio, inizi il gioco con un Arcanum già vincolato (puoi **sceglierlo** dagli esempi o **crearlo** con il gruppo). Qualsiasi altro Arcanum va ottenuto attraverso l'esplorazione e con il progredire della storia.

Any further Arcana must be obtained through exploration and story progression.

Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 30 Points de Magie pour **invoquer** un Arcanum que vous avez lié : les détails de l’opération figurent page suivante. Si vous prenez cette compétence à la création de personnage, vous commencez la partie avec un Arcanum de votre choix déjà lié, **à choisir** dans la liste des pages suivantes ou **à créer** avec votre groupe. En dehors de cela, vous ne pouvez obtenir de nouveaux Arcana que par l’exploration et le déroulement du récit.

Any further Arcana must be obtained through exploration and story progression.

Se você escolher este Poder na criação de personagem, começará o jogo com um Arcano vinculado a você (você pode **escolhê-lo** do Arcano de exemplo ou **criá-lo** com seu grupo). Quaisquer Arcanos adicionais devem ser obtidos por meio de exploração e progressão na história.

zh-CN: 你可以将奥灵与你的灵魂**绑定**，并在之后**召唤**它们。当你遇见新的奥灵时，游戏主持人会说明**绑定**它所需达成的条件。\n你可以使用一个行动并花费30点精神值，**召唤**一个先前已**绑定**的奥灵之力。\n若你在创建角色时获得此技能，则在游戏开始时已经**绑定**了一个奥灵（你可以从示例奥灵中**选择**，或与团队一同**创造**）。更多奥灵必须通过探索和故事发展来获得。

en: As long as you are in **Crisis**, the cost for summoning your Arcana is reduced by【**SL × 5**】Mind Points.
it: Finché sei in **Crisi**, il costo per evocare i tuoi Arcana è ridotto di【**LA × 5**】 Punti Mente.
de: As long as you are in **Crisis**, the cost for summoning your Arcana is reduced by【**SL × 5**】Mind Points.
fr: Tant que vous êtes en **Crise**, le coût d’invocation de vos Arcana diminue de **【NC × 5】** Points de Magie.
es: As long as you are in **Crisis**, the cost for summoning your Arcana is reduced by【**SL × 5**】Mind Points.
pt-BR: Enquanto você estiver em crise, o custo para invocar seus Arcanos será reduzido em 【NP × 5】 Pontos Mentais.

zh-CN: 当你处于**危机状态**时，你召唤奥灵的精神值消耗减少【**技能等级×5**】点。

en: You may perform Rituals of the **Arcanism** discipline, as long as their effects fall within the **domains** of one or more Arcana you have bound (see next pages). Arcanism Rituals use【**WLP + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
it: Puoi eseguire Rituali della disciplina di **Arcanismo**, a patto che i loro effetti rientrino nei **domini** di uno o più Arcana tra quelli che hai vincolato (vedi prossime pagine). I Rituali di Arcanismo utilizzano【 **VOL + VOL**】 per il Test di Magia.
de: You may perform Rituals of the **Arcanism** discipline, as long as their effects fall within the **domains** of one or more Arcana you have bound (see next pages). Arcanism Rituals use【**WLP + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
fr: Vous pouvez réaliser des rituels de la discipline **Arcanisme** tant que leurs effets relèvent des **domaines** d’un ou plusieurs Arcana que vous avez liés (voir pages suivantes). Le test de magie des rituels d’arcanisme utilise **【VOL + VOL】** .
es: You may perform Rituals of the **Arcanism** discipline, as long as their effects fall within the **domains** of one or more Arcana you have bound (see next pages). Arcanism Rituals use【**WLP + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
pt-BR: Você pode realizar Rituais da disciplina Arcanismo, desde que seus efeitos estejam dentro dos domínios de um ou mais Arcanos que você vinculou (veja as próximas páginas). Rituais de Arcanismo usam 【VON + VON】 para a Verificação Mágica.

zh-CN: 你可以启动**奥灵系**仪式，此仪式的效果必须隶属于某个与你契约的奥灵所拥有的**领域**（见下文）。**奥灵系**仪式以【**意志+意志**】进行施法检定。

en: When you perform a **pulse**, before resolving its effects, you may choose to have all damage you deal ignore Affinities until the end of this turn. If you do, the next time you deal damage before the end of this turn, you deal **【SL + 4】** extra damage.
it: Quando esegui un **impulso**, prima di risolverne gli effetti, puoi far sì che tutto il danno che infliggi ignori le Affinità fino al termine di questo turno. Se lo fai, la prossima volta che infliggi danno prima del termine di questo turno, infliggi **【LA + 4】** danni extra.
de: When you perform a **pulse**, before resolving its effects, you may choose to have all damage you deal ignore Affinities until the end of this turn. If you do, the next time you deal damage before the end of this turn, you deal **【SL + 4】** extra damage.
fr: Lorsque que vous effectuez une **pulsation**, avant de résoudre ses effets, vous pouvez faire en sorte que tous les dégâts que vous infligez ignorent les Affinités jusqu’à la fin de ce tour. Dans ce cas, la prochaine fois que vous infligez des dégâts avant la fin de ce tour, vous infligez **【NC + 4】** dégâts supplémentaires.
es: When you perform a **pulse**, before resolving its effects, you may choose to have all damage you deal ignore Affinities until the end of this turn. If you do, the next time you deal damage before the end of this turn, you deal **【SL + 4】** extra damage.
pt-BR: Ao executar um **pulso**, antes de resolver seus efeitos, você pode optar por ignorar Afinidades em todo o dano causado até o final deste turno. Se fizer isso, na próxima vez que causar dano antes do final deste turno, você causará **【NP + 4】** dano extra.
ru: When you perform a **pulse**, before resolving its effects, you may choose to have all damage you deal ignore Affinities until the end of this turn. If you do, the next time you deal damage before the end of this turn, you deal **【SL + 4】** extra damage.
pl: When you perform a **pulse**, before resolving its effects, you may choose to have all damage you deal ignore Affinities until the end of this turn. If you do, the next time you deal damage before the end of this turn, you deal **【SL + 4】** extra damage.
zh-CN: 当你发动**脉动**时，在结算其效果前，你可以选择让你造成的所有伤害忽略相性，直到此回合结束。若如此做，在此回合结束前，你下次造成伤害时额外造成【**SL+4**】点伤害。

en: When you **summon** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by **【SL × 5】**; **and/or** after you summon the Arcanum, if you are **merged** with it, immediately perform its **pulse**. If you choose at least one option, you **cannot willingly dismiss** that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both options, that Arcanum's **dismiss** effect will not be available for this summoning.
it: Quando **evochi** un Arcanum nel tuo turno in un conflitto, scegli fino a due opzioni: riduci il suo costo in PM di **【LA × 5】; e/o** dopo aver evocato l'Arcanum, se sei **fuso** con esso, esegui immediatamente il suo **impulso**. Se scegli almeno un'opzione, **non puoi congedare volontariamente** quell'Arcanum fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno; se scegli entrambe, il suo effetto di **congedo** non è disponibile per questa evocazione.
de: When you **summon** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by **【SL × 5】**; **and/or** after you summon the Arcanum, if you are **merged** with it, immediately perform its **pulse**. If you choose at least one option, you **cannot willingly dismiss** that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both options, that Arcanum's **dismiss** effect will not be available for this summoning.
fr: Lorsque vous **invoquez** un Arcanum lors de votre tour pendant un conflit, choisissez jusqu’à deux options : réduisez son coût en PM de **【NC × 5】** ; **et/ou** après avoir invoqué l’Arcanum, si vous avez **fusionné** avec lui, effectuez immédiatement sa **pulsation**. Si vous avez choisis au moins une option, vous **ne pouvez pas renvoyer volontairement** cet Arcanum avant le début de votre prochain tour ; si vous avez choisi les deux options, l’effet de **renvoi** de cet Arcanum n’est pas disponible pour cette invocation.
es: When you **summon** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by **【SL × 5】**; **and/or** after you summon the Arcanum, if you are **merged** with it, immediately perform its **pulse**. If you choose at least one option, you **cannot willingly dismiss** that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both options, that Arcanum's **dismiss** effect will not be available for this summoning.
pt-BR: Ao **invocar** um Arcano no seu turno durante um conflito, escolha até duas opções: reduzir seu custo de PM em **【NP × 5】**; **e/ou** após invocar o Arcano, se você estiver **fundido** com ele, execute imediatamente seu **pulso**. Se escolher pelo menos uma opção, você **não poderá dispensar** voluntariamente aquele Arcano até o início do seu próximo turno; se escolher ambas as opções, o efeito de **dispensar** daquele Arcano não estará disponível para esta invocação.
ru: When you **summon** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by **【SL × 5】**; **and/or** after you summon the Arcanum, if you are **merged** with it, immediately perform its **pulse**. If you choose at least one option, you **cannot willingly dismiss** that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both options, that Arcanum's **dismiss** effect will not be available for this summoning.
pl: When you **summon** an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by **【SL × 5】**; **and/or** after you summon the Arcanum, if you are **merged** with it, immediately perform its **pulse**. If you choose at least one option, you **cannot willingly dismiss** that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both options, that Arcanum's **dismiss** effect will not be available for this summoning.
zh-CN: 在冲突中你的回合**召唤**奥灵时，选择至多两项：精神值消耗减少【**SL×5**】；**以及／或者召唤**该奥灵后，若你与其**融合**，立即发动其**脉动**。若你选择了至少一项，则直到你的下个回合开始前，你都**不能主动遣散**该奥灵；若你选择了两项，此次**召唤**期间无法使用该奥灵的**遣散**效果。

en:
When you **dismiss** this Arcanum, choose **Forge** or **Inferno**:
**Forge.** You create a **basic armor**, **shield** or **weapon** of your choice. If you select this option again, the previously created item vanishes. If you create a weapon this way, it deals **fire** damage instead of **physical**.
**Inferno.** Choose any number of creatures you can see: each of them suffers 30 **fire** damage. This damage ignores Resistances.

en: When you deal damage to one or more creatures with one of your Chimerist spells, each of those creatures that share their **Species** with the creature you originally learned that spell from suffers **poisoned**.
it: Quando infliggi danno a una o più creature con uno dei tuoi incantesimi da Chimerista, infliggi lo status **avvelenato** a ciascuna tra di esse che condivida la **Specie** con quella della creatura da cui hai originariamente appreso l’incantesimo.
de: When you deal damage to one or more creatures with one of your Chimerist spells, each of those creatures that share their **Species** with the creature you originally learned that spell from suffers **poisoned**.
fr: Quand vous infligez des dégâts à une ou plusieurs créatures avec un de vos sorts de Chimériste, chacune de ces créatures dont l’**espèce** est la même que celle dont vous avez appris ce sort reçoit l’état **empoisonné**.
es: When you deal damage to one or more creatures with one of your Chimerist spells, each of those creatures that share their **Species** with the creature you originally learned that spell from suffers **poisoned**.
pt-BR: Quando você causa dano a uma ou mais criaturas com uma de suas magias de Quimerista, cada uma daquelas criaturas que compartilham suas Espécies com a criatura com a qual você originalmente aprendeu aquela magia sofre envenenamento.

pl: When you deal damage to one or more creatures with one of your Chimerist spells, each of those creatures that share their **Species** with the creature you originally learned that spell from suffers **poisoned**.
zh-CN: 当你施放拟兽使法术对生物造成伤害时，在被命中的生物中，与你学习此法术时的模仿对象属于相同**物种**的所有生物均会被施加**中毒**状态。

en: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Chimerism** discipline. When you acquire this Skill, choose【**INS + WLP**】**or**【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your Chimerism Rituals will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check.
it: Puoi eseguire Rituali i cui effetti rientrino nella disciplina di **Chimerismo**. Quando acquisisci questa Abilità, scegli 【**INT + VOL**】 **oppure** 【**VIG + VOL**】. D’ora in poi, i tuoi Rituali di Chimerismo utilizzano le Caratteristiche scelte per il Test di Magia.
de: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Chimerism** discipline. When you acquire this Skill, choose【**INS + WLP**】**or**【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your Chimerism Rituals will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check.
fr: Vous pouvez réaliser des rituels de la discipline **Chimérisme**. Lorsque vous obtenez cette compétence, choisissez **【INT + VOL】 ou 【PUI + VOL】** . Dorénavant, vous utilisez ces attributs pour le test de magie de vos rituels de Chimérisme.
es: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Chimerism** discipline. When you acquire this Skill, choose【**INS + WLP**】**or**【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your Chimerism Rituals will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check.
pt-BR: Você pode realizar Rituais cujos efeitos se enquadrem na disciplina Quimerismo. Ao adquirir esse Poder, escolha 【INT + VON】 ou 【VIG + VON】. A partir de agora, seus Rituais de Quimerismo usarão os Atributos escolhidos para o Teste Mágico.
ru: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Chimerism** discipline. When you acquire this Skill, choose【**INS + WLP**】**or**【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your Chimerism Rituals will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check.
