zh-CN: 你可以启动效果属于**拟兽系**的仪式。当你习得此技能时，选择【**洞察+意志**】**或**【**力量+意志**】。从现在起，你在启动**拟兽系**仪式时将会使用所选的属性组合进行施法检定。

en:
After a **beast**, **monster**, or **plant** creature you can see casts a spell and resolves its effects, you may learn that spell as a Chimerist spell of your own: if you do, record the **Species** of the creature you learned it from.
When you first acquire this Skill, choose 【**INS + WLP**】 or 【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your offensive (⚡) Chimerist spells will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creature you learned the spell from.
You may have **up to 【**SL + 2**】 different Chimerist spells** memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.
it: Quando vedi una creatura della Specie **bestia, mostro** o **pianta** lanciare un incantesimo, puoi scegliere di imparare immediatamente quell’incantesimo come incantesimo da Chimerista: se lo fai, prendi nota della **Specie** della creatura da cui lo hai appreso. Quando acquisisci questa Abilità, scegli 【**INT + VOL**】 **oppure** 【**VIG + VOL**】. D’ora in poi, i tuoi incantesimi offensivi (⚡) di Chimerismo utilizzano le Caratteristiche scelte per il Test di Magia, a prescindere da quelle usate dalle creature da cui li hai appresi. Puoi avere **fino a** 【**LA + 2**】 **incantesimi da Chimerista differenti** memorizzati in questo modo. Se vuoi memorizzare un nuovo incantesimo da Chimerista ma hai già raggiunto il limite, devi dimenticare uno dei vecchi incantesimi e sostituirlo con quello nuovo.
de:
After a **beast**, **monster**, or **plant** creature you can see casts a spell and resolves its effects, you may learn that spell as a Chimerist spell of your own: if you do, record the **Species** of the creature you learned it from.
When you first acquire this Skill, choose 【**INS + WLP**】 or 【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your offensive (⚡) Chimerist spells will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creature you learned the spell from.
You may have **up to 【**SL + 2**】 different Chimerist spells** memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.
fr: Quand vous voyez une créature appartenant à l’espèce **bête**, **monstre** ou **plante** lancer un sort, vous pouvez immédiatement choisir de l’apprendre sous forme de sort de Chimériste : dans ce cas, notez l’**espèce** de la créature dont vous le tenez. Quand vous obtenez ce sort, choisissez **【INT + VOL】 ou 【PUI + VOL】** . Dorénavant, vous utilisez ces attributs pour le test de magie de vos sorts offensifs (⚡) de Chimériste, quels que soient ceux qu’employait la créature lorsque vous l’avez appris. Vous pouvez mémoriser **jusqu’à 【NC + 2】 sorts de Chimériste** de cette façon. Si vous souhaitez mémoriser un nouveau sort de Chimériste alors que vous avez déjà atteint votre limite, vous devez oublier l’un des anciens et le remplacer par le nouveau.
es:
After a **beast**, **monster**, or **plant** creature you can see casts a spell and resolves its effects, you may learn that spell as a Chimerist spell of your own: if you do, record the **Species** of the creature you learned it from.
When you first acquire this Skill, choose 【**INS + WLP**】 or 【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your offensive (⚡) Chimerist spells will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creature you learned the spell from.
You may have **up to 【**SL + 2**】 different Chimerist spells** memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.
pt-BR:
Após uma criatura do tipo **fera**, **monstro** ou **planta** que você possa ver conjurar uma magia e resolver seus efeitos, você pode aprender essa magia como uma de suas próprias magias de Quimerista: se fizer isso, registre a **Espécie** da criatura com a qual aprendeu a magia.
Quando adquirir este Poder pela primeira vez, escolha 【**AST + VON**】 ou 【**VIG + VON**】. A partir de então, suas magias ofensivas (⚡) de Quimerista usarão os Atributos escolhidos para o Teste de Magia, independentemente dos Atributos usados pela criatura com a qual você aprendeu a magia.
Você pode ter **até 【**NP + 2**】 magias de Quimerista diferentes** memorizadas dessa forma. Se quiser memorizar uma nova magia de Quimerista, mas já estiver no seu limite, você deve esquecer uma de suas magias antigas e substituí-la pela nova.

When you first acquire this Skill, choose 【**INS + WLP**】 or 【**MIG + WLP**】. From now on, your offensive (⚡) Chimerist spells will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creature you learned the spell from.
You may have **up to 【**SL + 2**】 different Chimerist spells** memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.
zh-CN: 当你目睹**物种**为**野兽**、**怪物**或**植物**的生物施放法术时，可以选择习得此法术并作为专属于你的拟兽使法术，你在记录法术时需一并记录此生物所属的**物种**。当你首次习得此技能时，选择**【洞察+意志】**或**【力量+意志】**。从现在起，你在施放拟兽使的攻击性法术（OO）时将会使用所选的属性组合进行施法检定，而非你学习此法术时的模仿对象检定所用属性。你可以通过这种方式记忆至多**【技能等级+2】个拟兽使法术**。如果你想要记忆新的法术，但当前记忆的法术数量已达上限，则必须遗忘一个已有的法术，并用新学会的法术作为替换。

en: Once per turn (including other creatures’ turns), after you deal damage to one or more enemies you have a **Bond** towards, you may recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points and 【**SL × 2**】 Mind Points.
it: Dopo che infliggi danno a una o più creature, se hai un **Legame** con almeno una di esse, puoi recuperare 【**LA × 2**】 Punti Vita e 【**LA × 2**】 Punti Mente.
de: Once per turn (including other creatures’ turns), after you deal damage to one or more enemies you have a **Bond** towards, you may recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points and 【**SL × 2**】 Mind Points.
fr: Après avoir infligé des dégâts à une ou plusieurs créatures, si vous avez un lien avec au moins l’une d’entre elles, vous pouvez récupérer 【NC × 2】 Points de Vie et **【NC × 2】** Points de Magie.
es: Once per turn (including other creatures’ turns), after you deal damage to one or more enemies you have a **Bond** towards, you may recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points and 【**SL × 2**】 Mind Points.
pt-BR: Uma vez por turno (incluindo os turnos de outras criaturas), depois que você causar dano a um ou mais inimigos pelos quais tenha um **Laço**, você pode recuperar 【**NP × 2**】 Pontos de Vida e 【**NP × 2**】 Pontos de Mente.
ru: Once per turn (including other creatures’ turns), after you deal damage to one or more enemies you have a **Bond** towards, you may recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points and 【**SL × 2**】 Mind Points.
pl: Once per turn (including other creatures’ turns), after you deal damage to one or more enemies you have a **Bond** towards, you may recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points and 【**SL × 2**】 Mind Points.
zh-CN: 每个回合限一次（其他生物的回合也计入在内），当你对你建立了**羁绊**的敌人造成伤害后，你可以恢复等同于【**技能等级×2**】的生命值和精神值。

en: As long as you are in **Crisis**, you have Resistance to **dark** damage and **poison** damage.
it: Finché sei in **Crisi**, hai Resistenza ai danni da **ombra** e **veleno**.
de: As long as you are in **Crisis**, you have Resistance to **dark** damage and **poison** damage.
fr: Tant que vous êtes en **Crise**, vous bénéficiez d’une résistance aux dégâts de **ténèbres** et de **poison**.
es: As long as you are in **Crisis**, you have Resistance to **dark** damage and **poison** damage.
pt-BR: Enquanto estiver em crise, você terá resistência a danos de trevas e veneno.
ru: As long as you are in **Crisis**, you have Resistance to **dark** damage and **poison** damage.
pl: As long as you are in **Crisis**, you have Resistance to **dark** damage and **poison** damage.
zh-CN: 当你处于**危机状态**时，你对**暗系**和**毒系**伤害具有抵抗相性。

en: Once per scene upon entering **Crisis**, you may choose a specific creature you can see that you don't have a **Bond** towards. If you do, create a **Bond** of **hatred** towards that creature.
it: Una volta per scena quando vai in **Crisi**, puoi scegliere una specifica creatura a te visibile con cui non hai un **Legame**. Se lo fai, stringi un **Legame** di **odio** con quella creatura.
de: Once per scene upon entering **Crisis**, you may choose a specific creature you can see that you don't have a **Bond** towards. If you do, create a **Bond** of **hatred** towards that creature.
fr: Une fois par scène, lorsque vous entrez en **Crise**, vous pouvez choisir une créature spécifique que vous voyez et avec laquelle vous n’avez pas de **lien** : créez un **lien** de **haine** envers cette créature.
es: Once per scene upon entering **Crisis**, you may choose a specific creature you can see that you don't have a **Bond** towards. If you do, create a **Bond** of **hatred** towards that creature.
pt-BR: Uma vez por cena, ao entrar na Crise, você pode escolher uma criatura específica com a qual você pode ver e que não tem um vínculo. Se fizer isso, crie um Laço de ódio contra aquela criatura.
ru: Once per scene upon entering **Crisis**, you may choose a specific creature you can see that you don't have a **Bond** towards. If you do, create a **Bond** of **hatred** towards that creature.
pl: Once per scene upon entering **Crisis**, you may choose a specific creature you can see that you don't have a **Bond** towards. If you do, create a **Bond** of **hatred** towards that creature.
zh-CN: 每个场景限一次，当你进入**危机状态**时，你可以选择一个你能看见的且你未与其建立**羁绊**的生物。如果你这样做，便可对该生物建立情感为**憎恨**的**羁绊**。

en: After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the **Study** action on that creature (see page **74**) for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Check. Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once.
it: Subito dopo aver perso Punti Vita a causa di un’altra creatura (per via di un attacco, un incantesimo o in qualsiasi altro modo), puoi eseguire gratuitamente l’azione di **Studio** su quella creatura. Se lo fai, ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 al tuo Test. Ricorda che puoi studiare il medesimo aspetto di una creatura soltanto una volta.
de: After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the **Study** action on that creature (see page **74**) for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Check. Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once.
fr: Après qu’une autre créature vous a fait perdre des Points de Vie (au moyen d’une attaque, d’un sort ou de toute autre méthode), vous pouvez aussitôt réaliser gratuitement l’action **Analyse** (voir page **74**) en la prenant pour cible, bénéficiant alors d’un bonus égal à votre **【NC】** au test. Rappelez-vous que vous ne pouvez analyser qu’une fois chaque aspect d’une créature.
es: After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the **Study** action on that creature (see page **74**) for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Check. Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once.
pt-BR: Depois que outra criatura fizer com que você perca Pontos de Vida (com um ataque, uma magia ou qualquer outro método), você poderá realizar imediatamente a ação Estudar naquela criatura (veja a página 74) de graça. Se fizer isso, ganhe um bônus igual a【NP】no seu Teste. Lembre-se, você só pode estudar o mesmo aspecto de uma criatura uma vez.
ru: After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the **Study** action on that creature (see page **74**) for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Check. Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once.
pl: After another creature causes you to lose Hit Points (with an attack, a spell or any other method), you may immediately perform the **Study** action on that creature (see page **74**) for free. If you do, gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Check. Remember, you can study the same aspect of a creature only once.
zh-CN: 当其他生物令你失去生命值后（无论是通过攻击、法术还是任何其他方式），你可以立即对该生物执行一次类型为**调查**（见第**74**页）的顺势行动。如果你这样做，则在此次检定中获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。请记住，单个生物每一方面的内容均只能被你**调查**一次。

en: You have learned to channel your vital force into your attacks. You may use an action to perform a **Shadow Strike**: roll your current **Might** die and lose an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**the number rolled on your Might die**】. If this didn't reduce your Hit Points to 0, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped: if this attack hits one or more targets, it deals extra damage equal to 【**SL + the number rolled on your Might die**】. However, all damage dealt by this attack becomes **dark** and its damage type cannot be changed.
it: Hai imparato a incanalare la forza vitale nei tuoi attacchi. Puoi usare un’azione per eseguire un **Fendente Oscuro**: tira il tuo attuale dado di **Vigore** e perdi Punti Vita pari a 【**il numero ottenuto sul dado di Vigore**】. Se questo non riduce i tuoi Punti Vita a 0, puoi eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata: se l’attacco colpisce uno o più bersagli, infligge danni extra pari a 【**LA + il numero ottenuto sul dado di Vigore**】. Tuttavia, tutto il danno inflitto dall’attacco diventa **ombra** e il suo tipo non può essere cambiato.
de: You have learned to channel your vital force into your attacks. You may use an action to perform a **Shadow Strike**: roll your current **Might** die and lose an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**the number rolled on your Might die**】. If this didn't reduce your Hit Points to 0, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped: if this attack hits one or more targets, it deals extra damage equal to 【**SL + the number rolled on your Might die**】. However, all damage dealt by this attack becomes **dark** and its damage type cannot be changed.
fr: Vous avez appris à canaliser votre énergie vitale dans vos attaques. Vous pouvez utiliser une action pour effectuer une **Frappe de l’ombre**. Lancez alors votre dé de **Puissance** actuel : le résultat **indique le nombre de Points de Vie que vous perdez**. Si vous n’êtes pas tombé à 0 Point de Vie, vous pouvez réaliser une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme dont vous êtes équipé : si l’attaque touche au moins une cible, elle inflige un nombre de dégâts supplémentaire égal à **【NC + résultat obtenu au dé de Puissance】**. Tous les dégâts infligés par l’attaque deviennent toutefois des dégâts de **ténèbres**, et on ne peut pas changer leur type.
es: You have learned to channel your vital force into your attacks. You may use an action to perform a **Shadow Strike**: roll your current **Might** die and lose an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**the number rolled on your Might die**】. If this didn't reduce your Hit Points to 0, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped: if this attack hits one or more targets, it deals extra damage equal to 【**SL + the number rolled on your Might die**】. However, all damage dealt by this attack becomes **dark** and its damage type cannot be changed.

Você pode usar uma ação para realizar um Golpe Sombrio: jogue seu dado de Potência atual e perca uma quantidade de Pontos de Vida igual ao 【o número obtido em seu dado de Vigor】. Se isso não reduziu seus Pontos de Vida a 0, você pode realizar um ataque livre com uma arma que você tenha equipado: se este ataque atingir um ou mais alvos, ele causará dano extra igual a 【NP + o número obtido no seu dado de Vigor. 】. No entanto, todo o dano causado por este ataque torna-se trevas e seu tipo de dano não pode ser alterado.

zh-CN: 你已学会将自己的生命力注入到攻势之中。作为一次行动，你可以施放**暗影击**：使用你当前的**力量**骰进行掷骰，并失去等同于**【力量骰掷骰结果】**的生命值。如果你的生命值没有因此降为0，便可使用当前装备的武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。若本次攻击命中至少一个目标，便会额外造成等同于**【技能等级+力量骰掷骰结果】**的伤害。本次攻击造成的所有伤害都会变为**暗系**伤害，且无法变为其他类型。

en:
When you cast a spell with a **duration** of “Instantaneous”, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may **increase the spell’s total MP cost** by up to 【**SL × 10**】 Mind Points.
If you do so, the spell deals 5 extra damage for every 10 Mind Points by which you increased its cost this way.
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo con **durata** “Istantanea”, se hai un’arma **arcana** equipaggiata, puoi **incrementare il costo totale in PM di quell’incantesimo di un ammontare pari o inferiore a** 【**LA × 10**】 Punti Mente. Se lo fai e l’incantesimo infligge danni a una o più creature, l’incantesimo infligge 5 danni extra a ciascuna di esse per ogni 10 Punti Mente di cui ne hai incrementato il costo.
de:
When you cast a spell with a **duration** of “Instantaneous”, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may **increase the spell’s total MP cost** by up to (SL × 10) Mind Points.
If you do so, the spell deals 5 extra damage for every 10 Mind Points by which you increased its cost this way.
fr: Quand vous lancez un sort de durée **instantanée**, si vous êtes équipé d’une arme **arcanique**, vous pouvez **accroître le coût total en PM du sort**, d’un maximum de **【NC × 10】** Points de Magie. Dans ce cas, s’il inflige des dégâts à une ou plusieurs créatures, ceux-ci augmentent pour chaque cible de 5 par tranche de 10 Points de Magie supplémentaires dépensés.
es:
When you cast a spell with a **duration** of “Instantaneous”, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may **increase the spell’s total MP cost** by up to (SL × 10) Mind Points.
If you do so, the spell deals 5 extra damage for every 10 Mind Points by which you increased its cost this way.
pt-BR:
Ao conjurar uma magia com **duração** “Instantânea”, se você tiver uma arma **arcana** equipada, você pode **aumentar o custo total de PM da magia** em até 【**NP × 10**】 Pontos de Mente.
Se fizer isso, a magia causa 5 pontos de dano adicionais para cada 10 Pontos de Mente acrescentados ao seu custo dessa forma.

When you cast a spell with a **duration** of “Instantaneous”, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may **increase the spell’s total MP cost** by up to (SL × 10) Mind Points.

zh-CN: 当你施放**持续时间**为“瞬发”的法术时，如果你当前装备了**魔法类**武器，则可以将此法术的**精神值总消耗提升**至多等同于【**技能等级×10**】点。如果你这样做，则每以此方式将法术的**精神值总消耗提升**10点，此法术便会造成5点额外伤害。

en: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Elementalist spell. Offensive (⚡) Elementalist spells use 【**INS + WLP**】 for the Magic Check.
it: Ogni volta che acquisisci questa Abilità, impari un incantesimo da Elementalista. Gli incantesimi offensivi (⚡) da Elementalista utilizzano 【**INT + VOL**】 per il Test di Magia.

en: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) targeting a **single creature**, if the spell has a **total Mind Point cost of 【SL × 20】 or lower**, you may choose one **non-arcane** weapon you have equipped. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell uses the chosen weapon’s Accuracy Check formula; if that formula includes **Dexterity**, the Magic Check also gains a bonus equal to 【**SL**】. For instance, casting an **Elementalist** spell through a **bronze sword** (page **131**) when you have **Skill Level 2** in **Spellblade** will cause the Magic Check to be 【**DEX + MIG**】 **+3** instead of 【**INS + WLP**】.
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo offensivo (⚡) e bersagli **una sola creatura**, se l’incantesimo ha un **costo totale in Punti Mente pari o inferiore a** 【**LA × 10**】 e hai una o più armi equipaggiate della Categoria **arco, flagello, lancia, pugnale, da rissa** o **spada**, puoi scegliere una di queste armi. Se lo fai, il tuo Test di Magia per l’incantesimo utilizza la formula del Test di Precisione dell’arma; per esempio, il Test di Magia per un incantesimo da Elementalista lanciato attraverso una **spada di bronzo** è 【**DES + VIG**】 +1 invece di 【**INT + VOL**】.
de: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) targeting a **single creature**, if the spell has a **total Mind Point cost of 【SL × 20】 or lower**, you may choose one **non-arcane** weapon you have equipped. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell uses the chosen weapon’s Accuracy Check formula; if that formula includes **Dexterity**, the Magic Check also gains a bonus equal to 【**SL**】. For instance, casting an **Elementalist** spell through a **bronze sword** (page **131**) when you have **Skill Level 2** in **Spellblade** will cause the Magic Check to be 【**DEX + MIG**】 **+3** instead of 【**INS + WLP**】.
fr: Quand vous lancez un sort offensif (⚡) visant **une seule créature** en étant équipé d’une ou plusieurs armes de catégorie **arme**, **lutte**, **dague**, **articulé**, **lance** ou **épée**, si le **coût total en Points de Magie du sort est inférieur ou égal à 【NC × 10】**, vous pouvez choisir une de ces armes : le test de magie du sort est effectué à l’aide de la formule de précision de l’arme en question. Par exemple, le test de magie d’un sort d’Élémentaliste lancé au moyen d’une **épée de bronze** (page **131**) se fait avec **【DEX + PUI】+1** au lieu d’ **【INT + VOL】**.
es: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) targeting a **single creature**, if the spell has a **total Mind Point cost of 【SL × 20】 or lower**, you may choose one **non-arcane** weapon you have equipped. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell uses the chosen weapon’s Accuracy Check formula; if that formula includes **Dexterity**, the Magic Check also gains a bonus equal to 【**SL**】. For instance, casting an **Elementalist** spell through a **bronze sword** (page **131**) when you have **Skill Level 2** in **Spellblade** will cause the Magic Check to be 【**DEX + MIG**】 **+3** instead of 【**INS + WLP**】.
pt-BR: Ao conjurar um Feitiço ofensivo (⚡) que tenha como alvo uma **única criatura**, se o feitiço tiver um **custo total em Pontos de Mente de 【NP × 20】 ou menos**, você pode escolher uma arma **não arcana** que tenha equipada. Se fizer isso, seu Teste de Magia para esse Feitiço usa a fórmula do Teste de Precisão da arma escolhida; se essa fórmula incluir **Destreza**, o Teste de Magia também recebe um bônus igual a 【**NP**】. Por exemplo, conjurar um Feitiço de **Elementalista** por meio de uma **espada de bronze** (página **187**) quando você tem **Nível de Poder 2** em **Lâmina Mágica** fará com que o Teste de Magia seja 【**DES + VIG**】 **+3** em vez de 【**AST + VON**】.
ru: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) targeting a **single creature**, if the spell has a **total Mind Point cost of 【SL × 20】 or lower**, you may choose one **non-arcane** weapon you have equipped. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell uses the chosen weapon’s Accuracy Check formula; if that formula includes **Dexterity**, the Magic Check also gains a bonus equal to 【**SL**】. For instance, casting an **Elementalist** spell through a **bronze sword** (page **131**) when you have **Skill Level 2** in **Spellblade** will cause the Magic Check to be 【**DEX + MIG**】 **+3** instead of 【**INS + WLP**】.

zh-CN: 当你针对**单个生物**施放攻击性法术（OO）时，如果此法术的精神值总消耗不高于**【技能等级×20】**，你可以选择你当前装备的一件**非魔法类**武器。如果你这样做，你为此法术进行的施法检定将使用所选武器的命中检定算式。如果该算式包含**敏捷**属性，此次施法检定还会获得等同于**【技能等级】**的修正值。例如，如果你的**以械引咒技能等级为2**，通过**青铜剑**（见第**131**页）施放的**元素使**法术将以**【敏捷+力量】+3**进行施法检定，而非**【洞察+意志】**。

en: You have a **lucky number**; at the beginning of each session, that number is **7**. Once per scene after you perform a Check, you may replace the value shown on one of the dice you rolled with your lucky number (even if this would give an impossible Result, such as a value of 7 on a d6). If you do, the replaced value becomes your **new** lucky number.
it: All’inizio di ogni sessione, hai un **numero fortunato** pari a **7**. Una volta per scena, dopo che hai effettuato un Test, puoi sostituire il valore mostrato da uno dei dadi con il tuo numero fortunato (anche se portasse a un esito impossibile, come 7 su un d6). Se lo fai, il numero sostituito diventa il tuo nuovo numero fortunato.
de: You have a **lucky number**; at the beginning of each session, that number is **7**. If you do, the replaced value becomes your **new** lucky number.
fr: Vous avez un **nombre porte-bonheur**. Au début de chaque séance de jeu, il s’agit de 7. Le résultat que vous avez remplacé devient votre **nouveau** nombre porte-bonheur.

en:
During a conflict, you may use an action to interfere with the flow of time by spending up to 【**SL × 5**】 Mind Points. For every 5 Mind Points you spend this way, choose one option: one creature you can see suffers **slow**; **or** one creature you can see recovers from **slow**; **or** one enemy you can see that is suffering from **slow** loses 【**10 +  (SL × 5)**】 Hit Points; **or** one creature you can see may perform the **Equipment** action for free; **or** choose one ally you can see that has yet to take a turn during this round: that ally may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
Each option can only be chosen **once** per use of this Skill.
it: Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere fino a 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Mente per interferire con il flusso temporale. Per ogni 5 Punti Mente spesi in questo modo, scegli un’opzione (non puoi scegliere più volte la stessa opzione): una creatura a te visibile subisce lo status **lento**; **oppure** una creatura a te visibile guarisce dallo status **lento**; **oppure** una creatura a te visibile può immediatamente e gratuitamente eseguire l’azione di **Equipaggiamento**; **oppure** un alleato a te visibile a tua scelta che deve ancora svolgere il suo turno in questo round può invece svolgerlo subito dopo il tuo.

Each option can only be chosen **once** per use of this Skill.
fr: Pendant un conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action pour perturber le déroulement du temps en dépensant jusqu’à **【NC × 5】** Points de Magie. Pour chaque tranche de 5 PM dépensée de la sorte, choisissez une option : une créature que vous voyez subit l’état **ralenti**, **ou** une créature que vous voyez se débarrasse de l’état **ralenti**, **ou** une créature que vous voyez peut aussitôt effectuer gratuitement l’action **Équipement**, **ou** vous choisissez un allié que vous pouvez voir et qui n’a pas encore joué son tour durant ce round : cet allié peut jouer immédiatement son tour après le vôtre pendant ce round. Chaque option ne peut être choisie qu’une fois par utilisation de cette compétence.

Cada opção só pode ser escolhida **uma vez** por uso deste Poder.

zh-CN: 在冲突场景中，作为**一次**行动，你可以消耗至多【**技能等级×5**】的精神值来干涉时间的流动。你每以此方式消耗5点精神值，便可从以下效果中选择一项触发：对一个你能看见的生物施加**迟缓**状态；**或**一个你能看见的生物解除**迟缓**状态；**或**一个你能看见的处于**迟缓**状态的敌人失去【**10+（技能等级×5**）】的生命值；**或**一个你能看见的生物可以执行**一次**类型为**装备**的顺势行动；**或**选择一个你能看见且本轮还有未进行的回合的盟友，他可以在你的回合结束时立即开始他的回合。在此技能的单次效果中，每个选项均只能选择**一次**。

en: Your Accuracy Checks with **brawling**, **dagger**, **flail**, and **thrown** weapons trigger a **critical success** if both dice show the same number (and the Check is not a **fumble**).

it: Quando spendi uno o più Punti Fabula, ottieni un beneficio aggiuntivo, scegliendo un’opzione tra: recuperi 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Vita; **oppure** recuperi 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Mente; **oppure** guarisci da un singolo status a tua scelta.

fr: Quand vous dépensez au moins 1 Point Fabula, vous recevez un avantage supplémentaire. Choisissez une option : vous récupérez **【NC × 5】** Points de Vie **ou** vous récupérez **【NC × 5】** Points de Magie **ou** vous vous débarrassez d’un état de votre choix.

en:
You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform an Opposed 【**MIG + WLP**】 Check against an enemy you can see — describe how you taunt them! If you succeed, the target suffers **enraged**, is compelled to focus their attention on you, and must include you among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡) if able. This compulsion ends if you fall unconscious or leave the scene, if the creature is no longer **enraged**, or if they are successfully **provoked** by someone else.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**MIG + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 5 Punti Mente per effettuare un Test Contrapposto di  【**VIG + VOL**】 contro una creatura a te visibile (descrivi in che modo la provochi!). Se hai successo, il bersaglio subisce lo status **furente** e deve concentrare la sua attenzione su di te (i suoi attacchi e incantesimi offensivi devono includerti tra i bersagli se possibile). Questo obbligo termina se perdi i sensi o lasci la scena, se la creatura non è più **furente**, o se viene **provocata** con successo da qualcun altro. Inoltre, ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai tuoi Test di 【**VIG + VOL**】 per questa Abilità.

You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**MIG + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 5 Points de Magie pour réaliser un test opposé de **【PUI + VOL】** contre une créature que vous voyez : décrivez comment vous la provoquez ! En cas de réussite, la cible subit l’état **enragé** et elle est forcée de concentrer son attention sur vous (ses attaques et sorts offensifs doivent vous inclure dans la liste des cibles si possible). Cette obligation cesse si vous perdez connaissance ou quittez la scène, si la créature n’est plus **enragée** ou si quelqu’un d’autre la **provoque**. Vous bénéficiez d’un bonus égal au **【NC】** pour les tests effectués pour cette compétence.

Essa compulsão termina se você ficar inconsciente ou sair da cena, se a criatura deixar de estar sob a condição **enfurecido** ou se ela for **provocada** com sucesso por outra pessoa.
Você recebe um bônus igual a 【**NP**】 em seus Testes de 【**VIG + VON**】 para este Poder.

zh-CN: 作为一次行动，你可以消耗5点精神值，对一个你能看见的生物执行一次【**力量+意志**】对抗检定——然后描述你要如何**挑衅**他！如果你检定成功，目标便会被施加**激怒**，并且被迫将注意力集中在你身上（目标在选择攻击和攻击性法术的目标时必须尽量将你包括在内）。此强制效果会在你失去意识或离开场景时结束。如果该生物不再处于**激怒**状态，或者被其他角色成功**挑衅**，此效果同样会立即结束。你为此技能进行的【**力量+意志**】检定将获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。

en: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you recover Hit Points equal to【**5 + (SL, multiplied by the highest strength among your Bonds)**】and choose **Might** or **Willpower**: you treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the end of your next turn.
it: Quando esegui l’azione di **Guardia**, se scegli di **non** coprire un’altra creatura, recuperi Punti Vita pari a 【**LA, moltiplicato per la forza più alta tra i tuoi Legami**】 e scegli **Vigore** o **Volontà**: fino al termine del tuo prossimo turno, consideri la Caratteristica scelta incrementata di una taglia di dado (massimo **d12**).
de: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you recover Hit Points equal to【5 + **(SL, multiplied by the highest strength among your Bonds)**】and choose **Might** or **Willpower**: you treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the end of your next turn.
fr: Quand vous effectuez l’action **Garde**, si vous choisissez de **ne pas** couvrir une autre créature, vous récupérez un nombre de Points de Vie égal à **【NC × la plus haute intensité parmi vos liens】** et vous devez choisir entre **Puissance** et **Volonté** : vous faites comme si la taille de dé de l’attribut choisi était supérieure d’un cran (jusqu’à un maximum de **d12**) jusqu’à la fin de votre prochain tour.
es: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you recover Hit Points equal to【5 + **(SL, multiplied by the highest strength among your Bonds)**】and choose **Might** or **Willpower**: you treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the end of your next turn.
pt-BR: Quando você realiza a ação **Guarda**, se escolher **não** fornecer cobertura para outra criatura, você recupera Pontos de Vida igual a 【5 + **(NP, multiplicado pela maior força entre seus Laços)**】 e escolhe **Vigor** ou **Vontade**: você trata o Atributo escolhido como se estivesse um tamanho de dado acima (até um máximo de **d12**) até o fim de seu próximo turno.
ru: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you recover Hit Points equal to【5 + **(SL, multiplied by the highest strength among your Bonds)**】and choose **Might** or **Willpower**: you treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**) until the end of your next turn.

zh-CN: 当你执行**防御**行动时，如果选择**不**为其他生物提供掩护，便会恢复等同于**【技能等级×你的所有羁绊中最高的强度】**的生命值；此外你还需从**力量**或**意志**中选择其一，将所选属性的骰子等级视为比原本高一级（最多可提升至**d12**），持续至你的下个回合结束。

en: If you perform the **Guard** action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.
it: Quando esegui l’azione di **Guardia** e scegli di coprire un’altra creatura, quella creatura ottiene Resistenza a tutti i tipi di danno fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: If you perform the **Guard** action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.
fr: Si vous réalisez l’action **Garde** et choisissez de couvrir une autre créature, celle-ci bénéficie d’une résistance à tous les types de dégâts jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.
es: If you perform the **Guard** action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Se você realizar a ação de guarda e escolher fornecer cobertura para outra criatura, aquela criatura ganha Resistência a todos os tipos de dano até o início do seu próximo turno.
ru: If you perform the **Guard** action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.
pl: If you perform the **Guard** action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.

en: As long as you have a **shield** or a **martial armor** equipped, all damage you suffer is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** damage Affinities).
it: Finché hai un’**armatura marziale** o uno **scudo** equipaggiati, tutto il danno che subisci viene ridotto di 【**LA**】 (**prima** di applicare eventuali Affinità).

fr: Tant que vous êtes équipé d’un **bouclier** ou d’une **armure martiale**, tous les dégâts que vous subissez sont réduits de **【NC】** (à appliquer **avant** les affinités aux dégâts).
es: As long as you have a **shield** or a **martial armor** equipped, all damage you suffer is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** damage Affinities).
pt-BR: Contanto que você tenha um escudo ou armadura marcial equipado, todo dano sofrido será reduzido em 【NP】 (aplicado antes das afinidades de dano).

pl: As long as you have a **shield** or a **martial armor** equipped, all damage you suffer is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** damage Affinities).
zh-CN: 如果你装备了**盾牌**或**职业限定防具**，那么你受到的所有伤害都将减少【**技能等级**】点（此效果先于伤害相性生效）。

en: You may now equip a **shield** in your **main hand** slot. As long as you have two shields equipped, you gain the benefits of both items and may treat them as the following combined two-handed melee **brawling** weapon: **Twin Shields**【**MIG + MIG**】【**HR + 5**】 **physical** Deals extra damage equal to your 【**SL**】 in **Defensive Mastery**.
it: Puoi equipaggiare uno **scudo** nel tuo slot **mano principale**. Finché hai due scudi equipaggiati, ottieni i benefici di entrambi gli oggetti e puoi considerarli come la seguente arma combinata da **mischia** a due mani della Categoria **da rissa**: Scudi Gemelli  【**VIG + VIG**】 【**TM + 5**】 fisico. Infligge danni extra pari al tuo 【**LA**】 nell’Abilità **Maestria Difensiva**.
de: You may now equip a **shield** in your **main hand** slot. en: When another creature is threatened by an **attack**, **spell**, or other **danger**, you may take their place (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill **before or after** the Checks have been made). If the danger already affected you, it affects you **twice** (resolve both instances separately); you also cannot protect multiple creatures from the same danger. If you use this Skill during a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
it: Quando un’altra creatura è minacciata da un **attacco, incantesimo** o altro **pericolo**, puoi prenderne il posto (eventuali Test che fanno parte del pericolo verranno effettuati contro di te; puoi dichiarare l’uso di questa Abilità **prima o dopo** che tali Test sono stati effettuati). Se eri già coinvolto nel pericolo, lo subirai **due volte** (risolvi ciascuna istanza separatamente); puoi proteggere una sola creatura dal medesimo pericolo. Se usi questa Abilità in un conflitto, non puoi usarla di nuovo fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: When another creature is threatened by an **attack**, **spell**, or other **danger**, you may take their place (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill **before or after** the Checks have been made). If the danger already affected you, it affects you **twice** (resolve both instances separately); you also cannot protect multiple creatures from the same danger. If you use this Skill during a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
fr: Lorsqu’une autre créature est menacée par une **attaque**, un **sort** ou un autre **danger**, vous pouvez prendre sa place (tous les tests associés au danger sont effectués contre vous ; vous pouvez déclarer l’utilisation de cette compétence **avant ou après** que les tests en question ont été effectués). Si le danger vous a déjà affecté, il vous affecte **deux fois** (résolvez-en les deux effets séparément). En outre, vous ne pouvez pas protéger plusieurs créatures contre le même danger. Si vous utilisez cette compétence lors d’un conflit, vous ne pouvez plus vous en servir de nouveau jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.

Se o perigo já o afetou, ele o afetará duas vezes (resolva ambos os casos separadamente); você também não pode proteger múltiplas criaturas do mesmo perigo. Se você usar esse Poder durante um conflito, você não poderá usá-la novamente até o início do seu próximo turno.

zh-CN: 当另一个生物即将遭遇**攻击**、**法术**或其他**险情**时，你可以代为承受（此**险情**的所有检定都将改为针对你，你可以在这些检定进行**前或进行后**宣布使用此技能）。如果此**险情**已将你包含在目标当中，那么你将承受**两次**效果（需要分开结算）。你在面对同一项**险情**时不能同时挺身守护多个生物。如果你在冲突场景中使用了此技能，则无法在你的下个回合开始前再次使用。

en: When you roll a **13 or higher** on a Check performed to investigate a creature, item or location — this includes using the **Study** action during a conflict — you may ask the Game Master up to 【**SL**】 questions concerning the subject of your investigation. You may ask these questions immediately or save them for later; whenever you ask one of these questions, the Game Master will answer truthfully and you will describe your character's deductive process. This Skill may only be used once on the same creature, item or location.
it: Quando ottieni un Risultato **pari o superiore a 13** in un Test per esaminare una creatura, un oggetto o un luogo (inclusa l’azione di **Studio** durante un conflitto) puoi porre al Game Master fino a 【**LA**】 domande relative a ciò che stai esaminando. Puoi porre queste domande subito oppure conservarle per dopo; quando poni una di queste domande, il Game Master risponde dicendo la verità e tu descrivi il processo deduttivo del tuo personaggio. Questa Abilità può essere usata una volta sola sulla stessa creatura, oggetto o luogo.
de: When you roll a **13 or higher** on a Check performed to investigate a creature, item or location — this includes using the **Study** action during a conflict — you may ask the Game Master up to 【**SL**】 questions concerning the subject of your investigation. You may ask these questions immediately or save them for later; whenever you ask one of these questions, the Game Master will answer truthfully and you will describe your character's deductive process. This Skill may only be used once on the same creature, item or location.
fr: Quand vous obtenez **13 ou plus** à un test réalisé pour enquêter sur une créature, un objet ou un lieu (y compris lorsque vous utilisez l’action **Analyse** lors d’un conflit), vous pouvez poser au meneur de jeu jusqu’à **【NC】** questions sur le sujet de votre investigation. Vous êtes libre de les poser immédiatement ou de les garder pour plus tard : chaque fois, le meneur de jeu répond sincèrement, et vous décrivez le processus de déduction de votre personnage. Cette compétence ne peut être utilisée qu’une fois par créature, objet ou lieu.
es: When you roll a **13 or higher** on a Check performed to investigate a creature, item or location — this includes using the **Study** action during a conflict — you may ask the Game Master up to 【**SL**】 questions concerning the subject of your investigation. You may ask these questions immediately or save them for later; whenever you ask one of these questions, the Game Master will answer truthfully and you will describe your character's deductive process. This Skill may only be used once on the same creature, item or location.
pt-BR: Quando você obtiver 13 ou mais em um Teste realizado para investigar uma criatura, item ou local — isso inclui usar a ação Estudar durante um conflito — você pode fazer ao Narrador do Jogo até 【NP】 perguntas relacionadas ao assunto de sua investigação. Você pode fazer essas perguntas imediatamente ou guardá-las para mais tarde; sempre que você fizer uma dessas perguntas, o Mestre do Jogo responderá com sinceridade e você descreverá o processo dedutivo do seu personagem. esse Poder só pode ser usado uma vez na mesma criatura, item ou local.

zh-CN: 当你对某个生物、物品或地点进行**调查**（包括在冲突场景中执行**调查**行动）并在检定中掷出**不低于13**的结果时，可以向游戏主持人提出数量至多为【**技能等级**】、且与**调查**对象有关的问题。你可以立即询问，也可以将提问的次数保留到之后使用。当你提问时，游戏主持人必须如实回答，而你则需要描述角色的推导过程。此技能对同一个生物、物品或地点只能使用一次。

en: At the start of a conflict, you may spend up to 【**SL × 5**】 Mind Points. For every 5 Mind Points you spend this way, choose one option: choose a creature you can see and the GM reveals one of their **Traits**; **or** name a damage type and choose a creature you can see, and the GM reveals that creature's **Affinity** towards that damage type.
it: All’inizio di un conflitto, puoi spendere fino a 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Mente. Per ogni 5 Punti Mente spesi in questo modo, scegli un’opzione: il Game Master ti rivela uno dei **Tratti** di una creatura a te visibile a tua scelta; **oppure** scegli una creatura a te visibile e il Game Master ti rivela l’**Affinità** di quella creatura a un tipo di danno a tua scelta.

fr: Au début d’un conflit, vous pouvez dépenser jusqu’à **【NC × 5】** Points de Magie. Pour chaque tranche de 5 Points de Magie dépensée de la sorte, choisissez une option : choisissez une créature que vous voyez et le MJ vous révèle l’un de ses **traits** ; **ou** nommez un type de dégâts et choisissez une créature que vous voyez, et le MJ révèle l’**affinité** de cette dernière envers le type choisi.

it: Ricordi perfettamente i dettagli di ogni scena a cui hai partecipato negli ultimi sette giorni. Puoi “tornare indietro nel tempo” all’interno della tua mente per esaminare e investigare queste scene (**Intuizione Fulminea** si applica anche a questi ricordi).

en:
You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform an Opposed 【**INS + WLP**】 Check against an enemy that can hear and understand you. If you succeed, that enemy loses 【**SL × 5**】 Mind Points, suffers a status effect of your choice between dazed and shaken, and all sources deal 【**SL**】 extra damage to them until the start of your next turn.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**INS + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 5 Punti Mente per effettuare un Test Contrapposto di  【**INT + VOL**】 contro una creatura in grado di sentirti e comprenderti (descrivi la tua accusa!). Se hai successo, il bersaglio perde 【**LA × 10**】 Punti Mente e subisce uno status a tua scelta tra **confuso** e **scosso**. Inoltre, ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai tuoi Test di 【**INT + VOL**】 per questa Abilità.

fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 5 Points de Magie pour effectuer un test d’ **【INT + VOL】** opposé contre une créature capable de vous entendre et de vous comprendre : décrivez vos accusations ! Si vous réussissez, la cible perd **【NC × 10】** Points de Magie et subit l’état **étourdi** ou **traumatisé** (c’est vous qui choisissez). Vous bénéficiez d’un bonus égal à votre **【NC】** au test d’ **【INT + VOL】** réalisé pour cette compétence.

You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**INS + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
zh-CN: 作为一次行动，你可以消耗5点精神值，对一个能听见并理解你的言语的敌人执行一次【**洞察+意志**】对抗检定。如果你成功，该敌人失去等同于【**技能等级×5**】的精神值，并被施加眩晕或动摇（由你选择），且直至你的下个回合开始，任何伤害来源对该敌人都会造成等同于【**技能等级**】的额外伤害。你为此技能进行的【**洞察+意志**】检定将获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。

en: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to choose an ally that can hear and understand you. That ally recovers 【**SL × 10**】 Hit Points and chooses **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**: they treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) until the start of your next turn.
it: Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere 5 Punti Mente per scegliere un’altra creatura in grado di sentirti e comprenderti. La creatura recupera 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Vita e sceglie **Destrezza, Intuito, Vigore** o **Volontà**. Fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, essa considera la Caratteristica scelta incrementata di una taglia di dado (massimo **d12**).
de: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to choose an ally that can hear and understand you. That ally recovers 【**SL × 10**】 Hit Points and chooses **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**: they treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) until the start of your next turn.
fr: Pendant un conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 5 Points de Magie pour choisir une autre créature capable de vous entendre et de vous comprendre. Elle récupère **【NC × 5】** Points de Vie et choisit entre **Dextérité**, **Intuition**, **Puissance** et **Volonté** : elle fait comme si la taille de dé de l’attribut était supérieure d’un cran (pour un maximum de **d12**) jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.
es: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to choose an ally that can hear and understand you. That ally recovers 【**SL × 10**】 Hit Points and chooses **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**: they treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) until the start of your next turn.

Esse aliado recupera 【**NP × 10**】 Pontos de Vida e escolhe **Destreza**, **Astúcia**, **Vigor** ou **Vontade**: o dado do Atributo escolhido é considerado um tamanho maior (até o máximo de d12) até o início do seu próximo turno.
ru: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to choose an ally that can hear and understand you. That ally recovers 【**SL × 10**】 Hit Points and chooses **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**: they treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) until the start of your next turn.

zh-CN: 作为一次行动，你可以消耗5点精神值，然后选择一个能听见并理解你的言语的盟友。该盟友恢复等同于【**技能等级×10**】的生命值，然后他在**敏捷**、**洞察**、**力量**和**意志**中选择其一，在你的下个回合开始前，他所选属性的骰子等级视为比原本高一级（最多可提升至d12）。

en: After another Player Character who is able to hear you performs a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and invoke one of their **Traits** or **Bonds** in order to let them reroll dice or improve the Result of the Check (following the normal rules). Then, if you have a **Bond** towards that character, they recover【**SL × 10**】Mind Points.
it: Dopo che un altro PG in grado di sentirti effettua un Test, puoi spendere 1 Punto Fabula e invocare uno dei suoi **Tratti** o **Legami** per dargli la possibilità di ritirare i dadi o aumentare il Risultato del Test (come da regole standard). Poi, se hai un **Legame** verso quel personaggio, questi recupera 【**LA × 10**】 Punti Mente.
de: After another Player Character who is able to hear you performs a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and invoke one of their **Traits** or **Bonds** in order to let them reroll dice or improve the Result of the Check (following the normal rules). Then, if you have a **Bond** towards that character, they recover【**SL × 10**】Mind Points.
fr: Après qu’un personnage joueur capable de vous entendre a effectué un test, vous pouvez dépenser 1 Point Fabula et invoquer l’un de ses traits ou de ses liens pour lui permettre de relancer des dés ou d’améliorer le résultat de son test (conformément aux règles habituelles). Ensuite, si vous avez un **lien** avec ce personnage, il récupère **【NC × 10】** Points de Magie.
es: After another Player Character who is able to hear you performs a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and invoke one of their **Traits** or **Bonds** in order to let them reroll dice or improve the Result of the Check (following the normal rules). Então, se você tiver um vínculo com esse personagem, ele recupera 【NP × 10】 Pontos Mentais.

zh-CN: 当另一个能听见你的言语的玩家角色进行检定后，你可以消耗1点物语点并援用该角色的一项**特质**或**羁绊**，使其能够重掷骰子或提升检定结算值（遵循常规规则）。随后，如果你对该角色存在**羁绊**，那么该角色还将恢复等同于【**技能等级×10**】的精神值。

en: When you successfully perform a Check to fill or erase sections of a Clock, if your approach relied on **charm**, **diplomacy**, **deception**, or **intimidation**, you may spend up to【**SL × 20**】Mind Points. If you do, fill or erase an additional section of that Clock for every 20 Mind Points you spend this way.
it: Quando hai successo su un Test per riempire o svuotare un Orologio, se il tuo approccio si basava su **diplomazia, fascino, inganno** o **intimidazione**, puoi spendere fino a 【**LA × 20**】 Punti Mente. Se lo fai, riempi o svuota una sezione aggiuntiva di quell’Orologio per ogni 20 Punti Mente spesi in questo modo.
de: When you successfully perform a Check to fill or erase sections of a Clock, if your approach relied on **charm**, **diplomacy**, **deception**, or **intimidation**, you may spend up to【**SL × 20**】Mind Points. If you do, fill or erase an additional section of that Clock for every 20 Mind Points you spend this way.
fr: Quand vous réussissez un test pour remplir ou effacer des sections d’un Cadran, si votre approche relève du **charme**, de la **diplomatie**, de la **tromperie** ou de l’**intimidation**, vous pouvez dépenser jusqu’à **【NC × 20】** Points de Magie. Ensuite, remplissez ou effacez une section du même Cadran pour chaque tranche de 20 PM dépensée de la sorte.
es: When you successfully perform a Check to fill or erase sections of a Clock, if your approach relied on **charm**, **diplomacy**, **deception**, or **intimidation**, you may spend up to【**SL × 20**】Mind Points. If you do, fill or erase an additional section of that Clock for every 20 Mind Points you spend this way.
pt-BR: Quando você realiza com sucesso um Teste para preencher ou apagar seções de um Relógio, se sua abordagem depende de charme, diplomacia, engano ou intimidação, você pode gastar até 【NP × 20】 Pontos Mentais. Se fizer isso, preencha ou apague uma seção adicional desse Relógio para cada 20 Pontos Mentais gastos dessa maneira.

zh-CN: 当你成功进行检定，并在命刻上填充或擦除一格时，若你使用的方法依赖于**魅力**、**交涉**、**欺骗**或**威胁**，便可以消耗至多等同于【**技能等级×20**】的精神值。如果你这样做，那么你每以此方式消耗20点精神值，便可在命刻上额外填充或擦除一格。

en: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to choose a **non-hostile** creature able to hear and understand you. If you do, that creature becomes helpful towards you so long as you are kind and respectful to them and your requests are reasonable.
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 1 Punto Fabula per scegliere una creatura **non ostile** in grado di sentirti e comprenderti. Se lo fai, la creatura sarà disposta ad aiutarti finché ti comporti con gentilezza e rispetto e le tue richieste sono ragionevoli.
de: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to choose a **non-hostile** creature able to hear and understand you. If you do, that creature becomes helpful towards you so long as you are kind and respectful to them and your requests are reasonable.
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 1 Point Fabula pour choisir une créature **non hostile** capable de vous entendre et de vous comprendre. Elle vous aide désormais tant que vous demeurez bienveillant et respectueux envers elle et que vos demandes restent raisonnables.
es: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to choose a **non-hostile** creature able to hear and understand you. If you do, that creature becomes helpful towards you so long as you are kind and respectful to them and your requests are reasonable.
pt-BR: Você pode usar uma ação e gastar 1 Ponto de Fabula para escolher uma criatura não hostil, capaz de ouvir e entender você. Se você fizer isso, essa criatura se tornará útil para você, desde que você seja gentil e respeitoso com ela e seus pedidos sejam razoáveis.
ru: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to choose a **non-hostile** creature able to hear and understand you. If you do, that creature becomes helpful towards you so long as you are kind and respectful to them and your requests are reasonable.

en: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack **only** targeted that creature and they are suffering from **one or more status effects**, you may have it deal extra damage equal to【**SL + the number of status effects on the creature**】.
it: Quando colpisci una creatura con un attacco, se quell’attacco bersagliava **soltanto** quella creatura ed essa è afflitta da **uno o più status**, puoi far sì che l’attacco infligga danni extra pari a 【**LA + il numero di status presenti sulla creatura**】.
de: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack **only** targeted that creature and they are suffering from **one or more status effects**, you may have it deal extra damage equal to【**SL + the number of status effects on the creature**】.
fr: Quand une de vos attaques touche une créature, s’il s’agissait de la **seule** créature visée et si elle est sous l’effet d’au moins **un état**, vous pouvez lui infliger des dégâts supplémentaires égaux à **【NC + nombres d’états dont la créature est victime】**.
es: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack **only** targeted that creature and they are suffering from **one or more status effects**, you may have it deal extra damage equal to【**SL + the number of status effects on the creature**】.
pt-BR: Quando você atinge uma criatura com um ataque, se o ataque tiver como alvo apenas aquela criatura e ela estiver sofrendo um ou mais efeitos de status, você poderá causar dano extra igual a 【NP + o número de efeitos de status na criatura】.
ru: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack **only** targeted that creature and they are suffering from **one or more status effects**, you may have it deal extra damage equal to【**SL + the number of status effects on the creature**】.
pl: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack **only** targeted that creature and they are suffering from **one or more status effects**, you may have it deal extra damage equal to【**SL + the number of status effects on the creature**】.

en: As long as you have no **shields** and no **martial armor** equipped, your Defense score is increased by【**SL**】.
it: Finché non hai **armature marziali** né **scudi** equipaggiati, il tuo punteggio di Difesa viene aumentato di 【**LA**】.
de: As long as you have no **shields** and no **martial armor** equipped, your Defense score is increased by【**SL**】.
fr: Tant que vous n’êtes équipé ni de **boucliers** ni d’une **armure martiale**, le **【NC】** s’ajoute à votre valeur de Défense.
es: As long as you have no **shields** and no **martial armor** equipped, your Defense score is increased by【**SL**】.
pt-BR: Contanto que você não tenha escudos e nenhuma armadura marcial equipada, sua pontuação de Defesa será aumentada em 【NP】.

en: At the start of a conflict, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option and apply it before the start of the first round: perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; **or** perform a **Hinder** or **Objective** action. You also gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Checks you perform as part of the chosen option.

Se lo fai, scegli un’opzione e applicala prima dell’inizio del primo round: esegui un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata; oppure esegui un’azione di **Intralcio** o **Obiettivo**. Inoltre, ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai Test che effettui come parte dell’opzione scelta.

Vous bénéficiez en outre d’un bonus égal à **【NC】** à tous les tests que vous effectuez dans le cadre de l’option choisie.

Você também ganha um bônus igual a 【NP】 para todos os Testes realizados como parte da opção escolhida.

zh-CN: 你可以在冲突开始时消耗10点精神值。如果你这样做，便可在第一轮开始前从以下选项中选择一项：使用你正装备的一件武器进行一次**顺势攻击**；**或**执行一次类型为**妨碍或推进目标**的顺势行动。你在执行上述选项时进行的检定都将获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。

en: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a **different** scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 1 Punto Fabula per sparire dalla scena in corso, riapparendo dovunque tu voglia in una scena **diversa** in cui sia presente un altro Personaggio Giocante. Descrivi come sei fuggito e miracolosamente finito qui!
de: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a **different** scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 1 Point Fabula pour disparaître de la scène en cours, et réapparaître quand vous voulez durant une scène **différente** où un autre personnage joueur est présent. Décrivez comment vous vous êtes échappé et avez miraculeusement réussi à vous rendre là-bas !
es: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a **different** scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!
pt-BR: Você pode usar uma ação e gastar 1 Ponto Fabula para desaparecer da cena atual, reaparecendo sempre que quiser durante uma cena diferente na qual outro Personagem Jogador esteja presente. Descreva como você escapou e milagrosamente chegou aqui!
ru: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a **different** scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!
pl: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a **different** scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!
zh-CN: 作为一次行动，你可以消耗1点物语点，使自己从当前场景中消失，随后在你所期望的任意时刻重新现身于有**其他**玩家角色在场的**其他**场景中。接下来请描述你是如何逃脱并如何奇迹般地来到此处的！

en:
During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a 【**DEX + WLP**】 Check against the Magic Defense of an enemy you can see. If you succeed and the target is a **soldier**, you regain 【**SL**】 Inventory Points; if they are an **elite** or **champion**, the GM gives you their
soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit **equal to or lower than 【the target’s level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】**. This **soul treasure** appears in your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**DEX + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
it: Puoi usare un’azione per effettuare un Test di 【**DES + VOL**】 contro la Difesa Magica di una creatura a te visibile. Se hai successo e il bersaglio è di rango **soldato**, ricarichi 【**LA**】 Punti Inventario; se invece è di rango **élite** o **campione**, il Game Master ti consegna il suo **tesoro spirituale**, un oggetto dal valore in zenit **pari o inferiore a** 【**il livello del bersaglio moltiplicato per 30, o per 50 se è un Cattivo**】. Questo **tesoro spirituale** appare nel tuo **zaino**; una creatura può essere derubata con successo da questa Abilità soltanto una volta. Inoltre, ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai tuoi Test di 【**DES + VOL**】 per questa Abilità.
de:
During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a 【**DEX + WLP**】 Check against the Magic Defense of an enemy you can see. If you succeed and the target is a **soldier**, you regain 【**SL**】 Inventory Points; if they are an **elite** or **champion**, the GM gives you their
soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit **equal to or lower than 【the target’s level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】**. This **soul treasure** appears in your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**DEX + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action pour effectuer un test de **【DEX + VOL】** contre la Défense magique d’une créature que vous voyez. Si vous réussissez et si la cible est un **soldat**, vous récupérez **【NC】** Points d’Inventaire. S’il s’agit d’un personnage d’**élite** ou d’un **champion**, le MJ vous donne le **trésor spirituel** de la cible, un objet valant une quantité de zénits **inférieure ou égale à 【niveau de la cible × 30, ou 50 si c’est un Méchant】**. Ce **trésor spirituel** apparaît dans votre **sac à dos** ; on ne peut détrousser une même créature à l’aide de cette compétence qu’une fois. Vous bénéficiez d’un bonus égal au **【NC】** à vos tests de **【DEX + VOL】** pour cette compétence.
es:
During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a 【**DEX + WLP**】 Check against the Magic Defense of an enemy you can see. If you succeed and the target is a **soldier**, you regain 【**SL**】 Inventory Points; if they are an **elite** or **champion**, the GM gives you their
soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit **equal to or lower than 【the target’s level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】**. This **soul treasure** appears in your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**DEX + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
pt-BR:
Durante um conflito, você pode usar uma ação para realizar um Teste de 【**DES + VON**】 contra a Defesa Mágica de um inimigo que você possa ver. Se obtiver sucesso e o alvo for um **soldado**, você recupera 【**NP**】 Pontos de Inventário; se ele for um **elite** ou **campeão**, o Narrador lhe concede o tesouro de alma dele, um item que vale uma quantia de zenit **igual ou inferior a 【o nível do alvo multiplicado por 30, ou por 50 se ele for um Vilão】**. Esse **tesouro de alma** aparece em sua mochila; uma criatura só pode ser roubada com sucesso por meio deste Poder uma vez.
Você recebe um bônus igual a 【**NP**】 em seus Testes de 【**DES + VON**】 para este Poder.
ru:
During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a 【**DEX + WLP**】 Check against the Magic Defense of an enemy you can see. If you succeed and the target is a **soldier**, you regain 【**SL**】 Inventory Points; if they are an **elite** or **champion**, the GM gives you their
soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit **equal to or lower than 【the target’s level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】**. This **soul treasure** appears in your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**DEX + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.

soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit **equal to or lower than 【the target’s level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】**. This **soul treasure** appears in your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
You gain a bonus equal to 【**SL**】 to your 【**DEX + WLP**】 Checks for this Skill.
zh-CN: 在冲突场景中，作为一次行动，你可以选择一个你能看见的敌人，随后执行一次针对对方魔防的**【敏捷+意志】**检定。在检定成功的情况下，如果目标的阶级是**小兵**，你恢复等同于**【技能等级】**的物资点；如果目标的阶级是**精英**或**大将**，那么游戏主持人将给予你该目标的**灵魂宝藏**，这是一件物品，其金币价值不高于**【目标等级×30】**（如果目标是反派则改为×50）。**灵魂宝藏**会直接出现在你的背包内。一个生物至多只能被此技能成功窃取一次。你为此技能进行的**【敏捷+意志】**检定将获得等同于**【技能等级】**的修正值。

en: When you perform a **ranged** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.

zh-CN: 你可以在进行**远程**攻击时消耗10点精神值，并从以下选项中选择一项：此次攻击获得**多重攻击（2）**；**或**此次攻击的**多重攻击**可选目标数量加1，最多可提升至**多重攻击（3）**。

en: After a creature you can see performs a **ranged** attack, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to 【**5 + the Result of their Accuracy Check**】 to have the attack automatically miss all targets. You can only use this Skill if you have a **ranged** weapon equipped, and it has no effect if the Accuracy Check was a **critical success**.
it: Dopo che una creatura a te visibile esegue un attacco a **distanza**, puoi spendere un ammontare di Punti Mente pari al Risultato del suo Test di Precisione per far sì che l’attacco manchi tutti i bersagli. Puoi usare questa Abilità solo se hai un’arma a **distanza** equipaggiata, ma non ha effetto se il Test di Precisione era un **successo critico**.
de: After a creature you can see performs a **ranged** attack, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to 【**5 + the Result of their Accuracy Check**】 to have the attack automatically miss all targets. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cette compétence que si vous êtes équipé d’une arme **à distance**, et elle ne fonctionne pas contre une **réussite critique** au test de précision.

Você só pode usar este Poder se tiver uma arma **à distância** equipada, e ele não tem efeito se o Teste de Precisão tiver sido um **sucesso crítico**.

zh-CN: 当一个你能看见的生物进行**远程**攻击后，你可以消耗等同于**【5+此次命中检定结算值】**的精神值，使得此次命中检定自动失败，所有目标都不会被命中。你只能在装备**远程**武器时使用此技能。此外，如果此次命中检定掷出**大成功**，则此技能不会生效。

en: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: the next **ranged** attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage; **or** you may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **bow** or **firearm** you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
it: Quando esegui l’azione di **Guardia**, se scegli di **non** coprire un’altra creatura, puoi scegliere un’opzione: il prossimo attacco a **distanza** che esegui prima del termine della scena corrente infligge 【**LA × 3**】 danni extra; **oppure** puoi eseguire immediatamente un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata della Categoria **arco** o **da fuoco**, considerando il tuo **Tiro Maggiore TM** pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno inflitto da questo attacco.
de: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: the next **ranged** attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage; **or** you may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **bow** or **firearm** you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
fr: Quand vous effectuez l’action **Garde**, si vous décidez de **ne pas** couvrir une autre créature, vous pouvez choisir une option : la prochaine attaque **à distance** que vous effectuez avant la fin de la scène en cours inflige **【NC × 3】** dégâts supplémentaires, **ou** vous pouvez immédiatement effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec un **arc** ou une **arme à feu** dont vous êtes équipé, en considérant que votre **valeur haute 【VH】** est égale à 0 pour calculer les dégâts infligés.
es: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: the next **ranged** attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage; **or** you may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **bow** or **firearm** you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.

ru: When you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose **not** to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: the next **ranged** attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage; **or** you may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **bow** or **firearm** you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.

zh-CN: 如果你在执行**防御**行动时选择**不**为其他生物提供掩护，便可从以下选项中选择一项：你在本场景中的下一次**远程**攻击将造成等同于【**技能等级×3**】的额外伤害；**或**你可以使用当前装备的一件**弓类或枪械类**武器进行一次**顺势攻击**，此次攻击在计算伤害时**高值**视为0。

If you do, choose one option: inflict **shaken** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **slow** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!

Se lo fai, scegli un’opzione: infliggi lo status **lento** a ciascun bersaglio colpito; **oppure** infliggi lo status **scosso** a ciascun bersaglio colpito; **oppure** ciascun bersaglio colpito perde 【**LA × 10**】 Punti Mente.

fr: Quand vous touchez une ou plusieurs cibles avec une attaque **à distance** qui leur inflige des dégâts, vous pouvez renoncer aux dégâts en question. Décrivez votre manœuvre !

zh-CN: 当你的**远程**攻击命中目标并即将造成伤害时，可以选择让此次攻击不造成伤害。如果你这样做，便可从以下选项中选择一项：对此次攻击命中的每个目标施加**动摇**；**或**对此次攻击命中的每个目标施加**迟缓**；**或**使此次攻击命中的每个目标均失去【**技能等级×10**】的精神值。然后请描述你的招式动作！

en:
When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may have each of those allies recover an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**3 + (SL, multiplied by the number of Bonds you have)**】.
This healing is separate from any healing caused by the effects of the spell.
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo che bersaglia uno o più alleati, se hai un’arma **arcana** equipaggiata, puoi far sì che ciascuno di quegli alleati recuperi un ammontare di Punti Vita pari a 【**LA moltiplicato per il numero di Legami che possiedi**】. Questo effetto di recupero è separato da quelli causati dall’incantesimo (se presenti).

Essa cura é separada de qualquer cura causada pelos efeitos do Feitiço.

en: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Spiritism** discipline. Spiritism Rituals use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
it: Puoi eseguire Rituali i cui effetti rientrino nella disciplina di **Spiritismo**. I Rituali di Spiritismo utilizzano 【**INT + VOL**】 per il Test di Magia.
de: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the **Spiritism** discipline. Spiritism Rituals use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
fr: Vous pouvez réaliser des rituels dont les effets relèvent de la discipline **Spiritisme**. Le test de magie des rituels de Spiritisme utilise **【INT + VOL】** .

en: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell. Offensive (⚡) Spiritist spells use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
it: Ogni volta che acquisisci questa Abilità, impari un incantesimo da Spiritista. Gli incantesimi offensivi (⚡) da Spiritista utilizzano 【**INT + VOL**】 per il Test di Magia.
de: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell. Offensive (⚡) Spiritist spells use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
fr: Chaque fois que vous obtenez cette compétence, vous apprenez un sort de Spirite. Le test de magie des sorts de Spirite offensifs (⚡) utilise **【INT + VOL】** .
es: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell. Offensive (⚡) Spiritist spells use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.
pt-BR: Cada vez que você adquirir esse Poder, aprenda um feitiço Espiritualista. Os feitiços espiritualistas ofensivos (⚡) utilizam 【INT+ VON】 para a Verificação Mágica.
ru: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell. Offensive (⚡) Spiritist spells use【**INS + WLP**】for the Magic Check.

zh-CN: 每当你习得此技能时，便可学会一个御魂使法术（见后续两页）。御魂使的攻击性法术（OO）使用【**洞察+意志**】进行施法检定。

en: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a **Bond** towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the **strength** of your Bond towards them.
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo che bersaglia uno o più alleati, se hai un’arma **arcana** equipaggiata, puoi scegliere uno di quegli alleati con cui hai un **Legame**. Se lo fai, quell’alleato ottiene un bonus pari alla **forza** del tuo Legame con esso al prossimo Test che effettua nella scena corrente.
de: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a **Bond** towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the **strength** of your Bond towards them.
fr: Quand vous lancez un sort qui prend pour cible un ou plusieurs alliés, si vous êtes équipé d’une arme **arcanique**, vous pouvez choisir un de ces alliés vis-à-vis duquel vous avez un **lien**. Cet allié reçoit un bonus au prochain test qu’il effectue durant la scène en cours. Le bonus est égal à l’**intensité** du lien en question.
es: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a **Bond** towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the **strength** of your Bond towards them.
pt-BR: Quando você lança um feitiço que tem como alvo um ou mais aliados, se você tiver uma arma arcana equipada, você pode escolher um dos aliados com quem você tem um vínculo. Se você fizer isso, esse aliado ganhará um bônus no próximo Teste que realizar durante a cena atual; este bônus é igual à força do seu vínculo com eles.
ru: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a **Bond** towards. pl: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a **Bond** towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the **strength** of your Bond towards them.
zh-CN: 当你对一个或多个盟友施放法术时，如果你装备了**魔法类**武器，便可从法术目标中选择一个你对其具有**羁绊**的盟友。如果你这样做，该盟友在本场景的下一次检定中获得等同于【你对该盟友的**羁绊强度**】的修正值。

en: When you cast a spell, if you don’t have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**10 + the spell’s total MP cost**】 instead. If a spell cast this way would cause you to recover Hit Points, you instead recover no Hit Points (the spell functions normally on any other target).
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo, se non hai abbastanza Punti Mente da pagarne il costo totale, puoi invece decidere di spendere Punti Vita **pari al doppio del costo totale**. Non puoi usare questa Abilità se farlo ridurrebbe a 0 i tuoi Punti Vita. Se un incantesimo lanciato in questo modo ti consentirebbe di recuperare Punti Vita, invece non ne recuperi (l’incantesimo funziona normalmente su eventuali altri bersagli).
de: When you cast a spell, if you don’t have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**10 + the spell’s total MP cost**】 instead. If a spell cast this way would cause you to recover Hit Points, you instead recover no Hit Points (the spell functions normally on any other target).
fr: Quand vous lancez un sort, si vous n’avez pas assez de Points de Magie pour en payer le coût total, vous pouvez choisir de payer **le double en Points de Vie** à la place. Vous ne pouvez pas utiliser cette compétence si l’opération vous réduit à 0 Point de Vie. Si un sort lancé de cette façon est censé vous redonner des Points de Vie, il ne vous en octroie aucun (mais fonctionne normalement vis-à-vis des autres cibles).
es: When you cast a spell, if you don’t have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend an amount of Hit Points equal to 【**10 + the spell’s total MP cost**】 instead. If a spell cast this way would cause you to recover Hit Points, you instead recover no Hit Points (the spell functions normally on any other target).

Se um Feitiço conjurado dessa forma fizer com que você recupere Pontos de Vida, em vez disso você não recupera Pontos de Vida (o Feitiço funciona normalmente em qualquer outro alvo).

zh-CN: 当你施放法术时，如果你的精神值不足以支付该法术的总消耗，可以改为选择消耗等同于**【10+此次法术的精神值总消耗】**的生命值。如果以此方式施放的法术将会使你恢复生命值，改为你不恢复任何生命值（但法术效果对其他目标仍会正常生效）。

en: Once per conflict scene, if you are in **Crisis**, you may perform an additional action on your turn. This action **must** be the **Inventory** action.
it: Una volta per conflitto, se sei in **Crisi**, puoi eseguire un’azione aggiuntiva durante il tuo turno. Questa azione **deve** essere un’azione di **Inventario**.
de: Once per conflict scene, if you are in **Crisis**, you may perform an additional action on your turn. This action **must** be the **Inventory** action.
fr: Une fois par scène de conflit, si vous êtes en **Crise**, vous pouvez effectuer une action supplémentaire à votre tour de jeu. Il s’agit **forcément** de l’action **Inventaire**.
es: Once per conflict scene, if you are in **Crisis**, you may perform an additional action on your turn. This action **must** be the **Inventory** action.
pt-BR: Uma vez por cena de conflito, se você estiver em crise, você poderá realizar uma ação adicional no seu turno. Esta ação deve ser a ação Inventário.

zh-CN: 每个冲突场景限一次，如果你处于**危机状态**，你可以在自己的回合内执行一次额外行动。该行动**必须**是**消耗物资**行动。

en: When you first acquire this Skill, choose a gadget type: **alchemy**, **infusion**, or **magitech**. You gain its **basic benefits**. Whenever you take this Skill again, choose one option: you gain the **basic benefits** of a new gadget type; **or** you gain the **advanced benefits** of a gadget type whose **basic benefits** you already obtained; **or** you gain the **superior benefits** of a gadget type whose **advanced benefits** you already obtained.
it: Quando acquisisci questa Abilità per la prima volta, scegli un tipo di tecnologia: **alchimia, infusione** o **magitech**. Ne ottieni i **benefici base**. Ogni volta che acquisisci nuovamente questa Abilità, scegli un’opzione: ottieni i **benefici base** di un nuovo tipo di tecnologia; **oppure** ottieni i **benefici avanzati** di un tipo di tecnologia di cui hai già ottenuto i **benefici base**; **oppure** ottieni i **benefici** **superiori** di un tipo di tecnologia di cui hai già ottenuto i **benefici avanzati**.

Chaque fois que vous reprenez cette compétence, choisissez une option : vous obtenez les **atouts de base** d’un nouveau type de gadget, **ou** vous obtenez les **atouts avancés** d’un gadget dont vous possédez déjà les **atouts de base**, **ou** vous obtenez les **atouts supérieurs** d’un type de gadget dont vous possédez déjà les **atouts avancés**.

Sempre que adquirir esta Perícia novamente, escolha uma das opções a seguir: você recebe os benefícios básicos de um novo tipo de engenhoca; OU você recebe os benefícios avançados de um tipo de engenhoca cujos benefícios básicos você já obteve; OU você recebe os benefícios superiores de um tipo de engenhoca cujos benefícios avançados você já obteve.
