zh-CN: 当你首次习得此技能时，选择一种装置类型：**炼金装置**、**注魔**装置**或魔导装置**（见后续四页）。你将获得相应的**基础增益**。当你再次习得此技能时，从以下选项中选择一项：你获得新的装置类型的**基础增益**；**或**你在一项已有**基础增益**的装置类型上获得**进阶增益**；**或**你在一项已有**进阶增益**的装置类型上获得**顶级增益**。

en: When you create a **potion** that restores a **single** creature's HP and/or MP, you may have it affect up to【**SL**】additional creatures. If you do, the potion only restores half the normal amount of HP and MP to each creature.
it: Quando crei una **pozione** che fa recuperare PV e/o PM a una **singola** creatura, puoi applicarne gli effetti a fino a 【**LA**】 creature aggiuntive. Se lo fai, la pozione fa recuperare a ciascuna creatura metà del normale ammontare di PV e PM.
de: When you create a **potion** that restores a **single** creature's HP and/or MP, you may have it affect up to【**SL**】additional creatures. If you do, the potion only restores half the normal amount of HP and MP to each creature.
fr: Lorsque vous créez une **potion** restaurant les PV et/ou PM d’une **seule** créature, vous pouvez étendre ses effets à **【NC】** créatures supplémentaires. Dans ce cas, elle ne restaure que la moitié des PV et PM normaux pour chaque créature.

zh-CN: 当你制作出能为**单个**生物恢复生命值和/或精神值的**药剂**时，可以选择让它额外影响至多【**技能等级**】个生物。如果你这样做，此**药剂**为每个生物恢复的生命值和精神值将只有正常恢复量的一半。

en: When you create a **potion** or **magisphere** whose effects restore HP and/or MP, each restored amount is increased by【**SL × 5**】. When you create an **elemental shard**, **potion**, or **magisphere** that deals damage, that item deals【**SL**】extra damage.
it: Quando crei una **pozione** o **magisfera** che permette di recuperare PV e/o PM, ciascun effetto di recupero viene incrementato di 【**LA × 5**】. Quando crei una **scheggia elementale, pozione** o **magisfera** che infligge danno, quell’oggetto infligge 【**LA**】 danni extra.
de: When you create a **potion** or **magisphere** whose effects restore HP and/or MP, each restored amount is increased by【**SL × 5**】. When you create an **elemental shard**, **potion**, or **magisphere** that deals damage, that item deals【**SL**】extra damage.

Lorsque vous créez un **fragment élémentaire**, une **potion** ou une **magisphère** qui inflige des dégâts, cet objet inflige **【NC】** dégâts supplémentaires.

en: When you work on a **Project**, up to【**SL × 100**】zenit of material costs are automatically paid; additionally, you generate an additional【**SL**】**progress** every day. If multiple characters with this Skill work on the same Project, the effects will be cumulative.
it: Quando lavori a un **Progetto**, fino a 【**LA × 100**】 zenit di materiali vengono pagati automaticamente; inoltre, ogni giorno generi **progresso** addizionale pari a 【**LA**】. Se più personaggi con questa Abilità lavorano allo stesso Progetto, gli effetti sono cumulativi.

fr: Quand vous travaillez sur un **projet**, jusqu’à **【NC × 100】** zénits de coût de matériaux sont automatiquement payés. En outre, vous générez **【NC】 Points de Progression** en plus chaque jour. Si plusieurs personnages dotés de cette compétence travaillent sur le même projet, les effets se cumulent.

pt-BR: Quando você trabalha em um Projeto, até 【NP × 100】 zenit de custos de material são pagos automaticamente; além disso, você gera um progresso 【NP】 adicional todos os dias. Se vários personagens com esse Poder trabalharem no mesmo Projeto, os efeitos serão cumulativos.

en: Together with your group, create a **level 5 beast**, **construct**, **elemental** or **plant** NPC (see page **302**) that becomes your **companion**: this creature has **no initiative score** and **does not level up**, can have a **maximum of two basic attacks**, gains a bonus equal to【**SL**】to Accuracy Checks and Magic Checks, and their maximum Hit Points are equal to【**(SL, multiplied by the companion's base Might size) + half your level**】. Your companion doesn't get an independent turn during conflicts, but you can use an action to have them perform an action (once per turn). If your companion is affected by any **turn-related effects** (page **77**), these are based on **your** turn. Your companion joins and leaves scenes when you do, and gains your same benefits for **rests**. If reduced to 0 HP, your companion flees the scene and rejoins you at the start of the next scene in which you are present, with current HP equal to their **Crisis** score.
it: Insieme al resto del gruppo, crea il tuo **compagno**: una creatura di **livello 5** di Specie **bestia, costrutto, elementale** o **pianta**. La creatura **non ha punteggio di Iniziativa** e **non sale di livello**, può avere **fino a due attacchi base**, ottiene un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai Test di Precisione e di Magia, e possiede Punti Vita massimi pari a 【**(LA moltiplicato per la taglia base del dado di Vigore del compagno) + metà del tuo livello**】. Durante i conflitti, il tuo compagno non svolge un turno individuale, ma nel tuo turno puoi usare un’azione per fargli eseguire un’azione (solo una volta per turno). Se abbandoni una scena, il tuo compagno la abbandona insieme a te. Se il tuo compagno viene ridotto a 0 Punti Vita, fugge dalla scena e si ricongiunge con te all’inizio della prossima scena di cui fai parte, con PV pari al suo valore di **Crisi**. Quando **riposi**, anche il tuo compagno riceve tutti i benefici del riposo.

Your companion doesn't get an independent turn during conflicts, but you can use an action to have them perform an action (once per turn). fr: Vous et votre groupe concevez ensemble un PNJ de **niveau 5** et de type **bête**, **créature artificielle**, **élémentaire** ou **plante** (voir page **302**) qui devient votre **compagnon**. Cette créature n’a **pas de valeur d’initiative** et **ne gagne pas de niveau**. Elle peut avoir **jusqu’à deux attaques de base**, bénéficie d’un bonus égal à **【NC】** aux tests de précision et aux tests de magie, et son maximum de Points de Vie est égal à **【(NC × la taille de son dé de base de Puissance) + la moitié de votre niveau】** . Votre compagnon n'a pas de tour indépendant pendant les conflits, mais vous pouvez utiliser une action pour lui faire effectuer une action (une fois par tour). Si votre compagnon est affecté par des effets liés au tour (page **77**), ceux-ci sont basés sur votre tour. Votre compagnon rejoint et quitte les scènes en même temps que vous, et bénéficie des mêmes avantages pour les repos. S'il est réduit à 0 Point de Vie, votre compagnon fuit la scène et vous rejoint au début de la prochaine scène dans laquelle vous êtes présent, avec un nombre de PV égal à son score de **Crise**.

pt-BR: Junto com seu grupo, crie um PNJ besta, construto, elemental ou planta de nível 5 (ver página 302) que se torne seu companheiro: esta criatura não tem pontuação de iniciativa e não sobe de nível, pode ter no máximo dois ataques básicos, ganha um bônus igual a 【NP】 para testes de precisão e testes de magia, e seus pontos de vida máximos são iguais a 【(NP, multiplicado pelo tamanho de potência base do companheiro) + metade do seu nível】. Seu companheiro não tem um turno independente durante os conflitos, mas você pode usar uma ação para que ele execute uma ação (uma vez por turno). Se o seu companheiro for afetado por quaisquer efeitos relacionados ao turno (página 77), eles serão baseados no seu turno. Seu companheiro entra e sai das cenas quando você faz isso e ganha os mesmos benefícios para descanso. Se reduzido a 0 PV, seu companheiro foge da cena e se junta a você no início da próxima cena em que você estiver presente, com PV atual igual ao seu valor de Crise.

zh-CN: 与**你的**团友一同协作，创建一个**等级为5级、物种类型为野兽**、**构装体**、**元素**或**植物**的NPC（见第**302**页）作为**你的伙伴**。该生物**不具有先攻值**且**无法升级**；可以拥有**至多两种基础攻击**方式；在进行命中检定和施法检定时可获得等同于**【技能等级】**的修正值；它的最大生命值等同于**【（技能等级×伙伴的基础力量骰等级）+你的等级的一半】**。**你的伙伴**在冲突中不会获得独立的回合，但你可以将自己的行动改为让它执行一次行动（每个回合限一次）。如果**你的伙伴**受到**与回合相关的效果**影响（见第**77**页），那么这些效果的结束时机将以**你的**回合为准。**你的伙伴**会随你一起进入或离开场景，并会在**休息**时获得和你一样的收益。**你的伙伴**会在生命值归零时逃离场景，并在下一个你在场的场景开始时重新与你会合，它在与你会合时的生命值等同于它的**危机**值。

en: When you **rest** inside an inn or tavern, you may ask the Game Master up to【**SL**】questions about your surroundings and the people who live here; the Game Master will answer truthfully and you describe how you gathered the information.
it: Quando ti **riposi** in un ostello o taverna, puoi porre al Game Master fino a 【**LA**】 domande sui dintorni e sulle persone che ci vivono; il Game Master risponderà dicendo la verità e tu descriverai in che modo hai ottenuto queste informazioni.
de: When you **rest** inside an inn or tavern, you may ask the Game Master up to【**SL**】questions about your surroundings and the people who live here; the Game Master will answer truthfully and you describe how you gathered the information.
fr: Quand vous vous **reposez** dans une auberge ou une taverne, vous pouvez poser au meneur de jeu jusqu’à **【NC】** questions au sujet de votre environnement et des gens qui vivent là. Le meneur de jeu répond sincèrement, et vous décrivez comment vous avez rassemblé l’information.
es: When you **rest** inside an inn or tavern, you may ask the Game Master up to【**SL**】questions about your surroundings and the people who live here; the Game Master will answer truthfully and you describe how you gathered the information.
pt-BR: Quando você descansa dentro de uma pousada ou taverna, você pode fazer perguntas ao Narrador até 【NP】 sobre o seu entorno e as pessoas que vivem aqui; o Narrador responderá com sinceridade e você descreverá como reuniu as informações.
ru: When you **rest** inside an inn or tavern, you may ask the Game Master up to【**SL**】questions about your surroundings and the people who live here; the Game Master will answer truthfully and you describe how you gathered the information.
pl: When you **rest** inside an inn or tavern, you may ask the Game Master up to【**SL**】questions about your surroundings and the people who live here; the Game Master will answer truthfully and you describe how you gathered the information.
zh-CN: 当你在旅店或酒馆**休息**时，可以就周边地区和本地居民的情况向游戏主持人提问，问题的数量至多等同于【**技能等级**】。游戏主持人将如实回答，而你需要描述自己是通过怎样的方式收集情报的。

en: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a **discovery** on a roll of【**SL + 1**】**or lower** on the **travel roll** (instead of only on a **1**).
it: Quando il tuo gruppo viaggia sulla mappa del mondo, fate una **scoperta** con un esito **pari o inferiore a** 【**LA + 1**】 sul **tiro di viaggio** (anziché soltanto con **1**).
de: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a **discovery** on a roll of【**SL + 1**】**or lower** on the **travel roll** (instead of only on a **1**).
fr: Quand votre groupe voyage sur la carte du monde, vous faites une **découverte** sur un résultat de **【NC + 1】** ou moins au **test de voyage** (au lieu de seulement 1).
es: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a **discovery** on a roll of【**SL + 1**】**or lower** on the **travel roll** (instead of only on a **1**).
pt-BR: Quando seu grupo viajar no mapa mundial, você fará uma descoberta com um resultado de 【NP + 1】 ou inferior no teste de viagem (em vez de apenas 1).
ru: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a **discovery** on a roll of【**SL + 1**】**or lower** on the **travel roll** (instead of only on a **1**).
pl: When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a **discovery** on a roll of【**SL + 1**】**or lower** on the **travel roll** (instead of only on a **1**).
zh-CN: 当队伍在世界地图上旅行时，只要**旅行掷骰**的结果**不高于**【**技能等级+1**】（而非必须掷出**1**），便能触发**发现**。

en: You reduce the die rolled for your **travel rolls** by one size (to a minimum of **d6**). If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are **not** cumulative.
it: Riduci di una taglia il dado usato nei **tiri di viaggio** (minimo **d6**). Se due o più personaggi hanno questa Abilità, l’effetto **non è** cumulativo.
de: You reduce the die rolled for your **travel rolls** by one size (to a minimum of **d6**). If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are **not** cumulative.
fr: Vous réduisez d’un cran la taille du dé lancé pour les **tests de voyage** (minimum **d6**). Si plusieurs personnages disposent de cette compétence, les effets ne se cumulent **pas**.
es: You reduce the die rolled for your **travel rolls** by one size (to a minimum of **d6**). If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are **not** cumulative.
pt-BR: Você reduz o dado rolado para suas jogadas de viagem em um tamanho (até um mínimo de d6). Se vários personagens possuírem esse Poder, os efeitos não são cumulativos.
ru: You reduce the die rolled for your **travel rolls** by one size (to a minimum of **d6**). If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are **not** cumulative.
pl: You reduce the die rolled for your **travel rolls** by one size (to a minimum of **d6**). If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are **not** cumulative.
zh-CN: 在进行**旅行掷骰**时，所用的骰子等级降低一级（至多降至**d6**）。如果多个角色拥有此技能，效果**不**会叠加。

en: When you perform a **melee** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.
it: Quando esegui un attacco in **mischia**, puoi spendere 10 Punti Mente per scegliere un’opzione: l’attacco ottiene **multi (2); oppure** aumenti la proprietà **multi** dell’attacco di un punto, fino a un massimo di **multi (3)**.
de: When you perform a **melee** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.
fr: Quand vous effectuez une attaque de **corps à corps**, vous pouvez dépenser 10 Points de Magie pour choisir une option : l’attaque gagne la propriété **multi (2)**, ou vous ajoutez 1 au niveau de **multi** de l’attaque, jusqu’à un maximum de **multi (3)**.
es: When you perform a **melee** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.
pt-BR: Ao realizar um ataque corpo a corpo, você pode gastar 10 PM para escolher uma opção: o ataque ganha multi (2); OU você aumenta a propriedade múltipla do ataque em um, até um máximo de multi (3).
ru: When you perform a **melee** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.
pl: When you perform a **melee** attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains **multi (2)**; **or** you increase the attack's **multi** property by one, up to a maximum of **multi (3)**.
zh-CN: 你可以在进行**近战**攻击时消耗10点精神值，并从以下选项中选择一项：此次攻击获得**多重攻击（2）**；**或**此次攻击的**多重攻击**可选目标数量加1，最多可提升至**多重攻击（3）**。

en: When you hit one or more targets with a **melee** attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict **dazed** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **weak** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
it: Quando colpisci uno o più bersagli con un attacco in **mischia** che infliggerebbe danno, puoi invece decidere di non infliggere danno. Se lo fai, scegli un’opzione: infliggi lo status **confuso** a ciascun bersaglio colpito; **oppure** infliggi lo status **debole** a ciascun bersaglio colpito; **oppure** ciascun bersaglio colpito perde 【**LA × 10**】 Punti Mente.
de: When you hit one or more targets with a **melee** attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict **dazed** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **weak** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
fr: Quand vous touchez une ou plusieurs cibles avec une attaque de **corps à corps** qui leur inflige des dégâts, vous pouvez renoncer aux dégâts en question. Dans ce cas, choisissez une option : infligez l’état **étourdi** à chaque cible touchée par l’attaque, **ou** infligez l’état **affaibli** à chaque cible touchée par l’attaque, **ou** chaque cible touchée par l’attaque perd **【NC × 10】** Points de Magie. Décrivez votre manœuvre !
es: When you hit one or more targets with a **melee** attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict **dazed** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **weak** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
pt-BR: Quando você atinge um ou mais alvos com um ataque corpo a corpo que causaria dano, você pode fazer com que o ataque não cause dano. Se fizer isso, escolha uma opção: inflija atordoamento em cada alvo atingido pelo ataque; OU inflija fraqueza em cada alvo atingido pelo ataque; OU cada alvo atingido pelo ataque perde 【NP × 10】 Pontos Mentais. Descreva sua manobra!
ru: When you hit one or more targets with a **melee** attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict **dazed** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **weak** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
pl: When you hit one or more targets with a **melee** attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict **dazed** on each target hit by the attack; **or** inflict **weak** on each target hit by the attack; **or** each target hit by the attack loses【**SL × 10**】Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
zh-CN: 当你用**近战**攻击命中目标并即将造成伤害时，可以选择让本次攻击不造成伤害。如果你这样做，便可从以下选项中选择一项：对本次攻击命中的每个目标施加**眩晕**；**或**对本次攻击命中的每个目标施加**虚弱**；**或**令本次攻击命中的每个目标各失去【**技能等级×10**】的精神值。然后请描述你的招式动作！

en: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single creature**. If the attack is successful, it deals no damage and you choose one option: you destroy one shield equipped by the target; **or** you destroy the target’s equipped armor; **or** all sources deal 【**SL × 2**】 extra damage to the target until the start of your next turn.
it: Puoi usare un’azione e spendere 5 Punti Mente per eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma da **mischia** equipaggiata. L’attacco deve bersagliare una **singola** creatura. Se ha successo, non infligge danno e scegli un’opzione: distruggi uno scudo equipaggiato dal bersaglio; **oppure** distruggi l’armatura equipaggiata dal bersaglio; **oppure** ogni volta che il bersaglio subisce danni da una qualsiasi fonte prima dell’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, quella fonte gli infligge 【**LA × 2**】 danni extra.
de: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single creature**. If the attack is successful, it deals no damage and you choose one option: you destroy one shield equipped by the target; **or** you destroy the target’s equipped armor; **or** all sources deal 【**SL × 2**】 extra damage to the target until the start of your next turn.
fr: Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 5 Points de Magie pour effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme de **corps à corps** dont vous êtes équipé. Cette attaque doit viser **une seule créature**. En cas de réussite, elle n’inflige pas de dégâts, mais vous choisissez une option : vous détruisez un bouclier dont la cible est équipée ; **ou** vous détruisez l’armure dont la cible est équipée ; **ou** chaque fois que la cible subit des dégâts, quelle qu’en soit la source, avant le début de votre prochain tour, cette source lui inflige **【NC × 2】** dégâts supplémentaires.
es: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single creature**. If the attack is successful, it deals no damage and you choose one option: you destroy one shield equipped by the target; **or** you destroy the target’s equipped armor; **or** all sources deal 【**SL × 2**】 extra damage to the target until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Você pode usar uma ação e gastar 5 PM para realizar um ataque livre com uma arma corpo a corpo que você tenha equipado. Este ataque deve ter como alvo uma única criatura. Se o ataque for bem sucedido, ele não causa dano e você escolhe uma opção: você destrói um escudo equipado pelo alvo; OU você destrói a armadura equipada do alvo; OU sempre que o alvo sofrer dano de uma fonte antes do início do seu próximo turno, essa fonte causa 【NP × 2】 de dano extra a ele.
ru: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single creature**. If the attack is successful, it deals no damage and you choose one option: you destroy one shield equipped by the target; **or** you destroy the target’s equipped armor; **or** all sources deal 【**SL × 2**】 extra damage to the target until the start of your next turn.
pl: You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single creature**. If the attack is successful, it deals no damage and you choose one option: you destroy one shield equipped by the target; **or** you destroy the target’s equipped armor; **or** all sources deal 【**SL × 2**】 extra damage to the target until the start of your next turn.
zh-CN: 作为一次行动，你可以消耗5点精神值，使用当前装备的一件**近战**武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。此次攻击只能以**单个生物**为目标。如果本次攻击命中，将不会造成伤害，然后你需要从以下选项中选择一项：你摧毁目标装备的一个盾牌；**或**你摧毁目标装备的一件防具；**或**直至你的下个回合开始，任何伤害来源对该敌人均造成等同于【**技能等级×2**】的额外伤害。

en: After an enemy **hits or misses you with a melee attack**, if the Result of their Accuracy Check was an **even number**, you may perform a **free attack** against that enemy (after their attack has been fully resolved). This attack must be a **melee attack** and must have that enemy as its **only** target; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
it: Dopo che un nemico **ti colpisce o ti manca con un attacco in mischia**, se il Risultato del suo Test di Precisione è un **numero pari**, puoi eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma da **mischia** equipaggiata contro quel nemico (dopo che il suo attacco è stato risolto). Questo attacco può bersagliare **solamente** quel nemico; considera il tuo **Tiro Maggiore (TM)** pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno inflitto da questo attacco.
de: After an enemy **hits or misses you with a melee attack**, if the Result of their Accuracy Check was an **even number**, you may perform a **free attack** against that enemy (after their attack has been fully resolved). This attack must be a **melee attack** and must have that enemy as its **only** target; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
fr: Après qu’un **ennemi vous touche ou vous rate avec une attaque de corps à corps**, si le résultat de son test de précision était un **nombre pair**, vous pouvez réaliser une **attaque gratuite** contre lui (après la résolution de la sienne). Il doit s’agit d’une attaque de **corps à corps**, qui prend **uniquement** pour cible l’ennemi ; traitez votre **valeur haute 【VH】** comme s’il s’agissait de 0 lorsque vous en calculez les dégâts.
es: After an enemy **hits or misses you with a melee attack**, if the Result of their Accuracy Check was an **even number**, you may perform a **free attack** against that enemy (after their attack has been fully resolved). This attack must be a **melee attack** and must have that enemy as its **only** target; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
pt-BR: Depois que um inimigo acertar ou errar você em um ataque corpo a corpo, se o resultado da verificação de precisão for um número par, você poderá realizar um ataque livre contra esse inimigo (depois que o ataque dele tiver sido totalmente resolvido). Este ataque deve ser um ataque corpo a corpo e deve ter aquele inimigo como único alvo; trate sua Rolagem Alta (RA) como 0 ao calcular o dano causado por este ataque.
ru: After an enemy **hits or misses you with a melee attack**, if the Result of their Accuracy Check was an **even number**, you may perform a **free attack** against that enemy (after their attack has been fully resolved). This attack must be a **melee attack** and must have that enemy as its **only** target; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
pl: After an enemy **hits or misses you with a melee attack**, if the Result of their Accuracy Check was an **even number**, you may perform a **free attack** against that enemy (after their attack has been fully resolved). This attack must be a **melee attack** and must have that enemy as its **only** target; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
zh-CN: 当一个敌人**对你进行近战攻击后，无论此次攻击是否命中**，如果命中检定的结算值是**偶数**，你便可以在此次攻击结算完毕后，对该敌人进行一次**顺势攻击**。你的**顺势攻击**必须是**近战攻击**，且必须将这名敌人作为唯一目标。此次攻击在计算伤害时**高值**视为0。

fr: Maîtrise des Armes de Corps À Corps

en: You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Accuracy Checks with **melee** weapons.
it: Ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 a tutti i Test di Precisione con armi da **mischia**.
de: You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Accuracy Checks with **melee** weapons.
fr: Vous bénéficiez d’un bonus de **【NC】** à tous les tests de précision effectués avec des armes de **corps à corps**.
es: You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Accuracy Checks with **melee** weapons.
pt-BR: Você ganha um bônus igual a 【NP】 em todas as verificações de precisão com armas brancas.
ru: You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Accuracy Checks with **melee** weapons.
pl: You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to all Accuracy Checks with **melee** weapons.
zh-CN: 你使用**近战**武器进行的所有命中检定均获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。

en: Before you perform a Check, you may declare **double or nothing**. If you do, until the end of that Check, any dice you roll that show an **even** number are treated as if that number was **doubled**, and other dice you roll are treated as showing a **1**.
it: Prima di effettuare un Test di Precisione, un Test di Magia per un incantesimo offensivo (⚡) o un Test per riempire o svuotare sezioni di Orologio, puoi dichiarare **lascia o raddoppia**. Se lo fai e il Test genera un **successo critico**, **raddoppia** il danno inflitto dall'attacco o incantesimo o le sezioni riempite o svuotate dal Test, rispettivamente; tuttavia, qualsiasi altro tipo di successo diventa invece un **fallimento**.
de: Before you perform a Check, you may declare **double or nothing**. If you do, until the end of that Check, any dice you roll that show an **even** number are treated as if that number was **doubled**, and other dice you roll are treated as showing a **1**.
fr: Avant d'effectuer un test de précision, un test de magie pour un sort offensif (⚡) ou un test pour avancer ou reculer un Cadran, vous pouvez déclarer **quitte ou double**. Si vous le faites et que vous obtenez une **réussite critique** au test, **doublez** les dégâts infligés par l'attaque ou le sort, ou les sections remplies ou effacées du Cadran, respectivement ; cependant, tout autre succès est considéré comme un **échec**.
es: Before you perform a Check, you may declare **double or nothing**. If you do, until the end of that Check, any dice you roll that show an **even** number are treated as if that number was **doubled**, and other dice you roll are treated as showing a **1**.
pt-BR: Antes de realizar uma Verificação de Precisão, uma Verificação de Magia para um feitiço ofensivo (⚡) ou uma Verificação para avançar ou retroceder um Relógio, você pode declarar o dobro ou nada. Se você fizer isso e o Teste desencadear um sucesso crítico, dobre o dano causado por aquele ataque ou feitiço ou pelas seções preenchidas ou apagadas daquele Relógio, respectivamente; entretanto, qualquer outro Resultado é considerado uma falha crítica.
ru: Before you perform a Check, you may declare **double or nothing**. If you do, until the end of that Check, any dice you roll that show an **even** number are treated as if that number was **doubled**, and other dice you roll are treated as showing a **1**.
pl: Before you perform a Check, you may declare **double or nothing**. If you do, until the end of that Check, any dice you roll that show an **even** number are treated as if that number was **doubled**, and other dice you roll are treated as showing a **1**.
zh-CN: 在进行检定前，你可以宣告**孤注一掷**。若如此做，直到该次检定结束，你掷出的所有**偶数**骰值均视为**翻倍**，其他骰值均视为**1**。

en: When you resolve a set with **Magic Cards**, if it includes a **joker** and/or a **7**, you deal 【**SL**】 extra damage until the start of your next turn; if it includes a **joker** and/or a 1, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【**SL**】 until the start of your next turn (before Affinities); if it doesn't include any **joker**, **1**, or **7**, you recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points.
it: Quando ottieni un **successo critico** oppure un **fallimento critico**, puoi pescare 1 carta dal tuo **mazzo**. Se lo fai, scarta 1 carta dalla tua **mano**.
de: When you resolve a set with **Magic Cards**, if it includes a **joker** and/or a **7**, you deal 【**SL**】 extra damage until the start of your next turn; if it includes a **joker** and/or a 1, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【**SL**】 until the start of your next turn (before Affinities); if it doesn't include any **joker**, **1**, or **7**, you recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points.
fr: Lorsque vous obtenez une **réussite critique** ou un **échec critique**, vous pouvez piocher 1 carte de votre **paquet**. Si vous le faites, défaussez 1 carte de votre **main**.
es: When you resolve a set with **Magic Cards**, if it includes a **joker** and/or a **7**, you deal 【**SL**】 extra damage until the start of your next turn; if it includes a **joker** and/or a 1, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【**SL**】 until the start of your next turn (before Affinities); if it doesn't include any **joker**, **1**, or **7**, you recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points.
pt-BR: Quando você gera um sucesso crítico ou uma falha crítica, você pode comprar 1 carta do seu baralho. Se fizer isso, descarte 1 carta da sua mão.
ru: When you resolve a set with **Magic Cards**, if it includes a **joker** and/or a **7**, you deal 【**SL**】 extra damage until the start of your next turn; if it includes a **joker** and/or a 1, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【**SL**】 until the start of your next turn (before Affinities); if it doesn't include any **joker**, **1**, or **7**, you recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points.
pl: When you resolve a set with **Magic Cards**, if it includes a **joker** and/or a **7**, you deal 【**SL**】 extra damage until the start of your next turn; if it includes a **joker** and/or a 1, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【**SL**】 until the start of your next turn (before Affinities); if it doesn't include any **joker**, **1**, or **7**, you recover 【**SL × 2**】 Hit Points.
zh-CN: 使用**魔法卡牌**结算牌组组合时，若其中包含**鬼牌**及／或**7**，则直到你的下个回合开始，你造成的伤害增加【**SL**】；若包含**鬼牌**及／或**1**，则直到你的下个回合开始，你受到的所有伤害减少【**SL**】（在计算相性前）；若不包含任何**鬼牌**、**1**或**7**，你恢复【**SL×2**】点生命值。

en:
You gain a **deck**, a **hand** and a **discard pile** (see next page).
During a conflict, you may use an action and spend up to 【**10 + (SL × 5)**】 Mind Points (minimum 10). If you do, discard and **resolve 1 card** from your **hand** for every 5 MP spent this way (to a maximum of 5 cards; these cards form a **set**). After you resolve the effect of the **set** (if any), draw that many cards.
it: Ottieni un **mazzo**, una **mano** e una **pila degli scarti**. Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un'azione e spendere fino a 【**10 + (LA × 5)**】 Punti Mente (minimo 10). Se lo fai, **risolvi 1 carta** dalla tua **mano** per ogni 5 PM spesi in questo modo (massimo 5 carte; queste carte formano un **set**). Dopo aver risolto l'effetto del **set** (se presente), **scarta** queste carte e pescane altrettante dal tuo **mazzo**.
de:

After you resolve the effect of the **set** (if any), draw that many cards.
fr: Vous obtenez un **paquet** et une **main** de cartes, ainsi qu'une **pile de défausse**. Pour ce faire, vous **posez** des cartes (au moins 2 et au maximum 5) depuis votre main et payez 5 PM par carte. Vous ne pouvez dépenser au maximum de cette manière que 【10 + (NC × 5)】Points de Magie. Après avoir résolu l'effet de cette **série** (s'il y en a), **défaussez** ces cartes et piochez autant de cartes de votre **paquet**.

en: When you **hit** one or more enemies with an attack during your turn, you may discard up to 【**SL + 1**】 cards. If you do, draw that many cards.
it: Al termine del tuo turno durante un conflitto, puoi scartare fino a 【**LA**】 carte dalla tua **mano**. Se lo fai, pesca altrettante carte dal tuo **mazzo**.
de: When you **hit** one or more enemies with an attack during your turn, you may discard up to 【**SL + 1**】 cards. If you do, draw that many cards.
fr: À la fin de votre tour lors d'un conflit, vous pouvez défausser jusqu'à【SL】cartes de votre **main**. Si vous les faites, piochez autant de cartes de votre **paquet**.

en: After an enemy you can see resolves an **Attack**, **Objective**, **Skill**, or **Spell** action, you may discard up to 【**SL + 1**】 cards that are **jokers** or whose **suit** corresponds to a damage type based on the enemy action: **ice (Attack)**, **fire (Objective)**, **earth (Skill)**, or **air (Spell)**. If you do, draw that many cards; then you may perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than **(SL × 5)** (you must still pay its MP cost) and you cannot use this Skill again until the start of your next turn.
it: Dopo che un nemico a te visibile esegue un'azione durante un conflitto, puoi dichiarare uno dei **segni** del tuo **mazzo** (dopo che l'azione è stata risolta) e mettere nella tua **pila degli scarti** la prima carta dal fondo del tuo **mazzo**, scoperta. Se quella carta è un **jolly** o il suo **segno** è quello che avevi dichiarato, puoi eseguire immediatamente e gratuitamente l'azione di **Incantesimo**, lanciando un incantesimo con un **costo totale in Punti Mente pari o inferiore a** 【**LA × 5**】 (devi pagarne il costo in PM).
de: After an enemy you can see resolves an **Attack**, **Objective**, **Skill**, or **Spell** action, you may discard up to 【**SL + 1**】 cards that are **jokers** or whose **suit** corresponds to a damage type based on the enemy action: **ice (Attack)**, **fire (Objective)**, **earth (Skill)**, or **air (Spell)**. If you do, draw that many cards; then you may perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than **(SL × 5)** (you must still pay its MP cost) and you cannot use this Skill again until the start of your next turn.
fr: Après qu'un ennemi que vous pouvez voir a effectué une action au cours du conflit, vous pouvez annoncer une des **couleurs** de votre **paquet** (après la résolution de l'action) et placer la première carte du dessous de votre **paquet** sur la **pile de défausse**, face visible. Si cette carte est un **joker** ou si sa **couleur correspond à celle que vous avez annoncée, vous pouvez immédiatement effectuer gratuitement l'action **Sort**, pour lancer un sort avec un **total de Points de Magie égal ou inférieur à【NC × 5**】(vous devez tout de même payer son prix en PM).
es: After an enemy you can see resolves an **Attack**, **Objective**, **Skill**, or **Spell** action, you may discard up to 【**SL + 1**】 cards that are **jokers** or whose **suit** corresponds to a damage type based on the enemy action: **ice (Attack)**, **fire (Objective)**, **earth (Skill)**, or **air (Spell)**. If you do, draw that many cards; then you may perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than **(SL × 5)** (you must still pay its MP cost) and you cannot use this Skill again until the start of your next turn.

Se aquela carta for um curinga ou seu naipe corresponder ao que você declarou, você pode realizar imediatamente a ação de Feitiço de graça, conjurando uma mágica com um custo total de Pontos Mentais igual ou inferior a 【NP × 5】 (você ainda deve pagar seu Custo de PM).

zh-CN: 当你能看见的敌人结算**攻击**、**目标**、**技能**或**法术**行动后，你可以弃置至多【**SL+1**】张**鬼牌**，或弃置**花色**对应下列伤害类型的牌：**冰（攻击）**、**火（目标）**、**土（技能）**、**风（法术）**。若如此做，抽取同等数量的牌；随后你可以免费执行**法术**行动，施放精神值总消耗不高于（**SL×5**）的**法术**（仍须支付其精神值消耗），此**技能**直到你的下个回合开始前都无法再次使用。

en:
After another creature you can see loses Hit Points, if they are in **Crisis** and are not **undead**, you gain **1 Grave Point**. You may never have more than **【SL + 1】** Grave Points.
When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you **lose all Grave Points**; then, if you lost at least 1 Grave Point this way and this is the **first time** you are reduced to 0 HP during this scene, your current Hit Points instead become equal to **【SL, multiplied by the amount of Grave Points you lost this way】** .
it: Quando un'altra creatura a te visibile perde PV mentre è in **Crisi**, se non è un **non morto**, guadagni **1 Punto Sepolcro**. Non puoi mai avere più di 【**LA + 1**】 Punti Sepolcro. Quando vieni ridotto a 0 Punti Vita, **perdi tutti i Punti Sepolcro**; poi, se hai perso almeno 1 Punto Sepolcro in questo modo e questa è la **prima** volta che vieni ridotto a 0 PV in questa scena, non ti **Arrendi** né **Sacrifichi**: invece, recuperi un ammontare di PV pari a 【**LA, moltiplicato per il numero di Punti Sepolcro persi in questo modo**】.

À la place, vous récupérez un nombre de PV égal à【**NC, multiplié par le nombre de Points de Sépulture que vous venez de perdre**】.

Quando você é reduzido a 0 Pontos de Vida, você perde todos os Pontos de Túmulo; então, se você perdeu pelo menos 1 Ponto de Túmulo desta forma e esta é a primeira vez que você é reduzido a 0 PV durante esta cena, você não se rende nem se sacrifica: em vez disso, você recupera uma quantidade de PV igual a 【NP, multiplicado pela quantidade de Pontos de Túmulo que você perdeu dessa maneira.

zh-CN: 你能看见的另一个生物失去生命值后，若其处于**危机状态**且并非**不死生物**，你获得**1点墓地点数**。你的墓地点数上限为**【SL+1】**。\n你的生命值降至0时，**失去所有墓地点数**；随后，若你以此方式失去了至少**1点墓地点数**，且这是你在此场景中**首次**生命值降至0，则你的当前生命值改为**【SL乘以此次失去的墓地点数】**。

en: You can always communicate with **undead** creatures. Once per scene, you may ask an **undead** a single question. They are compelled to answer truthfully.
it: Puoi comunicare verbalmente con qualsiasi **non morto**. Una volta per scena, puoi porre a un **non morto** una singola domanda; è costretto a rispondere dicendo la verità.
de: You can always communicate with **undead** creatures. Once per scene, you may ask an **undead** a single question. They are compelled to answer truthfully.
fr: Vous pouvez toujours communiquer verbalement avec les **morts-vivants**. Une fois par scène, vous pouvez poser à un **mort-vivant** une unique question ; ils doivent vous répondre honnêtement.

zh-CN: 你始终能够与**不死生物**交流。每个场景一次，你可以向一个**不死生物**提出一个问题，对方必须如实回答。

en: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from **shaken** and/or **weak**, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover **【SL × 2】** Mind Points.
it: Dopo che fai sì che uno o più nemici perdano Punti Vita, se hai acquisito l'Abilità **Oltre i Reami della Morte** e almeno uno di essi è afflitto dallo status **debole** e/o **scosso**, guadagni 1 Punto Sepolcro e recuperi 【**LA × 2**】 Punti Vita e Punti Mente.
de: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from **shaken** and/or **weak**, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover **【SL × 2】** Mind Points.
fr: Après avoir provoqué une perte de Points de Vie chez un ou plusieurs ennemis, si vous avez obtenu la Compétence **Au-delà du royaume des morts** et qu'au moins l'un d'entre eux subits un état **affaibli** et/ou **traumatisé,** vous gagnez 1 Point de Sépulture et récupérez【**NC × 2**】Points de Vie et Points de Magie.
es: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from **shaken** and/or **weak**, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover **【SL × 2】** Mind Points.
pt-BR: Depois de fazer com que um ou mais inimigos percam Pontos de Vida, se você adquiriu o Poder Além dos Reinos da Morte e pelo menos um deles está abalado e/ou fraco, você ganha 1 Ponto de Túmulo e recupera 【NP × 2】 Pontos de vida e Pontos Mentais.
ru: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from **shaken** and/or **weak**, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover **【SL × 2】** Mind Points.
pl: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from **shaken** and/or **weak**, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover **【SL × 2】** Mind Points.
zh-CN: 使一个或多个敌人失去生命值后，若你已获得超越死亡之境技能，且其中至少一个敌人正处于**动摇**及／或**虚弱**状态，你获得1点墓地点数并恢复【**SL×2**】点精神值。

en:
When you deal damage to one or more enemies with a spell, you may spend 1 Grave Point. If you do, choose one option:
- Choose one of those enemies, and the spell deals extra damage equal to **【SL + the number of status effects the chosen enemy is suffering from】**.
- Each of those enemies suffers **shaken** after the effects of the spell are resolved.
it: Quando **infliggi danno a una creatura con un incantesimo**, se quell'incantesimo **infligge danno solo a quella creatura**, puoi spendere 1 Punto Sepolcro. Se lo fai, scegli un'opzione: se quella creatura è afflitta da uno o più status, l'incantesimo infligge danni extra pari a 【**(LA × 2) + il numero di status presenti sulla creatura**】; **oppure** se quella creatura non è afflitta da status, subisce lo status **scosso**.
de:
When you deal damage to one or more enemies with a spell, you may spend 1 Grave Point. If you do, choose one option:
- Choose one of those enemies, and the spell deals extra damage equal to **【SL + the number of status effects the chosen enemy is suffering from】**.
- Each of those enemies suffers **shaken** after the effects of the spell are resolved.
fr: Lorsque vous **infligez des dégâts à une unique créature avec un sort**, vous pouvez dépenser 1 Point de Sépulture. Choisissez alors une option : si cette créature subit un ou plusieurs états, le sort inflige【**(NC × 2) + le nombre d'états sur cette créature**】dégâts supplémentaires ; **ou** si cette créature ne subit aucun effet, elle devient **traumatisée**.
es:

- Each of those enemies suffers **shaken** after the effects of the spell are resolved.

Se fizer isso, escolha uma opção: se aquela criatura estiver sofrendo um ou mais efeitos de status, a magia causa dano extra igual a 【(NH × 2) + o número de efeitos de status naquela criatura】; ou se aquela criatura não estiver sofrendo nenhum efeito de status, ela ficará abalada.

zh-CN: 当你以法术对一个或多个敌人造成伤害时，你可以花费1点墓地点数。若如此做，选择一项：\n- 选择其中一个敌人，该法术对其额外造成**【SL+该敌人正承受的异常状态数量】**点伤害。\n- 法术效果结算后，这些敌人均陷入**动摇**状态。

en: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) with a **target** of "One creature", you may spend 2 Grave Points to have its **target** become "Every creature present on the scene" (perform a single Magic Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each target). If you do, all damage dealt by the spell becomes **dark** and its type cannot change.
it: Quando lanci un incantesimo offensivo (⚡) con **bersaglio** "Una creatura", puoi spendere 2 Punti Sepolcro per fargli bersagliare **tutte** le creature a te visibili nella scena (effettui un singolo Test di Magia e lo confronti con la Difesa Magica di ciascun bersaglio). Se lo fai, tutto il danno inflitto dall'incantesimo diventa **ombra** e non può cambiare tipo.
de: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) with a **target** of "One creature", you may spend 2 Grave Points to have its **target** become "Every creature present on the scene" (perform a single Magic Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each target). If you do, all damage dealt by the spell becomes **dark** and its type cannot change.
fr: Lorsque vous lancez un sort offensif (⚡) dont la **cible** est ♠ une créature », vous pouvez dépenser 2 Points de Sépulture pour cibler **toutes** les créatures que vous voyez et qui sont présentes dans la scène (effectuez un simple Test de magie et confrontez-le à la Défense magique de chaque cible). Si vous le faites, tous les dégâts infligés par le sort deviennent des dégâts de **ténèbres** et leur type ne peut pas changer.
es: When you cast an offensive spell (⚡) with a **target** of "One creature", you may spend 2 Grave Points to have its **target** become "Every creature present on the scene" (perform a single Magic Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each target). If you do, all damage dealt by the spell becomes **dark** and its type cannot change.
pt-BR: Quando você lança um feitiço ofensivo (⚡) com o alvo de “Uma criatura”, você pode gastar 2 Pontos de Túmulo para que ele atinja todas as criaturas que você puder ver e que estejam presentes na cena (realize um único Teste Mágico e confronte-o com o Defesa Mágica de cada alvo). Se você fizer isso, todo o dano causado pelo feitiço se tornará trevas e seu tipo não poderá mudar.

zh-CN: 施放**目标**为“一个生物”的攻击法术（⚡）时，你可以花费2点墓地点数，将其**目标**改为“场景中的所有生物”（进行一次施法检定，并将结果与每个**目标**的魔法防御比较）。若如此做，该法术造成的所有伤害变为**暗属性**，且其类型无法改变。

en: On your turn during a conflict scene, you may use an action and spend a variable amount of MP to weave voice and music into a magical effect known as a **verse**. You may only sing **one verse** per turn, even if you have access to multiple actions. When you first acquire this Skill, you learn all **three volumes**, plus **one key** and **one tone**. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you may learn **one key or one tone** (your choice).
it: Nel tuo turno durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere un ammontare variabile di Punti Mente per combinare musica e voce in un effetto magico, chiamato **verso**. Puoi cantare **un solo verso** per turno, anche se hai accesso a più di un’azione. Quando acquisisci questa Abilità per la prima volta, impari **tutti i tipi di volume, una chiave** e **un tono**; ogni volta che acquisisci nuovamente questa Abilità, impari **una chiave o un tono** (a tua scelta).
de: On your turn during a conflict scene, you may use an action and spend a variable amount of MP to weave voice and music into a magical effect known as a **verse**. You may only sing **one verse** per turn, even if you have access to multiple actions. When you first acquire this Skill, you learn all **three volumes**, plus **one key** and **one tone**. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you may learn **one key or one tone** (your choice).
fr: À votre tour, pendant une scène de conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser un nombre variable de PM pour entremêler votre voix et votre musique afin de créer un effet magique baptisé **couplet**. Vous ne pouvez chanter qu’**un couplet** par tour, même si vous disposez de plusieurs actions ; les règles complètes des **couplets** commencent page suivante. Quand vous obtenez cette compétence pour la première fois, vous apprenez **les trois volumes**, plus **une clef** et **un ton**. Dès que vous apprenez de nouveau la compétence, vous pouvez prendre **une clef ou un ton** de plus (à vous de choisir).
es: On your turn during a conflict scene, you may use an action and spend a variable amount of MP to weave voice and music into a magical effect known as a **verse**. You may only sing **one verse** per turn, even if you have access to multiple actions. When you first acquire this Skill, you learn all **three volumes**, plus **one key** and **one tone**. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you may learn **one key or one tone** (your choice).
pt-BR: No seu turno, durante uma cena de conflito, você pode usar uma ação e gastar uma quantidade variável de PM para transformar voz e música em um efeito mágico conhecido como verso. Você só pode cantar um verso por turno, mesmo que tenha acesso a múltiplas ações. Ao adquirir esse Poder pela primeira vez, você aprende todos os três volumes, mais uma tonalidade e um tom. Sempre que você adquirir esse Poder novamente, você poderá aprender uma tonalidade ou um tom (sua escolha).
ru: On your turn during a conflict scene, you may use an action and spend a variable amount of MP to weave voice and music into a magical effect known as a **verse**. You may only sing **one verse** per turn, even if you have access to multiple actions. When you first acquire this Skill, you learn all **three volumes**, plus **one key** and **one tone**. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you may learn **one key or one tone** (your choice).

You may only sing **one verse** per turn, even if you have access to multiple actions. When you first acquire this Skill, you learn all **three volumes**, plus **one key** and **one tone**. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you may learn **one key or one tone** (your choice).
zh-CN: 在冲突场景中你的回合内，作为一次行动，你可以消耗一定数量的精神值，将声音和旋律编织成一种被称为**乐章**的魔法效果。即使你在同一回合内能行动多次，你每个回合也只能咏唱**一段乐章**。**乐章**的完整规则详见下一页。首次习得此技能时，你将掌握**全部三种音量**，外加**一种调式**和**一种音色**（见下页）。每当你再次习得此技能时，可再选择学习**一种调式或音色**。

en: After you affect one or more enemies with a **verse**, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one option: until the start of your next turn, your allies deal【**SL**】extra damage to those enemies; **or** until the start of your next turn, you recover【**SL**】Mind Points **every time** one of those enemies suffers damage (if the same source deals damage to two or more of those enemies at the same time, you recover【**SL**】MP for each damaged enemy).
it: Dopo che uno o più nemici subiscono gli effetti di un tuo **verso**, se hai un’arma della Categoria **arcana** equipaggiata, puoi scegliere un’opzione: fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, i tuoi alleati infliggono 【**LA**】 danni extra a quei nemici; **oppure** fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, recuperi 【**LA**】 Punti Mente **ogni volta** che uno di quei nemici subisce danno (se la medesima fonte danneggia due o più di quei nemici contemporaneamente, recuperi 【**LA**】 Punti Mente per ciascun nemico danneggiato).
de: After you affect one or more enemies with a **verse**, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one option: until the start of your next turn, your allies deal【**SL**】extra damage to those enemies; **or** until the start of your next turn, you recover【**SL**】Mind Points **every time** one of those enemies suffers damage (if the same source deals damage to two or more of those enemies at the same time, you recover【**SL**】MP for each damaged enemy).
fr: Après avoir affecté un ou plusieurs ennemis avec un **couplet**, si vous êtes équipé d’une arme **arcanique**, vous pouvez choisir une option : jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour, vos alliés infligent **【NC】** dégâts supplémentaires à ces ennemis ; **ou** jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour, vous récupérez **【NC】** Points de Magie **chaque fois** qu’un de ces ennemis subit des dégâts (si la même source inflige des dégâts à deux de ces ennemis ou plus en même temps, vous récupérez **【NC】** PM pour chaque ennemi endommagé).
es: After you affect one or more enemies with a **verse**, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one option: until the start of your next turn, your allies deal【**SL**】extra damage to those enemies; **or** until the start of your next turn, you recover【**SL**】Mind Points **every time** one of those enemies suffers damage (if the same source deals damage to two or more of those enemies at the same time, you recover【**SL**】MP for each damaged enemy).
pt-BR: Depois de afetar um ou mais inimigos com um verso, se você tiver uma arma arcana equipada, você pode escolher uma opção: até o início do seu próximo turno, seus aliados causam 【NP】 dano extra a esses inimigos; OU até o início do seu próximo turno, você recupera【NP】Pontos Mentais toda vez que um desses inimigos sofre dano (se a mesma fonte causa dano a dois ou mais desses inimigos ao mesmo tempo, você recupera【NP】PM por cada inimigo danificado).
ru: After you affect one or more enemies with a **verse**, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one option: until the start of your next turn, your allies deal【**SL**】extra damage to those enemies; **or** until the start of your next turn, you recover【**SL**】Mind Points **every time** one of those enemies suffers damage (if the same source deals damage to two or more of those enemies at the same time, you recover【**SL**】MP for each damaged enemy).
pl: After you affect one or more enemies with a **verse**, if you have an **arcane** weapon equipped, you may choose one option: until the start of your next turn, your allies deal【**SL**】extra damage to those enemies; **or** until the start of your next turn, you recover【**SL**】Mind Points **every time** one of those enemies suffers damage (if the same source deals damage to two or more of those enemies at the same time, you recover【**SL**】MP for each damaged enemy).
zh-CN: 当你的**乐章**效果对一个**或**多个敌人造成影响时，如果你正装备**魔法类**武器，你可以从以下效果中选择一项：在你的下个回合开始前，你的盟友对这些敌人造成等同于【**技能等级**】的额外伤害；**或**在你的下个回合开始前，**每当**你对这些敌人造成伤害时，自身恢复等同于【**技能等级**】的精神值（如果你的单次伤害效果同时对两个**或**更多敌人造成伤害，则你每对一个敌人造成伤害，便能恢复等同于【**技能等级**】的精神值）。

en: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; additionally, you may use **Ritualism** to create **hearing-based illusions**.
it: Puoi eseguire Rituali i cui effetti rientrino nella disciplina di **Ritualismo**; in più, puoi usare il **Ritualismo** per creare **illusioni basate sull’udito**.
de: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; additionally, you may use **Ritualism** to create **hearing-based illusions**.
fr: Vous êtes capable de réaliser des rituels de la discipline **Ritualisme** ; **de plus**, vous pouvez utiliser **Ritualisme** pour créer **des illusions auditives**.
es: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; additionally, you may use **Ritualism** to create **hearing-based illusions**.
pt-BR: Você ganha o Poder de realizar Rituais da disciplina Ritualismo; além disso, você pode usar o Ritualismo para criar ilusões baseadas na audição.
ru: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; additionally, you may use **Ritualism** to create **hearing-based illusions**.
pl: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; additionally, you may use **Ritualism** to create **hearing-based illusions**.
zh-CN: 你可以启动效果属于**仪式系**的仪式。此外，你还可以用**仪式系**仪式创造**基于听觉的幻觉**。

en: After you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high volume**, all **physical** damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** Affinities).
it: Dopo che canti un **verso** con volume **medio** o **alto**, tutto il danno **fisico** che subisci fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno viene ridotto di 【**LA**】 (**prima** di applicare Affinità).
de: After you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high volume**, all **physical** damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** Affinities).
fr: Après avoir chanté un **couplet** à **volume intermédiaire** ou **élevé**, tous les dégâts **physiques** que vous subissez jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour sont réduits de **【NC】** (**avant** d’appliquer les affinités).
es: After you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high volume**, all **physical** damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** Affinities).
pt-BR: Depois de cantar um verso com volume médio ou alto, todo dano físico que você sofrer até o início do seu próximo turno será reduzido em 【NP】 (aplicado antes das Afinidades).
ru: After you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high volume**, all **physical** damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** Affinities).
pl: After you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high volume**, all **physical** damage you suffer until the start of your next turn is reduced by【**SL**】(applied **before** Affinities).
zh-CN: 当你以**中音**或**高音**咏唱一段**乐章**后，你受到的所有**物理**伤害都将减少【**技能等级**】点（先于相性生效），持续至你的下个回合开始。

en: After you sing a verse with **low** or **medium volume**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
it: Dopo che canti un **verso** con volume **basso** o **medio**, puoi eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata; considera il tuo **Tiro Maggiore** pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno inflitto da questo attacco.
de: After you sing a verse with **low** or **medium volume**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
fr: Après avoir chanté un **couplet** à **volume bas ou intermédiaire**, vous pouvez effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme dont vous êtes équipé ; faites comme si votre **valeur haute** était 0 quand vous calculez les dégâts infligés par cette attaque.
es: After you sing a verse with **low** or **medium volume**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
pt-BR: Após cantar um verso com volume baixo ou médio, você poderá realizar um ataque livre com uma arma que tenha equipado; trate sua Rolagem Alta (RA) como 0 ao calcular o dano causado por este ataque.
ru: After you sing a verse with **low** or **medium volume**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
pl: After you sing a verse with **low** or **medium volume**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
zh-CN: 当你以**低音**或**中音**咏唱一段乐章后，你可以使用一件你已装备的武器执行一次**顺势攻击**，本次攻击的**高值**在计算伤害时视为0。

en: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: all MP costs are doubled; **or** all sources of damage deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
it: Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere 10 PM per scegliere un’opzione: tutti i costi in Punti Mente sono raddoppiati; **oppure** tutte le fonti di danno infliggono 【**LA × 3**】 danni extra. L’effetto scelto termina all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: all MP costs are doubled; **or** all sources of damage deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
fr: Pendant un conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 10 Points de Magie pour choisir une option : tous les coûts en PM sont doublés **ou** toutes les sources de dégâts infligent **【NC × 3】** dégâts supplémentaires. L’effet choisi dure jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.
es: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: all MP costs are doubled; **or** all sources of damage deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Durante um conflito, você pode usar uma ação e gastar 10 PM para escolher uma opção: todos os custos de PM são dobrados; OU todas as fontes de dano causam 【NP × 3】dano extra. O efeito escolhido dura até o início do seu próximo turno.
ru: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: all MP costs are doubled; **or** all sources of damage deal【**SL × 3**】extra damage. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

en: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one ally that can hear you. That ally may immediately perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped (or with a **basic attack** if they are an NPC). They gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to the Accuracy Check, but treat their **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage.
it: Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere 10 PM per scegliere un alleato in grado di sentirti. Quell’alleato può immediatamente eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata (o con un **attacco base** se è un PNG); ottiene un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 al Test di Precisione, ma considera il suo **TM** pari a 0 quando calcola il danno.
de: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one ally that can hear you. That ally may immediately perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped (or with a **basic attack** if they are an NPC). They gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to the Accuracy Check, but treat their **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage.
fr: Pendant un conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 10 PM pour choisir un allié qui vous entend. Celui‑ci peut immédiatement effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme dont il est équipé (ou avec une **attaque de base** s’il s’agit d’un PNJ). Il bénéficie alors d’un bonus égal à votre **【NC】** à son test de précision, mais on considère sa **valeur haute** comme égale à 0 lorsqu’on calcule les dégâts.
es: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one ally that can hear you. That ally may immediately perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped (or with a **basic attack** if they are an NPC). They gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to the Accuracy Check, but treat their **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage.
pt-BR: Durante um conflito, você pode usar uma ação e gastar 10 PM para escolher um aliado que possa ouvi-lo. Esse aliado pode realizar imediatamente um ataque livre com uma arma que tenha equipado (ou com um ataque básico se for um PNJ). Eles ganham um bônus igual a 【NP】 na Verificação de Precisão, mas tratam sua Rolagem Alta (RA) como 0 ao calcular o dano.

zh-CN: 在冲突场景中，作为一次行动，你可以消耗10点精神值，选择一名能听见你的言语的盟友。该盟友可以使用其正装备的一件武器执行一次**顺势攻击**（如果该盟友是非玩家角色，则使用**基础攻击**）。其命中检定获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值，但在计算伤害时将**高值**视为0。

en: After you use **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle**, you may choose another Player Character that can hear you who has yet to take a turn during this round. That character may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
it: Dopo che usi **Castello del Re**, **Cavallo in Carica** o **Editto dell’Alfiere**, puoi scegliere un altro Personaggio Giocante in grado di sentirti che deve ancora svolgere il suo turno in questo round: quel PG può svolgere il suo turno immediatamente dopo il tuo.
de: After you use **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle**, you may choose another Player Character that can hear you who has yet to take a turn during this round. That character may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
fr: Après avoir utilisé **Décret du fou**, **Charge de cavalerie** ou **Roque du roi**, vous pouvez choisir un autre personnage joueur capable de vous entendre et qui n’a pas encore joué son tour durant ce round. Ce personnage peut jouer son tour immédiatement après vous durant ce round.
es: After you use **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle**, you may choose another Player Character that can hear you who has yet to take a turn during this round. That character may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
pt-BR: Depois de usar o Édito do Bispo, a Cavalaria de Ataque ou o Castelo do Rei, você pode escolher outro Personagem de Jogador que possa ouvi-lo e que ainda não tenha jogado durante esta rodada. Esse personagem pode jogar seu turno imediatamente após o seu durante esta rodada.
ru: After you use **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle**, you may choose another Player Character that can hear you who has yet to take a turn during this round. That character may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
pl: After you use **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle**, you may choose another Player Character that can hear you who has yet to take a turn during this round. That character may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.
zh-CN: 在你使用**主教敕令**、**骑士冲锋**或**王车易位**后，可以选择一名本轮还有未进行的回合、且能听见你的言语的玩家角色，他可以在你的回合结束时立即开始他的回合。

en: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one option: no creature can recover Hit Points or Mind Points; **or** all effects that restore Mind Points restore【**SL × 5**】additional Mind Points. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
it: Durante un conflitto, puoi usare un’azione e spendere 10 PM per scegliere un’opzione: tutte le creature non possono recuperare PV o PM; **oppure** gli effetti che causano il recupero di PV e/o PM causano rispettivamente il recupero di 【**LA × 10**】 PV e/o PM addizionali. L’effetto scelto termina all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one option: no creature can recover Hit Points or Mind Points; **or** all effects that restore Mind Points restore【**SL × 5**】additional Mind Points. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
fr: Pendant un conflit, vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser 10 PM pour choisir une option : aucune créature ne peut récupérer de Points de Vie ou de Points de Magie, **ou bien** tous les effets qui restaurent des Points de Magie en redonnent **【NC × 5】** de plus. L’effet choisi dure jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.
es: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one option: no creature can recover Hit Points or Mind Points; **or** all effects that restore Mind Points restore【**SL × 5**】additional Mind Points. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Durante um conflito, você pode usar uma ação e gastar 10 PM para escolher uma opção: nenhuma criatura pode recuperar Pontos de Vida ou Pontos Mentais; OU todos os efeitos que restauram Pontos Mentais restauram【NP × 5】Pontos Mentais adicionais. O efeito escolhido dura até o início do seu próximo turno.
ru: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one option: no creature can recover Hit Points or Mind Points; **or** all effects that restore Mind Points restore【**SL × 5**】additional Mind Points. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
pl: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 mp to choose one option: no creature can recover Hit Points or Mind Points; **or** all effects that restore Mind Points restore【**SL × 5**】additional Mind Points. The chosen effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
zh-CN: 在冲突场景中，作为一次行动，你可以消耗10点精神值，从下列选项中选择一项：任何生物都无法恢复生命值**或**精神值；**或**所有能恢复精神值的效果都会额外恢复【**技能等级×5**】的精神值。选定的效果持续到你的下个回合开始。

en: During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage. After the attack is resolved, choose one option: one ally who is able to hear you recovers【**5 + (SL × 5)**】Hit Points; **or** you may immediately use a Skill you acquired among **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle** for free (spending the appropriate MP).
it: Puoi usare un’azione per eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata; considera il tuo **TM** pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno. Dopo che l’attacco è risolto, scegli un’opzione: un alleato in grado di sentirti recupera 【**5 + (LA × 5)**】 Punti Vita; **oppure** usi immediatamente e **gratuitamente** un’Abilità che hai acquisito tra **Castello del Re**, **Cavallo in Carica** e **Editto dell’Alfiere** (spendendo i Punti Mente appropriati).
de: During a conflict, you may use an action to perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped, treating your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage. After the attack is resolved, choose one option: one ally who is able to hear you recovers【**5 + (SL × 5)**】Hit Points; **or** you may immediately use a Skill you acquired among **Bishop's Edict**, **Charging Cavalry**, or **King's Castle** for free (spending the appropriate MP).

en:
Each time you take this Skill, you learn a **dance**.
On your turn during a conflict scene, if you have no **martial armor** equipped, you may spend 10 Mind Points to **perform a dance** you have learned. This doesn’t require an action, but it can only be done **once per turn**, while no other effect is being resolved.
If you already performed a **different dance** during your previous turn in this scene, the cost of the new **dance** is reduced to 5 Mind Points.
Some **dances** are **instantaneous** and resolve immediately, while others have effects that last **until the start of your next turn**.
it: Ogni volta che acquisisci questa Abilità, impari una **danza**. Nel tuo turno durante un conflitto, se non hai un’**armatura marziale** equipaggiata, puoi spendere 10 Punti Mente per **eseguire una danza** tra quelle che hai imparato; ciò non richiede un’azione, ma puoi farlo solo **prima o dopo** un’azione, e solo **una volta per turno**. Se hai già eseguito una danza **differente** nel tuo turno precedente di questa scena, il costo della nuova **danza** è ridotto a 5 Punti Mente. Alcune danze hanno **durata** “Istantanea” e si risolvono immediatamente, altre hanno effetti che durano “Fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno”.

fr: Chaque fois que vous prenez cette compétence, vous apprenez une **danse**. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’utiliser une action pour le faire, mais ne pouvez danser de la sorte qu’**avant ou après** une action et seulement **une fois par tour**. Si vous avez déjà exécuté une **danse différente** pendant votre tour précédent lors de cette scène, le coût de la nouvelle **danse** diminue de 5 Points de Magie. Certaines **danses instantanées** se résolvent immédiatement, tandis que l’effet de certaines autres dure **jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour**.

zh-CN: 每当你习得该技能时，都能学会一种**舞蹈**（见下页）。在冲突场景中你的回合内，若你未装备**职业限定防具**，便可消耗10点精神值以**表演一支**你已习得的**舞蹈**。这不视为一次行动，但只能在没有其他效果正在结算时发动，且**每个回合限执行一次**。若你在当前场景的先前回合已表演过**不同舞蹈**，则本次**舞蹈**的消耗降低至5点精神值。某些**舞蹈**的持续时间为**瞬发**；而另一些**舞蹈**的效果则会**持续到你的下个回合开始**。

en: When you perform a **dance** with a **duration** of “Until the start of your next turn”, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one ally you can see towards whom you have a **Bond** of **affection**: apply the benefits of the **dance** to that ally as well as yourself (the benefits still last until the start of **your** next turn).
it: Quando esegui una **danza** con **durata** “Fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno”, puoi spendere 10 Punti Mente addizionali. Se lo fai, scegli un alleato a te visibile verso cui hai un Legame di **affetto**: applichi i benefici della tua **danza** anche a quell’alleato (tali benefici terminano comunque all’inizio del **tuo** prossimo turno).

en: After you perform a **dance** with a **duration** of “Until the start of your next turn”, you gain a bonus equal to【**SL × 2**】to all Opposed Checks that rely on **acrobatics**, **coordination**, or **speed** until the start of your next turn.

zh-CN: 在你表演一支**舞蹈**后，你使用**格斗类**、**匕首类**、**链枷类**、剑类和**投掷类**武器进行的攻击将造成【**技能等级**】点额外伤害，持续至你的下个回合开始。如果你正装备**魔法类**武器，则你施放的攻击性法术（OO）也将造成【**技能等级**】的额外伤害，持续至你的下个回合开始。

en: If an ally bears one of your **symbols**, that ally may perform the **Spell** action and destroy that symbol to cast a single spell among those **you** know, as long as it has a **total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than**【**SL × 10**】(that ally must still pay the MP cost).

fr: Si un allié porte un de vos **symboles**, il peut effectuer l’action **Sort** et détruire le symbole en question pour lancer un unique sort parmi ceux que **vous** connaissez, tant que son **coût en Points de Magie est inférieur ou égal à 【NC × 10】** (l’allié doit naturellement acquitter ce coût).

zh-CN: 带有**你**的**符印**的盟友在执行**施法**行动时，可以选择销毁该**符印**，从而施放一个**你**知晓的法术，该法术的**精神值总消耗不得高于**【**技能等级×10**】（该盟友仍须支付精神值消耗）。

en: When a creature you can see that is bearing one of your **symbols** suffers damage or recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points, you may have that creature suffer【**SL**】extra damage or recover【**SL**】additional Hit Points and/or Mind Points, respectively).
it: Quando una creatura a te visibile su cui è impresso un tuo **simbolo** subisce danno o recupera Punti Vita e/o Punti Mente, puoi far sì che quella creatura subisca 【**LA**】 danni extra o recuperi rispettivamente 【**LA**】 Punti Vita e/o Punti Mente addizionali.
de: When a creature you can see that is bearing one of your **symbols** suffers damage or recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points, you may have that creature suffer【**SL**】extra damage or recover【**SL**】additional Hit Points and/or Mind Points, respectively).
fr: Quand une créature que vous voyez et qui porte un de vos **symboles** subit des dégâts ou récupère des Points de Vie et/ou des Points de Magie, vous pouvez lui infliger **【NC】** dégâts supplémentaires ou lui faire récupérer **【NC】** Points de Vie ou Points de Magie supplémentaires, respectivement.

zh-CN: 当一个你能看见，且带有你的**符印**的生物受到伤害或恢复生命值和/或精神值时，你可以让该生物受到【**技能等级**】的额外伤害，或额外恢复【**技能等级**】的生命值和/或精神值。

en: You always know the exact direction in which to find any creature bearing one of your **symbols**, as long as that creature is within **2 travel days** of your position.
it: Conosci l’esatta direzione in cui si trova qualsiasi creatura su cui sia impresso uno dei tuoi **simboli**, a patto che essa si trovi entro **2 giorni di viaggio** da te.
de: You always know the exact direction in which to find any creature bearing one of your **symbols**, as long as that creature is within **2 travel days** of your position.
fr: Vous savez toujours dans quelle direction exacte trouver n’importe quelle créature portant l’un de vos **symboles** tant qu’elle se trouve à un maximum de **2 jours de voyage** de votre position.
es: You always know the exact direction in which to find any creature bearing one of your **symbols**, as long as that creature is within **2 travel days** of your position.
pt-BR: Você sempre sabe a direção exata em que encontrará qualquer criatura com um de seus símbolos, desde que essa criatura esteja a 2 dias de viagem de sua posição.
ru: You always know the exact direction in which to find any creature bearing one of your **symbols**, as long as that creature is within **2 travel days** of your position.
pl: You always know the exact direction in which to find any creature bearing one of your **symbols**, as long as that creature is within **2 travel days** of your position.
zh-CN: 如果一个生物身上带有你的**符印**，且与你的距离不超过**2个旅行日**，那么你便可以随时知晓该生物的确切方位。

en: Each time you acquire this Skill, you learn **two symbols**. You may have **up to**【**SL + 1**】**symbols active at the same time**; if you create more while at your limit, you must first choose and destroy some of your previous **symbols**. You may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a **symbol** you have learned and choose one option: apply that **symbol** to yourself; **or** apply that **symbol** to an ally you can see; **or** perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply a copy of the chosen **symbol** to each enemy hit by the attack (each copy counts as a separate **symbol** towards your limit of【**SL + 1**】active **symbols**).
it: Ogni volta che acquisisci questa Abilità, impari **due simboli**. Puoi avere **fino a** 【**LA + 1**】 **simboli attivi allo stesso tempo**; se crei **simboli** in eccesso, devi prima scegliere e distruggere altrettanti **simboli** da te creati in precedenza. Puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** e spendere 2 Punti Inventario per creare un **simbolo** tra quelli che conosci e scegliere un’opzione: imprimi il **simbolo** su te stesso; **oppure** imprimi il **simbolo** su un alleato a te visibile; **oppure** esegui un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata. L’attacco non infligge danno, ma imprimi una copia del **simbolo** su ciascun nemico colpito (ogni copia conta come un **simbolo** separato ai fini del limite).

Vous pouvez réaliser l’action **Inventaire** et dépenser 2 Points d’Inventaire pour créer un **symbole** que vous avez appris et choisir une option : **soit** appliquer à vous‑même ce **symbole**, **soit** l’appliquer sur un allié que vous voyez, **soit** effectuer une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme dont vous êtes équipé. Cette attaque n’inflige aucun dégât, mais vous appliquez une copie du **symbole** choisi à chaque ennemi touché (chaque copie compte comme un **symbole** séparé dans le maximum de **【NC + 1】 symboles** actifs que vous pouvez maintenir).

zh-CN: 每当你习得此技能时，都将学会**两种符印**（见下页）。你可以在同一时间维持**至多**【**技能等级+1**】个**激活的符印**，如果你在**激活的符印**数量达到上限时继续创造**符印**，则必须先选择销毁一部分已存在的**符印**。你可以执行**消耗物资**行动，并消耗2点物资点，以创造一个你已习得的**符印**，并选择一项：将该**符印**施加于自身；**或**将该**符印**施加于一名你能看见的盟友；**或**使用你已装备的一件武器执行一次**顺势攻击**。这次攻击不造成伤害，但你会将本次创造的**符印**的复制品施加于每个被攻击命中的敌人（每份复制品都会作为一个独立的**符印**计入你**激活的符印**上限，上限为【**技能等级+1**】）。

en: At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may choose one ally who is able to hear you **or** one enemy you can see that is suffering from **dazed**, **enraged**, and/or **shaken**. Until the start of your next turn, the chosen creature becomes your **focus**. You gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to Checks you perform to examine your **focus**, as well as to your Accuracy Checks and Magic Checks for attacks and offensive spells (⚡) that include your **focus** among the targets. When you cause your focus to recover Hit Points and/or Mind Points, they recover【**SL × 2**】additional HP and/or MP, respectively.
it: All’inizio del tuo turno durante un conflitto, puoi scegliere un alleato in grado di sentirti **oppure** un nemico a te visibile che sia afflitto dallo status **confuso, furente** e/o **scosso**. Fino all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, la creatura scelta diventa il tuo **focus**. Ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai Test che effettui per esaminare il tuo **focus**, nonché ai tuoi Test di Precisione e Test di Magia per attacchi e incantesimi offensivi (⚡) che includono il tuo **focus** tra i bersagli. Quando fai recuperare Punti Vita e/o Punti Mente al tuo **focus**, gli fai recuperare rispettivamente 【**LA × 2**】 PV e/o PM addizionali.

Jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour, la créature choisie devient votre **sujet**. Vous gagnez un bonus égal à votre **【NC】** lors de vos tests effectués pour examiner votre **sujet**, ainsi qu’à vos tests de précision et de magie liés aux attaques et aux sorts offensifs (⚡) qui comprennent votre **sujet** parmi leurs cibles. Quand vous faites récupérer des Points de Vie et/ou de Magie à votre **sujet**, il en regagne **【NC × 2】** de plus.

Até o início do seu próximo turno, a criatura escolhida se torna o seu foco. Você ganha um bônus igual a 【NP】 aos testes que você realiza para examinar seu foco, bem como aos seus testes de precisão e testes mágicos para ataques e feitiços ofensivos (⚡) que incluem seu foco entre os alvos. Quando você faz com que seu foco recupere Pontos de Vida e/ou Pontos Mentais, eles recuperam 【NP× 2】 PV e/ou PM adicionais, respectivamente.
