zh-CN: 在冲突场景中你的回合开始时，你可以选择一名能听见你的言语的盟友，**或**一名你能看见且正处于**眩晕**、**激怒或动摇**状态的敌人。直到你的下一回合开始，所选生物将成为你的**焦点**。你在检视你的**焦点**而进行的检定中，以及目标包含该**焦点**的攻击和攻击性法术（OO）的命中检定与施法检定中，均获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。当你使你的**焦点**恢复生命值和/**或**精神值时，分别额外增加等同于【**技能等级×2**】的恢复量。

en: The total MP cost of your **spells** and **verses** (see **High Fantasy**, page **138**) that include your **focus** among their targets is reduced by【**SL**】, or by【**SL × 2**】if your **focus** is the only target (up to a minimum cost of 0 Mind Points).
it: Il costo totale in Punti Mente dei tuoi **incantesimi** e **versi** che includono il tuo **focus** tra i bersagli è ridotto di 【**LA**】, oppure di 【**LA × 2**】 se il tuo **focus** è l’**unico** bersaglio (fino a un costo minimo di 0 Punti Mente).
de: The total MP cost of your **spells** and **verses** (see **High Fantasy**, page **138**) that include your **focus** among their targets is reduced by【**SL**】, or by【**SL × 2**】if your **focus** is the only target (up to a minimum cost of 0 Mind Points).
fr: Le coût total en PM de vos **sorts** et de vos **couplets** (cf. **Atlas de high fantasy** page **138**) comprenant votre **sujet** parmi leurs cibles est réduit de **【NC】** ou de **【NC × 2】** si votre **sujet** en est la seule cible (pour un coût minimal de 0 Point de Magie).

zh-CN: 当你的**法术**和**乐章**（见《**史诗奇幻设定集**》第**138**页）的目标中包含你的**焦点**时，本次精神值总消耗减少【**技能等级**】点；若你的**焦点**是唯一目标，则本次精神值总消耗减少【**技能等级×2**】点（精神值消耗最低减少至0点）。

en: You can communicate telepathically with any conscious ally **within 1 travel day** of you; you are **able to hear each other** for the sake of Skills and effects. You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline. **Additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **transport creatures** in and out of the soul network, and to **gain information** and track entities while inside the soul network.
it: Puoi comunicare telepaticamente con ciascun alleato non privo di sensi entro **1 giorno di viaggio** da te; siete **reciprocamente in grado di sentirvi** ai fini di Abilità ed effetti. Puoi eseguire Rituali i cui effetti rientrino nella disciplina di **Ritualismo; in più**, puoi usare il Ritualismo per **trasportare creature** dentro e fuori dalla rete spirituale, nonché per **ottenere informazioni** e seguire le tracce di entità all’interno della rete spirituale.
de: You can communicate telepathically with any conscious ally **within 1 travel day** of you; you are **able to hear each other** for the sake of Skills and effects. You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline. **Additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **transport creatures** in and out of the soul network, and to **gain information** and track entities while inside the soul network.
fr: Vous pouvez communiquer télépathiquement avec tout allié conscient **situé dans un rayon d’un jour de voyage** autour de vous. On considère que vous êtes **capables de vous entendre l’un l’autre** dans le cadre des compétences et des autres effets. Vous recevez le pouvoir de réaliser des rituels de **Ritualisme**. **En outre**, vous pouvez vous servir du **Ritualisme** pour **transporter des créatures** à l’intérieur du réseau des âmes et les en faire sortir, ainsi que pour **recevoir des informations** sur des entités et les traquer lorsqu’elles sont dans le réseau en question.
es: You can communicate telepathically with any conscious ally **within 1 travel day** of you; you are **able to hear each other** for the sake of Skills and effects. You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline. **Additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **transport creatures** in and out of the soul network, and to **gain information** and track entities while inside the soul network.
pt-BR: Você pode se comunicar telepaticamente com qualquer aliado consciente dentro de 1 dia de viagem; vocês são capazes de ouvir uns aos outros por causa de poderes e efeitos. Você ganha o Poder de realizar Rituais da disciplina Ritualismo. Além disso, você pode usar o Ritualismo para transportar criaturas para dentro e para fora da rede da alma e para obter informações e rastrear entidades enquanto estiver dentro da rede da alma.

zh-CN: 你可以通过意念与**距离1个旅行日之内**的，未失去意识的盟友进行沟通。在判断技能使用或效果触发时，你们可以**听见彼此**。你获得启动**仪式系**仪式的能力。**此外**，你可以用仪式**传送生物**使其能出入灵魂网络。若你位于灵魂网络中，还可以通过仪式**获取信息**或追踪实体。

en: When you perform an Accuracy Check, you may replace one of the Attribute dice with **Willpower** (such as【**DEX + WLP**】for a **shortbow**). Additionally, your **melee** attacks with weapons belonging to the **arcane** or **sword** Categories may target **ﬂying** creatures.
it: Quando effettui un Test di Precisione, puoi sostituire **uno** dei dadi di Caratteristica con **Volontà** (ad esempio 【**DES + VOL**】 per un **arco corto**). Inoltre, i tuoi attacchi in **mischia** con armi appartenenti alle Categorie **arcana** o **spada** possono bersagliare le creature **volanti**.
de: When you perform an Accuracy Check, you may replace one of the Attribute dice with **Willpower** (such as【**DEX + WLP**】for a **shortbow**). Additionally, your **melee** attacks with weapons belonging to the **arcane** or **sword** Categories may target **ﬂying** creatures.
fr: Quand vous effectuez un test de précision, vous pouvez remplacer un des dés d’attribut par **Volonté** (par exemple **【DEX + VOL】** pour un **arc court**). En outre, les attaques de **corps à corps** que vous portez avec des armes de catégorie **arcanique** ou **épée** peuvent viser des créatures **volantes**.

pt-BR: Ao realizar uma Verificação de Precisão, você pode substituir um dos dados de Atributo por Força de Vontade (como 【DES + VON】 para um arco curto). Além disso, seus ataques corpo a corpo com armas pertencentes às categorias arcano ou espada podem ter como alvo criaturas voadoras.

zh-CN: 当你进行命中检定时，你可以将一个属性骰子替换为**意志**（例如使用【**敏捷+意志**】进行**短弓**攻击）。此外，你在使用**魔法类**或**剑类**武器进行**近战**攻击时，能够选择**飞行**生物作为目标。

en: Your **unarmed strikes** deal【**6 + (SL × 2)**】extra damage, and you gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Accuracy Checks with them. At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may choose a weapon Category other than **brawling**. If you do, your **unarmed strikes** now belong to the chosen Category; if you choose **bow**, **firearm** or **thrown**, they become **ranged** weapons instead of **melee**; if you choose **dagger** or **sword**, they cannot be used with **Triple Slash** (see **High Fantasy** Atlas, page **161**). These changes last until the start of your next turn.
it: I tuoi **colpi senz’armi** infliggono 【**6 + (LA × 2)**】 danni extra e ottieni un bonus pari a 【**LA**】 ai tuoi Test di Precisione con essi. All’inizio del tuo turno durante un conflitto, puoi scegliere una Categoria di arma diversa da **rissa**. Se lo fai, i tuoi **colpi senz’armi** appartengono ora a quella Categoria; se scegli **arco, da fuoco** o **da lancio**, diventano armi a **distanza** anziché da **mischia**; se scegli pugnale o spada, non possono essere usati con **Triplo Fendente**. Questi cambiamenti terminano all’inizio del tuo prossimo turno.
de: Your **unarmed strikes** deal【**6 + (SL × 2)**】extra damage, and you gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Accuracy Checks with them. At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may choose a weapon Category other than **brawling**. If you do, your **unarmed strikes** now belong to the chosen Category; if you choose **bow**, **firearm** or **thrown**, they become **ranged** weapons instead of **melee**; if you choose **dagger** or **sword**, they cannot be used with **Triple Slash** (see **High Fantasy** Atlas, page **161**). These changes last until the start of your next turn.
fr: Vos **attaques à mains nues** infligent **【6 + 【NC × 2】】** dégâts supplémentaires et vous bénéficiez d’un bonus égal à **【NC】** à leurs tests de précision. Au début de votre tour pendant un conflit, vous pouvez choisir une catégorie d’armes en dehors de lutte. Vos **attaques à mains nues** appartiennent désormais à la catégorie en question. Si vous choisissez **arc**, **arme à feu** ou **jet**, elles deviennent des armes **à distance** au lieu d’armes de **corps à corps**. Si vous choisissez **dague** ou **épée**, elles ne peuvent pas servir en conjonction avec **Triple entaille** (cf. **Atlas de high fantasy** page **161**). Ces changements durent jusqu’au début de votre prochain tour.
es: Your **unarmed strikes** deal【**6 + (SL × 2)**】extra damage, and you gain a bonus equal to【**SL**】to your Accuracy Checks with them. At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may choose a weapon Category other than **brawling**. If you do, your **unarmed strikes** now belong to the chosen Category; if you choose **bow**, **firearm** or **thrown**, they become **ranged** weapons instead of **melee**; if you choose **dagger** or **sword**, they cannot be used with **Triple Slash** (see **High Fantasy** Atlas, page **161**). These changes last until the start of your next turn.
pt-BR: Seus ataques desarmados causam 【6 + (NP× 2)】 de dano extra, e você ganha um bônus igual a 【NP】 em suas verificações de precisão com eles. No início do seu turno durante um conflito, você pode escolher uma categoria de arma diferente de briga. Se fizer isso, seus ataques desarmados agora pertencem à categoria escolhida; se você escolher arco, arma de fogo ou arremesso, eles se tornam armas de longo alcance em vez de corpo a corpo; se você escolher adaga ou espada, elas não poderão ser usadas com Corte Triplo (veja Atlas de Alta Fantasia, página 161). Essas mudanças duram até o início do seu próximo turno.

These changes last until the start of your next turn.
zh-CN: 你的**徒手攻击**造成等同于【**6+（技能等级×2**）】的额外伤害，且**徒手攻击**的命中检定获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值。在冲突场景中你的回合开始时，你可以选择一个**格斗类**以外的武器类型。如果你这样做，你的**徒手攻击**便归属于所选类型。如果你选择**弓类**、**枪械类**或**投掷类**，**徒手攻击**会从**近战**武器变为**远程**武器。如果你选择**匕首类**或**剑类**，**徒手攻击**无法用于**三连斩**（见《**史诗奇幻设定集**》第**161**页）。此变化持续到你的下一回合开始时。

en: After one of your attacks or offensive spells (⚡) causes one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you are in **Crisis**, you may recover【**SL × 5**】Hit Points.
it: Dopo che un tuo attacco o incantesimo offensivo (⚡) fa sì che uno o più nemici perdano Punti Vita, se sei in **Crisi**, puoi recuperare 【**LA × 5**】 Punti Vita.
de: After one of your attacks or offensive spells (⚡) causes one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you are in **Crisis**, you may recover【**SL × 5**】Hit Points.
fr: Après qu’une de vos attaques ou qu’un de vos sorts offensifs (⚡) fait perdre des Points de Vie à un ou plusieurs ennemis, si vous êtes en **Crise**, vous pouvez récupérer **【NC × 5】** Points de Vie.
es: After one of your attacks or offensive spells (⚡) causes one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you are in **Crisis**, you may recover【**SL × 5**】Hit Points.
pt-BR: Após um de seus ataques ou feitiços ofensivos (⚡) fazer com que um ou mais inimigos percam Pontos de Vida, se você estiver em Crise, você poderá recuperar 【NP × 5】 Pontos de Vida.
ru: After one of your attacks or offensive spells (⚡) causes one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you are in **Crisis**, you may recover【**SL × 5**】Hit Points.
pl: After one of your attacks or offensive spells (⚡) causes one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you are in **Crisis**, you may recover【**SL × 5**】Hit Points.
zh-CN: 在你的攻击或攻击性法术（OO）对一名或多名敌人造成伤害后，若你处于**危机状态**，则可以恢复等同于【**技能等级×5**】的生命值。

en: After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage had a type **other than physical**, you may spend 10 hp]to gain Resistance to that damage type until you use this Skill again. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP.
it: Dopo che una fonte di danno ti fa perdere Punti Vita, se quel danno aveva un tipo **diverso da fisico**, puoi spendere 10 PV per ottenere Resistenza a quel tipo di danno finché non usi di nuovo questa Abilità. Non puoi usare questa Abilità se farlo ridurrebbe a 0 i tuoi PV.
de: After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage had a type **other than physical**, you may spend 10 hp]to gain Resistance to that damage type until you use this Skill again. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP.
fr: Après avoir perdu des Points de Vie à cause de dégâts, si ceux-ci étaient d’un **autre type que physiques**, vous pouvez dépenser 10 Points de Vie pour résister à ce type de dégâts jusqu’à ce que vous utilisiez de nouveau cette compétence.
es: After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage had a type **other than physical**, you may spend 10 hp]to gain Resistance to that damage type until you use this Skill again. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP.
pt-BR: Depois de perder Pontos de Vida devido a dano, se esse dano tiver um tipo diferente de físico, você poderá gastar 10 PV para ganhar Resistência a esse tipo de dano até usar esse Poder novamente. Você não pode usar esse Poder se isso reduziria seu PV a 0.
ru: After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage had a type **other than physical**, you may spend 10 hp]to gain Resistance to that damage type until you use this Skill again. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP.
pl: After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage had a type **other than physical**, you may spend 10 hp]to gain Resistance to that damage type until you use this Skill again. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP.
zh-CN: 当你因受到伤害而失去生命值后，如果该伤害的类型**不为物理**，你可以消耗10点生命值来获得对该伤害类型的抵抗相性，此效果持续到你再次使用此技能为止。

en: When you deal damage to one or more NPCs, you learn their **Species and the GM chooses**【**SL**】**therioforms** appropriate to those NPCs: if you have acquired the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, you may immediately pay its HP cost and use it to manifest those **therioforms** (even if they are not among those you have learned).
it: Quando infliggi danno a uno o più PNG, scopri la loro **Specie** e il GM sceglie 【**LA**】 **terioforme** che ritiene tematiche per quei PNG: se possiedi l’Abilità **Teriomorfosi**, puoi immediatamente usarla, pagando il relativo costo in PV per manifestarle (anche se non sono tra quelle che hai imparato).
de: When you deal damage to one or more NPCs, you learn their **Species and the GM chooses**【**SL**】**therioforms** appropriate to those NPCs: if you have acquired the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, you may immediately pay its HP cost and use it to manifest those **therioforms** (even if they are not among those you have learned).
fr: Quand vous infligez des dégâts à un ou plusieurs PNJ, vous apprenez leur **espèce et le MJ choisit 【NC】 thérioformes** adaptées à ces PNJ (cf. page suivante). Si vous avez acquis la compétence **Thériomorphose**, vous pouvez immédiatement en payer le coût en PV et l’utiliser pour manifester ces **thérioformes** (même si elles ne font pas partie de celles que vous avez apprises).
es: When you deal damage to one or more NPCs, you learn their **Species and the GM chooses**【**SL**】**therioforms** appropriate to those NPCs: if you have acquired the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, you may immediately pay its HP cost and use it to manifest those **therioforms** (even if they are not among those you have learned).
pt-BR: Quando você causa dano a um ou mais PNJs, você aprende suas Espécies e o Mestre escolhe 【NP】 as terioformas apropriadas para esses PNJs (veja a próxima página): se você adquiriu o Poder Teriomorfose, você pode pagar imediatamente seu custo de PV e usá-la para manifestar essas terioformas (mesmo que não estejam entre aquelas que você aprendeu).
ru: When you deal damage to one or more NPCs, you learn their **Species and the GM chooses**【**SL**】**therioforms** appropriate to those NPCs: if you have acquired the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, you may immediately pay its HP cost and use it to manifest those **therioforms** (even if they are not among those you have learned).
pl: When you deal damage to one or more NPCs, you learn their **Species and the GM chooses**【**SL**】**therioforms** appropriate to those NPCs: if you have acquired the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, you may immediately pay its HP cost and use it to manifest those **therioforms** (even if they are not among those you have learned).
zh-CN: 当你对一个或多个NPC造成伤害时，你可以知晓他们的**物种类型，然后游戏主持人会选择**数量等同于【**技能等级**】且适合这些NPC的**野兽形态**（见下一页）。如果你已习得**野兽变异**技能，就可以立刻支付技能所需的生命值消耗，并使用该技能来显现这些**野兽形态**（即便是你尚未学习的形态）。

en: Each time you acquire this Skill, you learn a **therioform**. You may use an action and spend **one third of your current Hit Points** (rounded down) to manifest the effects of **up to two therioforms** you have learned.
it: Ogni volta che acquisici questa Abilità, impari una **terioforma**. Puoi usare un’azione e spendere **un terzo dei tuoi Punti Vita attuali** (arrotondato per difetto) per manifestare gli effetti di **fino a due terioforme** tra quelle che hai imparato.
de: Each time you acquire this Skill, you learn a **therioform**. You may use an action and spend **one third of your current Hit Points** (rounded down) to manifest the effects of **up to two therioforms** you have learned.
fr: Chaque fois que vous acquérez cette compétence, vous apprenez une **thérioforme**. Vous pouvez utiliser une action et dépenser **un tiers de vos Points de Vie actuels** (arrondi à l’entier inférieur) pour manifester les effets d’au **maximum deux thérioformes** parmi celles que vous avez apprises. Les détails de cette transformation figurent page suivante.
es: Each time you acquire this Skill, you learn a **therioform**. You may use an action and spend **one third of your current Hit Points** (rounded down) to manifest the effects of **up to two therioforms** you have learned.
pt-BR: Cada vez que você adquire esse Poder, você aprende uma terioforma. Você pode usar uma ação e gastar um terço de seus Pontos de Vida atuais (arredondados para baixo) para manifestar os efeitos de até duas terioformas que você aprendeu. Os detalhes dessa transformação são explicados na próxima página.
ru: Each time you acquire this Skill, you learn a **therioform**. You may use an action and spend **one third of your current Hit Points** (rounded down) to manifest the effects of **up to two therioforms** you have learned.

zh-CN: 每当你习得此技能时，你都能学会一种**野兽形态**（见下一页）。作为一次行动，你可以消耗你**当前生命值的三分之一**（向下取整），以显现你已习得的**最多两种野兽形态**的效果。此变形的详情将在下一页说明。

en: As long as there is no one aboard your **personal vehicle**, you may have it safely disappear from the game world at any time. What magic or technology allows it?If your **personal vehicle** is not present in the game world and you are in a space big enough to contain it, you may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to have the vehicle appear near you and **enter** it for free.
it: Se non c’è nessuno a bordo del tuo **veicolo personale**, puoi farlo svanire in sicurezza dal mondo di gioco in qualsiasi momento. Quale magia o scienza lo permette? Se il tuo **veicolo personale** è assente dal mondo di gioco e sei in un’area grande abbastanza da contenerlo, puoi eseguire l’azione di **Inventario** e spendere 2 Punti Inventario per farlo apparire a pochi passi da te e **salirvi** gratuitamente.
de: As long as there is no one aboard your **personal vehicle**, you may have it safely disappear from the game world at any time. What magic or technology allows it?If your **personal vehicle** is not present in the game world and you are in a space big enough to contain it, you may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to have the vehicle appear near you and **enter** it for free.
fr: Tant qu’il n’y a personne à bord de votre **véhicule personnel**, vous pouvez le faire disparaître sans danger du monde de jeu à tout moment. Par quelle magie ou technologie cela est-il possible ? Si votre **véhicule personnel** n’est pas présent dans le monde de jeu et que vous occupez un espace assez vaste pour le contenir, vous pouvez réaliser l’action **Inventaire** et dépenser 2 points d’Inventaire pour qu’il apparaisse près de vous et y **entrer** gratuitement.
es: As long as there is no one aboard your **personal vehicle**, you may have it safely disappear from the game world at any time. What magic or technology allows it?If your **personal vehicle** is not present in the game world and you are in a space big enough to contain it, you may perform the **Inventory** action and spend 2 Inventory Points to have the vehicle appear near you and **enter** it for free.
pt-BR: Contanto que não haja ninguém a bordo do seu veículo pessoal, você poderá fazer com que ele desapareça com segurança do mundo do jogo a qualquer momento. Que magia ou tecnologia permite isso? Se o seu veículo pessoal não estiver presente no mundo do jogo e você estiver em um espaço grande o suficiente para contê-lo, você pode realizar a ação de Inventário e gastar 2 PI para que o veículo apareça perto de você e entre nele de graça.

zh-CN: 只要你的**个人载具**上没有人，你可以随时让它从游戏世界中消失。这是采用了什么样的魔法或科技？如果你的**个人载具**不在游戏世界中，且你身处于一个足以容纳该载具的空间内，你可以执行**消耗物资**行动，消耗2点物资点使其出现在你附近，并且你可以**进入**该载具而无需消耗行动。

en: When you perform the **Equipment** or **Guard** action while driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose up to 【**SL**】 of its enabled modules and disable them. If you do, choose up to 【**SL**】 among its disabled modules and enable them.
it: Quando esegui l’azione di **Equipaggiamento** o di **Guardia**, se sei alla guida del tuo **veicolo personale**, puoi scegliere fino a 【**LA**】 tra i suoi moduli abilitati e **disabilitarli**; se lo fai, scegli altrettanti tra i suoi moduli disabilitati e **abilitali**.
de: When you perform the **Equipment** or **Guard** action while driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose up to 【**SL**】 of its enabled modules and disable them. If you do, choose up to 【**SL**】 among its disabled modules and enable them.
fr: Quand vous réalisez l’action **Équipement** ou **Garde** aux commandes de votre **véhicule personnel**, vous pouvez désigner jusqu’à **【NC】** modules activés à bord et les **désactiver**. Ensuite, vous pouvez choisir une quantité inférieure ou égale de modules désactivés pour les **activer**.
es: When you perform the **Equipment** or **Guard** action while driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose up to 【**SL**】 of its enabled modules and disable them. If you do, choose up to 【**SL**】 among its disabled modules and enable them.
pt-BR: Ao realizar a ação de Equipamento ou Guarda enquanto dirige seu veículo pessoal, você pode escolher até 【NP】 de seus módulos habilitados e desativá-los. Se você fizer isso, escolha uma quantidade igual de módulos desabilitados e ative-os.
ru: When you perform the **Equipment** or **Guard** action while driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose up to 【**SL**】 of its enabled modules and disable them. If you do, choose up to 【**SL**】 among its disabled modules and enable them.
pl: When you perform the **Equipment** or **Guard** action while driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose up to 【**SL**】 of its enabled modules and disable them. If you do, choose up to 【**SL**】 among its disabled modules and enable them.
zh-CN: 当你正驾驶你的**个人载具**时，你可以执行**装备**或**防御**行动，选择数量最多为【**技能等级**】的已启用模块，并将它们停用。如果你这样做，你可以再选择数量最多为【上一步骤中所选模块数量】的已停用模块，并将它们启用。

en: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option: the next time you deal damage during this turn, deal【**SL × 2**】extra damage; **or** the next time you suffer damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by【**SL × 2**】(applied **before** damage Affinities); **or** you recover from a status effect of your choice among **slow** and **weak**.
it: All’inizio del tuo turno durante un conflitto, se sei alla guida del tuo **veicolo personale**, puoi spendere 10 PM. Se lo fai, scegli un’opzione: la prossima volta che infliggi danno durante questo turno, infliggi 【**LA × 2**】 danni extra; **oppure**, la prossima volta che subisci danno prima dell’inizio del tuo prossimo turno, quel danno è ridotto di 【**LA × 2**】 (**prima** di applicare le Affinità); **oppure**, guarisci da uno status a scelta tra **debole** e **lento**.
de: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option: the next time you deal damage during this turn, deal【**SL × 2**】extra damage; **or** the next time you suffer damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by【**SL × 2**】(applied **before** damage Affinities); **or** you recover from a status effect of your choice among **slow** and **weak**.
fr: Au début de votre tour pendant un conflit, si vous pilotez votre **véhicule personnel**, vous pouvez dépenser 10 Points de Magie et choisir une option : la prochaine fois que vous infligez des dégâts durant ce tour, vous en infligez **【NC × 2】** de plus ; **OU** la prochaine fois que vous subissez des dégâts avant le début de votre prochain tour, ils diminuent de **【NC × 2】** (à appliquer **avant** les affinités aux dégâts) ; **OU** vous vous remettez de l’état **ralenti** ou **affaibli** (à vous de choisir).
es: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option: the next time you deal damage during this turn, deal【**SL × 2**】extra damage; **or** the next time you suffer damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by【**SL × 2**】(applied **before** damage Affinities); **or** you recover from a status effect of your choice among **slow** and **weak**.
pt-BR: No início do seu turno durante um conflito, se você estiver dirigindo seu veículo pessoal, você poderá gastar 10 PM. Se fizer isso, escolha uma opção: na próxima vez que você causar dano durante este turno, cause 【NP × 2】 dano extra; ou, na próxima vez que você sofrer dano antes do início do seu próximo turno, esse dano será reduzido em 【NP × 2】 (aplicado antes das Afinidades de dano); ou você se recupera de um efeito de status de sua escolha entre lento e fraco.
ru: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option: the next time you deal damage during this turn, deal【**SL × 2**】extra damage; **or** the next time you suffer damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by【**SL × 2**】(applied **before** damage Affinities); **or** you recover from a status effect of your choice among **slow** and **weak**.
pl: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option: the next time you deal damage during this turn, deal【**SL × 2**】extra damage; **or** the next time you suffer damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by【**SL × 2**】(applied **before** damage Affinities); **or** you recover from a status effect of your choice among **slow** and **weak**.
zh-CN: 在冲突场景中你的回合开始时，如果你正在驾驶你的**个人载具**，你可以消耗10点精神值，并从以下选项中选择一项：在本回合中，你下一次造成伤害时，造成等同于【**技能等级×2**】的额外伤害；**或**在下一回合开始**前**，你下一次受到伤害时，伤害量减少【**技能等级×2**】点（先于伤害相性结算）；**或**你解除自身的**迟缓或虚弱**状态（由你选择）。

en: When you acquire this Skill, you gain a **personal vehicle** with a **frame** of your choice and **three different modules** of your choice. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you acquire **two additional modules** of your choice.
it: Quando acquisisci questa Abilità, ottieni un **veicolo personale** con una **struttura** a tua scelta e **tre moduli differenti** a tua scelta. Ogni volta che acquisisci nuovamente questa Abilità, ottieni **due moduli** a tua scelta.
de: When you acquire this Skill, you gain a **personal vehicle** with a **frame** of your choice and **three different modules** of your choice. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you acquire **two additional modules** of your choice.
fr: Quand vous acquérez cette compétence, vous recevez un **véhicule personnel** de l’**ossature** de votre choix accompagné de **trois modules** différents, de votre choix. Chaque fois que vous obtenez de nouveau cette compétence, vous recevez **deux modules supplémentaires** de votre choix.
es: When you acquire this Skill, you gain a **personal vehicle** with a **frame** of your choice and **three different modules** of your choice. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you acquire **two additional modules** of your choice.
pt-BR: Ao adquirir esse Poder, você ganha um veículo pessoal com quadro à sua escolha e três módulos diferentes à sua escolha. Sempre que adquirir esse Poder novamente, você adquire dois módulos adicionais à sua escolha.
ru: When you acquire this Skill, you gain a **personal vehicle** with a **frame** of your choice and **three different modules** of your choice. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you acquire **two additional modules** of your choice.
pl: When you acquire this Skill, you gain a **personal vehicle** with a **frame** of your choice and **three different modules** of your choice. Whenever you acquire this Skill again, you acquire **two additional modules** of your choice.
zh-CN: 当你习得此技能时，你获得一部**个人载具**，你可以为这部载具选择一种**框架**和**三个不同的模块**（见下页）。每当你再次习得此技能时，你可以为你的载具**额外选择两个模块**。

en: When you perform an Accuracy Check with a **weapon module**, you may replace **one** of the Attributes with **Might** (such as【**MIG + WLP**】for an **arcane module**).

en: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, or **ice**. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance against the chosen damage type.
it: Plasmi l’energia magica e proteggi i bersagli dalla furia degli elementi. Scegli un tipo di danno: aria, fulmine, fuoco, ghiaccio o terra. Finché questo incantesimo è attivo, ciascun bersaglio ottiene Resistenza al tipo di danno scelto.
de: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, or **ice**. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance against the chosen damage type.
fr: Vous tissez un voile d’énergie magique qui protège les cibles des éléments déchaînés. Choisissez un type de magie : **air**, **foudre**, **terre**, **feu** ou **glace**. Tant que ce sort fait effet, chaque cible bénéficie d’une résistance face au type de dégâts choisi.

en:
You imbue a **weapon** with elemental energy. Choose a damage type: **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, or **ice**. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the **weapon** becomes of the chosen damage type. If you have that **weapon** equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a **weapon** equipped by a willing creature.
it:
Infondi energia elementale in un’arma. Scegli un tipo di danno: aria, fulmine, fuoco, ghiaccio o terra. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, il danno inflitto dall’arma diventa del tipo scelto. Se hai quell’arma equipaggiata mentre lanci questo incantesimo, puoi eseguire un attacco gratuito con essa come parte della stessa azione.
Puoi lanciare questo incantesimo solo su armi equipaggiate da creature consenzienti.
de: You imbue a weapon with elemental energy. Choose a damage type: **air**, **bolt**, **earth**, **fire**, or **ice**. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the chosen damage type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
fr: Vous imprégnez une arme d’énergie magique. Choisissez un type de dégâts : **air**, **foudre**, **terre**, **feu** ou **glace**. Tant que ce sort fait effet, tous les dégâts infligés par l’arme sont du type choisi. Si vous êtes équipé de l’arme lorsque vous lancez ce sort, vous pouvez l’utiliser pour réaliser une **attaque gratuite** dans la même action. Ce sort ne peut être lancé que sur l’arme d’une créature volontaire.

Se você tiver aquela arma equipada enquanto lança esta magia, você pode realizar um ataque livre com ela como parte da mesma ação. Este feitiço só pode ser lançado em uma arma equipada por uma criatura voluntária.

en: The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack may target creatures that can only be targeted by **ranged** attacks. If you used a weapon belonging to the **brawling**, **spear**, or **sword** Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage. If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.
it:
Il vento trasposta i tuoi colpi attraverso il campo di battaglia. Puoi immediatamente esguire un attacco gratuito con un’arma da mischia equipaggiata. Questo attacco può
bersagliare creature che possono essere bersagliate solo da attacchi a distanza.
Se hai usato un’arma della Categoria lancia o da rissa per questo attacco, infligge 5 danni extra.
Se colpisci un bersaglio volante con questo attacco, puoi obbligarlo ad atterrare.
de: The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **melee** weapon you have equipped. This attack may target creatures that can only be targeted by **ranged** attacks. If you used a weapon belonging to the **brawling**, **spear**, or **sword** Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage. If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.
fr: Le vent porte vos attaques à l’autre bout du champ de bataille. Vous pouvez immédiatement réaliser une **attaque gratuite** avec une arme de **corps à corps** dont vous êtes équipé. Cette attaque peut prendre pour cible des créatures qu’on ne peut viser qu’avec des attaques **à distance**. Si vous utilisez une arme de catégorie **lutte** ou **lance**, l’attaque inflige 5 dégâts de plus. Si vous touchez une cible volante à l’aide de cette attaque, vous pouvez la forcer à atterrir immédiatement.

Se você usar, para esse ataque, uma arma da Categoria **briga**, **lança** ou **espada**, ele causa 5 de dano extra. Se atingir um alvo voador com esse ataque, você pode forçá-lo a pousar imediatamente.

zh-CN: 疾风裹挟着你的攻势席卷战场。你可以使用当前装备的一件**近战**武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。此次攻击可以将通常无法被**近战**攻击选中的敌人作为目标。如果你使用的武器属于**格斗类**、**长柄类**或**剑类**，那么本次攻击还将造成5点额外伤害。如果你此次攻击命中了飞行中的目标，可以迫使对方立刻落地。

en: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**earth** damage. This spell cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
it:
Guglie di pietra affilata sorgono dal terreno sotto i nemici, avvolgendoli. Ciascun bersaglio colpito subisce【TM + 15】 danni da terra. Questo incantesimo non può
bersagliare creature che stanno volando, fluttuando, cadendo o che si trovano a mezz’aria.
Opportunità: ciascun bersaglio colpito esegue un’azione in meno durante il suo prossimo turno (fino a un minimo di zero azioni).
de: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**earth** damage. pl: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**earth** damage. This spell cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
zh-CN: 嶙峋岩柱破土而出，将敌人困入其中。你对每个被此法术命中的目标造成【**高值+15**】的**土系**伤害。此法术无法将飞行、漂浮、坠落中或是以其他方式位于半空的生物作为目标。**机会：**所有被此法术命中的生物在其自身的下个回合中少执行一次行动（行动次数最低减至0）。

en:
You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. 
You deal 【**HR + 25**】**bolt** damage to the target target; this damage ignores Resistances.
it:
Scagli una saetta sfolgorante verso il nemico. Il bersaglio subisce【TM + 25】 danni da fulmine.
I danni inflitti da questo incantesimo ignorano le Resistenze.
de:
You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. 
You deal 【**HR + 25**】**bolt** damage to the target target; this damage ignores Resistances.
fr: Vous lancez un éclair sur votre adversaire. La cible subit **【VH + 25】** dégâts de **foudre**. Les dégâts infligés par ce sort ignorent les résistances.
es:
You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. 
You deal 【**HR + 25**】**bolt** damage to the target target; this damage ignores Resistances.
pt-BR: Você envia um raio atingindo seu inimigo. O alvo sofre dano de raio 【RA + 25】. O dano causado por este feitiço ignora as Resistências.
ru:
You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. 
You deal 【**HR + 25**】**bolt** damage to the target target; this damage ignores Resistances.
pl:
You send an arrow of overcharged lightning striking at your foe. 
You deal 【**HR + 25**】**bolt** damage to the target target; this damage ignores Resistances.
zh-CN: 你将一道闪电劈向敌人。你对目标造成【**高值+25**】的**雷系**伤害。此法术造成的伤害无视抵抗相性。

en: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**air** damage. **Opportunity:** Each **flying** target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.
it:
Evochi il potere dei venti contro i tuoi nemici. Ciascun bersaglio colpito subisce【TM + 15】 danni da aria.
Opportunità: ciascun bersaglio volante colpito deve atterrare immediatamente.
de: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**air** damage. **Opportunity:** Each **flying** target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.
fr: Vous invoquez la puissance des vents contre votre ennemi. Chaque cible touchée par ce sort subit **【VH + 15】** dégâts d’**air**. **Aubaine** : chaque cible **volante** touchée par ce sort est immédiatement forcée d’atterrir.
es: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**air** damage. **Opportunity:** Each **flying** target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.
pt-BR: Você invoca o poder dos ventos contra seu inimigo. Cada alvo atingido por este feitiço sofre 【RA + 15】 dano aéreo. Oportunidade: Cada alvo voador atingido por este feitiço é forçado a pousar imediatamente.
ru: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**air** damage. **Opportunity:** Each **flying** target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.
pl: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**air** damage. **Opportunity:** Each **flying** target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.
zh-CN: 你召唤风的力量对抗敌人。你对每个被此法术命中的目标造成【**高值+15**】的**风系**伤害。**机会：**被此法术命中的**飞行**生物将被迫立刻落地。

en: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal 【**HR + 25**】 air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
it: Un vento feroce ti circonda, deviando frecce e proiettili. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, ottieni un bonus di +2 alla tua Difesa contro gli attacchi a distanza.
de: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal 【**HR + 25**】 air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
fr: Un véritable ouragan vous entoure, déviant flèches et balles. Jusqu’à ce que les effets de ce sort s’achèvent, vous bénéficiez d’un bonus de +2 à la Défense contre les attaques **à distance**.
es: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal 【**HR + 25**】 air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
pt-BR: Você corta seu oponente com vento de alta pressão. Você causa 【**RA + 25**】 de dano de ar ao alvo; esse dano ignora Resistências.
ru: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal 【**HR + 25**】 air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
pl: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal 【**HR + 25**】 air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.
zh-CN: 你将高压气流化为风刃攻击敌人。你对目标造成【**高值+25**】的风系伤害，此法术造成的伤害无视抵抗相性。

en: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose **one** option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total MP cost equal to or lower than 10** (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
it: Pieghi il tessuto del tempo. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, il bersaglio può eseguire un’azione aggiuntiva durante ciascuno dei suoi turni. Dopo che il bersaglio ha eseguito due azioni aggiuntive in questo modo, questo incantesimo termina.
de: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose **one** option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total MP cost equal to or lower than 10** (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
fr: Vous altérez la trame du temps. Jusqu’à ce que cesse l’effet de ce sort, la cible a le pouvoir d’effectuer une action de plus à chacun de ses tours. Une fois qu’elle a réalisé un total de deux actions supplémentaires permises par ce sort, les effets de celui-ci s’achèvent.
es: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose **one** option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total MP cost equal to or lower than 10** (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
pt-BR: Ao fim de cada um dos turnos do alvo, ele pode escolher **uma** opção: realizar um **ataque gratuito** com uma arma que tenha equipada; ou realizar a ação **Feitiço** gratuitamente, conjurando um Feitiço com **custo total em PM igual ou inferior a 10** (pagando seu custo em PM). Depois que a mesma criatura se beneficiar deste efeito pela segunda vez, este Feitiço termina.
ru: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose **one** option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total MP cost equal to or lower than 10** (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
pl: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose **one** option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total MP cost equal to or lower than 10** (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
zh-CN: 在该目标的每个回合结束时，他可以选择一项触发：使用他正装备的一件武器进行**顺势攻击**；或执行一次类型为**施法**的顺势行动，所施放法术的**精神值总消耗不得高于10点**（需如常支付其精神值消耗）。在同**一个**生物从单次法术效果中第二次获得增益后，此法术效果结束。

en: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.
it: Alteri la natura stessa del bersaglio. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, se il bersaglio subisce danni di un tipo che Assorbe o a cui è Immune, viene invece considerato Vulnerabile a essi. Quando ciò accade, questo incantesimo termina.
de: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.
fr: Vous altérez la nature de votre cible. Jusqu’à ce que l’effet de ce sort cesse, lorsqu’elle subit des dégâts d’un type qu’elle absorbe ou contre lesquels elle est immunisée, ils sont traités comme si elle y était vulnérable au contraire. Une fois que cela s’est produit, l’effet du sort s’achève.
es: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.
pt-BR: Você altera a própria natureza do seu alvo. Até que este feitiço termine, se o alvo sofrer dano de um tipo que ele Absorve ou ao qual é Imune, ele será tratado como se fosse Vulnerável a esse tipo de dano. Quando isso acontecer, o feitiço termina.
ru: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.
pl: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.
zh-CN: 你改变了目标的自然本质。在此法术效果结束前，如果目标受到的伤害属于原本可被其吸收或免疫的伤害类型，则将他视为对该伤害类型具有弱点，原有的相性不再生效。如果出现上述情形，此法术效果便会立即结束。

en:
You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes **dark**. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
it:
Avvolgi un’arma nelle tenebre. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, tutto il danno inflitto dall’arma diventa ombra. Se hai quell’arma equipaggiata mentre lanci questo incantesimo,puoi eseguire un attacco gratuito con essa come parte della stessa azione.
Puoi lanciare questo incantesimo solo su armi equipaggiate da creature consenzienti.
de:
You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes **dark**. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
fr: Vous imprégnez une arme d’énergie ténébreuse. Tant que ce sort fait effet, tous les dégâts infligés par l’arme sont de type **ténèbres**. Si vous êtes équipé de l’arme lorsque vous lancez ce sort, vous pouvez l’utiliser pour réaliser une **attaque gratuite** dans la même action. Ce sort ne peut être lancé que sur l’arme d’une créature volontaire.
es:
You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes **dark**. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
pt-BR:
Você imbui uma arma com energia de **trevas**. Até o fim deste Feitiço, todo o dano causado pela arma se torna de **trevas**. Se tiver essa arma equipada ao conjurar este Feitiço, você pode realizar um **ataque gratuito** com ela como parte da mesma ação.
Este Feitiço só pode ser conjurado sobre uma arma equipada por uma criatura disposta.
ru:
You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes **dark**. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
pl:
You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes **dark**. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action.
This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
zh-CN: 你将黑暗能量注入一件武器。这件武器造成的所有伤害都会变为**暗系**伤害，直至此法术效果结束。如果你在施放此法术时正装备着这件武器，便可以使用该武器进行一次**顺势攻击**，此攻击视为本次行动的一部分。此法术只能对自愿获得这项增益的生物所装备的武器施放。

en: You release a wave of negative energy and cleanse all magic from a creature. If the target is affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of Scene, they are no longer affected by any of those spells instead.
it: Un’onda di energia negativa spezza gli incantesimi presenti su una creatura. Se il bersaglio è sotto l’effetto di uno o più incantesimi con durata “Scena”, invece non è più sotto l’effetto di quegli incantesimi.
de: You release a wave of negative energy and cleanse all magic from a creature. If the target is affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of Scene, they are no longer affected by any of those spells instead.
fr: Vous libérez une vague d’énergie négative qui dissipe toute magie d’une créature. Si la cible était sous l’effet d’un ou plusieurs sorts dont la **durée** est d’une scène, leur effet sur elle s’arrête immédiatement.
es: You release a wave of negative energy and cleanse all magic from a creature. If the target is affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of Scene, they are no longer affected by any of those spells instead.
pt-BR: Você libera uma onda de energia negativa e limpa toda a magia de uma criatura. Se o alvo for afetado por um ou mais feitiços com duração de Cena, ele não será mais afetado por nenhum desses feitiços.
ru: You release a wave of negative energy and cleanse all magic from a creature. If the target is affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of Scene, they are no longer affected by any of those spells instead.
pl: You release a wave of negative energy and cleanse all magic from a creature. If the target is affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of Scene, they are no longer affected by any of those spells instead.
zh-CN: 你净化了这个生物所承受的所有魔法效果。如果目标正在被一个或多个**持续时间**为“场景”的法术影响，那么这些法术将不再对该目标生效。

en: You glimpse briefly into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see performs a Check, if it was not a **fumble** nor a **critical success**, you may force that creature to reroll **both** dice. Once you have forced **two** rerolls this way, this spell ends.
it: Hai una premonizione. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, dopo che una creatura a te visibile effettua un Test, se non è un fallimento critico o successo critico, puoi farle ritirare entrambi i dadi. Dopo aver causato due ritiri in questo modo, questo incantesimo termina.
de: You glimpse briefly into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see performs a Check, if it was not a **fumble** nor a **critical success**, you may force that creature to reroll **both** dice. Once you have forced **two** rerolls this way, this spell ends.
fr: Vous avez un bref aperçu de l’avenir. Jusqu’à la fin de l’effet de ce sort, lorsqu’une créature que vous voyez effectue un test, s’il ne s’agit ni d’un **échec critique** ni d’une **réussite critique**, vous pouvez la forcer à relancer **les deux** dés. Une fois que vous avez forcé **deux** relances de la sorte, l’effet de ce sort s’achève.
es: You glimpse briefly into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see performs a Check, if it was not a **fumble** nor a **critical success**, you may force that creature to reroll **both** dice. Once you have forced **two** rerolls this way, this spell ends.
pt-BR: Você vislumbra brevemente o futuro. Até que esta magia termine, depois que uma criatura que você pode ver realizar um Teste, se não foi um desastre nem um sucesso crítico, você pode forçar aquela criatura a rolar novamente ambos os dados. Depois de forçar duas novas jogadas desta forma, este feitiço termina.
ru: You glimpse briefly into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see performs a Check, if it was not a **fumble** nor a **critical success**, you may force that creature to reroll **both** dice. Once you have forced **two** rerolls this way, this spell ends.
pl: You glimpse briefly into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see performs a Check, if it was not a **fumble** nor a **critical success**, you may force that creature to reroll **both** dice. Once you have forced **two** rerolls this way, this spell ends.
zh-CN: 你向未来投去匆匆一瞥。在此法术效果结束前，如果一个你能看见的生物进行检定且未掷出**大失败**或**大成功**，你便可以强迫该生物将**两枚**骰子全部重掷一次。当你以此方式强制进行**两次**重掷后，此法术效果便会立即结束。

en: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses【**HR + 20**】Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
it: Consumi la psiche di una creatura. Il bersaglio perde【TM + 20】 Punti Mente, e recuperi un ammontare di Punti Mente pari a metà dei Punti Mente persi dal bersaglio (se la perdita è stata ridotta a 0 in qualche modo, non recuperi Punti Mente).
de: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses【**HR + 20**】Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
fr: Vous absorbez l’énergie psychique d’une créature. La cible perd **【VH + 20】** Points de Magie. Ensuite, vous récupérez un nombre de Points de Magie égal à la moitié des points perdus (si la perte en question a été réduite à 0 d’une façon ou d’une autre, vous ne gagnez rien).
es: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses【**HR + 20**】Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
pt-BR: Você consome a psique de uma criatura. O alvo perde 【**RA + 20**】 Pontos de Mente. Depois, você recupera uma quantidade de Pontos de Mente igual à metade da perda de Pontos de Mente sofrida por ele (se essa perda for reduzida a 0 de alguma forma, você não recupera nada).
ru: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses【**HR + 20**】Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
pl: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses【**HR + 20**】Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
zh-CN: 你吞噬了一个生物的心力。目标失去【**高值+20**】的精神值。随后，你恢复等同于【目标此次精神值损失量一半】的精神值（如果目标精神值归零，那么你不会恢复精神值）。

en:
"You steal another creature’s life force. You deal 【**HR + 15**】**dark**  damage to the target.
Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none)."
it: Assorbi la vitalità altrui. Il bersaglio subisce【TM + 15】 danni da ombra, e recuperi un ammontare di Punti Vita pari a metà dei Punti Vita persi dal bersaglio (se la perdita è stata ridotta a 0 in qualche modo, non recuperi Punti Vita).
de:
"You steal another creature’s life force. You deal 【**HR + 15**】**dark**  damage to the target.
Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none)."
fr: Vous volez l’énergie vitale d’une créature. La cible subit **【VH + 15】** dégâts de **ténèbres**. Ensuite, vous récupérez un nombre de Points de Vie égal à la moitié des points perdus (si la perte en question a été réduite à 0 d’une façon ou d’une autre, vous ne gagnez rien).
es:
"You steal another creature’s life force. You deal 【**HR + 15**】**dark**  damage to the target.
Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none)."
pt-BR: Você rouba a força vital de outra criatura. O alvo sofre 【RA + 15】de dano trevas . Então, você recupera uma quantidade de Pontos de Vida igual à metade da perda de Pontos de Vida que eles sofreram (se a perda foi reduzida a 0 de alguma forma, você não recupera nenhum).
ru:
"You steal another creature’s life force. You deal 【**HR + 15**】**dark**  damage to the target.
Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none)."
pl:
"You steal another creature’s life force. You deal 【**HR + 15**】**dark**  damage to the target.
Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none)."
zh-CN: 你窃取了另一个生物的生命力。你对目标造成【**高值+15**】的**暗系**伤害。随后，你恢复等同于【目标此次生命值损失量一半】的生命值（如果目标的生命值归零，那么你不会恢复生命值）。

en: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (⚡), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.
it: Pieghi le leggi della magia. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, se un incantesimo offensivo (⚡) viene lanciato sul bersaglio, la creatura che ha lanciato l’incantesimo offensivo in questione viene bersagliata al suo posto (eventuali altri bersagli vengono bersagliati normalmente). Dopo che ciò accade, questo incantesimo termina.
de: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (⚡), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.
fr: Vous déformez les lois de la magie. Jusqu’à ce que l’effet de ce sort s’achève, si un sort offensif (⚡) est lancé sur votre sujet, la créature qui l’a lancé est prise pour cible à sa place par le sort en question (toutes les autres cibles de ce dernier sont visées normalement). Une fois que cela s’est produit, l’effet du sort s’achève.
es: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (⚡), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.
pt-BR: Você distorce as leis da magia. Até o fim deste Feitiço, quando o alvo for alvo de um Feitiço ofensivo (⚡), a criatura que conjurou esse Feitiço ofensivo será alvo dele em seu lugar (quaisquer outros alvos do Feitiço ofensivo serão afetados normalmente). Assim que isso acontecer, este Feitiço termina.
ru: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (⚡), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.
pl: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (⚡), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.
zh-CN: 你扭曲了魔法的法则。在此法术效果结束前，如果此法术的作用对象成为了攻击性法术（OO）的目标，那么施放此攻击性法术的生物将改为选中自身为目标（此攻击性法术的其他目标保持不变）。如果上述效果被触发，此法术便会立即结束。

en: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to【**20 + half the target's level**】.
it: Condanni un nemico alla rovina, trasformandone la forza in debolezza. Il bersaglio perde un ammontare di Punti Vita pari a【20 + metà del livello del bersaglio】.
de: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to【**20 + half the target's level**】.
fr: Vous invoquez le mauvais sort contre votre adversaire pour transformer sa force en fragilité. La cible perd un nombre de Points de Vie égal à **【20 + la moitié de son niveau】** .
es: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to【**20 + half the target's level**】.
pt-BR: Você invoca a destruição de seu inimigo, transformando força em fragilidade. O alvo perde uma quantidade de Pontos de Vida igual a 【20 + metade do nível do alvo】.
ru: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to【**20 + half the target's level**】.
pl: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to【**20 + half the target's level**】.
zh-CN: 你让末日在敌人身上显现，削弱他的生命力。目标失去等同于**【20+目标等级的一半】**的生命值。

en: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
it: Intrappoli il nemico in una bolla di tempo e spazio alterati. Il bersaglio esegue un’azione in meno durante il suo prossimo turno (fino a un minimo di zero azioni).
de: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
fr: Vous enfermez un adversaire dans un cercle de temps et d’espace altérés. La cible effectue une action de moins à son prochain tour (pour un minimum de 0 action).
es: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
pt-BR: Você prende um inimigo dentro de um círculo de tempo e espaço alterados. O alvo realizará uma ação a menos no próximo turno (até um mínimo de 0 ações).
ru: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
pl: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

en: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**dark** damage. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell suffers **weak**.
it:
Una tempesta di energie oscure sbriciola la materia. Ciascun bersaglio colpito subisce 【TM + 15】 danni da ombra.
Opportunità: Ciascun bersaglio colpito subisce lo status debole.
de: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**dark** damage. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell suffers **weak**.
fr: Une tempête d’énergie noire transforme la matière en cendres. Chaque cible touchée par ce sort subit **【VH + 15】** dégâts de **ténèbres**. **Aubaine** : chaque cible touchée par ce sort subit l’état **affaibli**.
es: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**dark** damage. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell suffers **weak**.
pt-BR: Uma tempestade de energia escura transforma matéria em cinzas. Cada alvo atingido por este feitiço sofre 【RA + 15】de dano trevas. Oportunidade: Cada alvo atingido por este feitiço sofre fraqueza.
ru: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**dark** damage. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell suffers **weak**.
pl: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. Each target hit by this spell suffers【**HR + 15**】**dark** damage. **Opportunity:** Each target hit by this spell suffers **weak**.
zh-CN: 黑暗能量的风暴将物质化作飞灰。你对每个被此法术命中的目标造成【**高值+15**】的**暗系**伤害。**机会：**对此法术命中的每个目标施加**虚弱**。

en: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against any effects that target it (they are still free to use their normal Defense score if higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or to 14 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
it: Proietti il tuo spirito fuori dal corpo e lo usi per avvolgere i bersagli, proteggendoli dai pericoli della magia. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, ciascun bersaglio può considerare la sua Difesa Magica pari a 12 contro qualsiasi effetto (può comunque utilizzare il suo normale valore di Difesa Magica nel caso sia maggiore di 12).
de: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against any effects that target it (they are still free to use their normal Defense score if higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or to 14 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
fr: Vous projetez votre âme hors de votre corps afin qu’elle entoure les cibles et les protège contre la magie néfaste. Jusqu’à la fin des effets de ce sort, chaque cible fait comme si sa Défense magique était de 12 contre tout effet qui la prend pour cible (mais peut utiliser sa valeur normale si elle est supérieure à 12).
es: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against any effects that target it (they are still free to use their normal Defense score if higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or to 14 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
pt-BR: Você projeta sua alma para fora do corpo e a dirige para envolver os alvos, protegendo-os de magia perigosa. Até o fim deste Feitiço, cada alvo pode tratar sua Defesa Mágica como se fosse igual a 12 contra quaisquer efeitos que o tenham como alvo (eles ainda podem usar seu valor normal de Defesa, se for maior que 12). Esse valor aumenta para 13 se você for **nível 20 ou superior**, ou para 14 se você for **nível 40 ou superior**.
ru: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against any effects that target it (they are still free to use their normal Defense score if higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or to 14 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
pl: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against any effects that target it (they are still free to use their normal Defense score if higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or to 14 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
zh-CN: 你将自己的灵魂投射于外并包裹目标，由此保护他们免受危险魔法侵害。在此法术效果结束前，此法术的作用对象在被任何效果选为目标时，视为拥有12点魔防（如果他们原本的魔防值高于12，则原本的魔防值可照常生效）。当你的**等级大于等于20级**时，此法术效果改为提供13点魔防；当你的**等级大于等于40级**时，此法术效果改为提供14点魔防。

en: You allow a creature to focus their vital energy into accomplishing what they previously could not. Choose one Attribute: **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**. Until this spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**).
it: Consenti a una creatura di concentrare la sua energia vitale perché sia in grado di superare i propri limiti. Scegli Destrezza, Intuito, Vigore o Volontà: fino al termine di questo incantesimo, il bersaglio considera la Caratteristica scelta incrementata di una taglia di dado (massimo d12).
de: You allow a creature to focus their vital energy into accomplishing what they previously could not. Choose one Attribute: **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**. Until this spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of **d12**).

Choisissez un attribut : **Dextérité**, **Intuition**, **Puissance** ou **Volonté**. Jusqu’à ce que l’effet du sort s’achève, la cible fait comme si la taille de dé de cet attribut était supérieure d’un cran (jusqu’à un maximum de **d12**).

en: You imbue a weapon with the cleansing energy of your spirit. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the **light** type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a **free attack** with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
it: Avvolgi un’arma con l’energia purificatrice del tuo spirito. Fino al termine di questo incantesimo, tutto il danno inflitto dall’arma diventa luce. Se hai quell’arma equipaggiata mentre lanci questo incantesimo, puoi eseguire un attacco gratuito con essa come parte della stessa azione. Puoi lanciare questo incantesimo solo su armi equipaggiate da creature consenzienti.

Este feitiço só pode ser lançado em uma arma equipada por uma criatura voluntária.

zh-CN: 你将自己灵魂中的净化之力注入一件武器。这件武器造成的所有伤害都会变为**光系**伤害，直至此法术效果结束。如果你在施放此法术时正装备着这件武器，便可以使用该武器进行一次**顺势攻击**，此攻击视为本次行动的一部分。此法术只能对自愿获得这项增益的生物所装备的武器施放。

it: Soffochi l’energia spirituale che attraversa i corpi dei tuoi nemici, ostacolandone i movimenti. Scegli uno status tra debole e lento: ciascun bersaglio colpito subisce lo status scelto.

en: After you plant a magiseed through the **Chloromancy** Skill (not when using **Graft**), you may choose one option: perform a **free attack** with an equipped weapon; **or** perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell with a **total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than 【 5 + (SL × 5)】** (you must still pay its MP cost). Treat the **High Roll (HR)** of your Accuracy Check or Magic Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage dealt by this attack or spell.
it: Dopo aver **piantato un magiseme** tramite l’Abilità **Cloromanzia** (non usando **Innesto**), puoi scegliere un’opzione: esegui un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata; **oppure** esegui immediatamente e gratuitamente l’azione di Incantesimo, lanciando un incantesimo dal **costo totale in Punti Mente pari o inferiore a【5 + (LA × 5)】** (devi pagarne il costo in PM). Considera il **Tiro Maggiore** del Test di Precisione o Magia pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno inflitto da questo attacco o incantesimo.

Treat the **High Roll (HR)** of your Accuracy Check or Magic Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage dealt by this attack or spell.
pt-BR: Depois de plantar um magigrão através da perícia Cloromancia (não ao usar Enxerto), você pode escolher uma das opções: realizar um ataque gratuito com uma arma equipada; ou realizar a ação Feitiço gratuitamente, conjurando um feitiço com um custo total de Pontos de Mente igual ou inferior a【5 + (NH × 5)】(ainda é  necessário pagar seu custo em PM). Considere que a Rolagem Alta do seu Teste de Precisão ou Teste de Magia é igual a 0 ao determinar o dano causado por esse ataque ou feitiço.

Treat the **High Roll (HR)** of your Accuracy Check or Magic Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage dealt by this attack or spell.
zh-CN: 当你通过**植生术**技能（不包括使用**嫁接**时）种植魔种后，你可以选择一项：使用一件已装备的武器执行一次**顺势攻击**；**或**执行一次类型为**施法**的顺势行动，从而施放一个精神值总消耗不高于**【5+（技能等级×5）】**的法术（仍需要支付精神值消耗）。在计算此次攻击**或**法术造成的伤害时，将你的命中检定**或施法**检定的**高值**视为0。

en: Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover **a new type of magiseed**. During a conflict, if there are **no magiseeds** in your **garden**, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to **plant a magiseed** of a type you have  discovered.
it: Ogni volta che acquisisci questa Abilità, scopri **un nuovo tipo di magiseme**. Durante un conflitto, se non ci sono **magisemi** nel tuo **giardino**, puoi usare un’azione e spendere 20 Punti Mente per **piantare un magiseme** di un tipo che hai scoperto.
de: Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover **a new type of magiseed**. During a conflict, if there are **no magiseeds** in your **garden**, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to **plant a magiseed** of a type you have  discovered.
fr: Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover a new type of magiseed. During a conflict, if there are no magiseeds in your garden, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to plant a magiseed of a type you have  discovered.
es: Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover **a new type of magiseed**. During a conflict, if there are **no magiseeds** in your **garden**, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to **plant a magiseed** of a type you have  discovered.
pt-BR: Cada vez que você adquire esta perícia, descobre um novo tipo de magigrão da lista encontrada nas próximas páginas. Durante um conflito, se não houver magigrãos em seu jardim, você pode usar uma ação e gastar 20 Pontos de Mente para plantar um magigrão de um tipo que tenha descoberto. As regras para o jardim e para o crescimento dos magigrãos podem ser encontradas nas próximas páginas.
ru: Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover **a new type of magiseed**. During a conflict, if there are **no magiseeds** in your **garden**, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to **plant a magiseed** of a type you have  discovered.

zh-CN: 每当你习得此技能时，你都会发现**一种新类型的魔种**，可在后续页面的列表中找到。在冲突场景中，若你的**花园**中**没有魔种**，那么作为一次行动，你可以消耗20点精神值来**种植一种你已发现的魔种**。关于**花园**和魔种生长的规则见下一页。

en: As long as there is a **magiseed** in your **garden** and **1 or more sections** of your **Growth Clock** are **filled**, you may use an action to **remove** that **magiseed** from your **garden**: if you do, **plant a different magiseed** among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
it: Finché c’è un **magiseme** nel tuo **giardino** e il tuo **Orologio di Crescita** ha **1 o più sezioni piene**, puoi usare un’azione per **rimuovere** quel **magiseme** dal tuo **giardino**: se lo fai, pianta immediatamente un **magiseme diverso** di un tipo che hai scoperto (mantenendo invariate le sezioni attuali del tuo Orologio di Crescita).
de: As long as there is a **magiseed** in your **garden** and **1 or more sections** of your **Growth Clock** are **filled**, you may use an action to **remove** that **magiseed** from your **garden**: if you do, **plant a different magiseed** among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
fr: As long as there is a magiseed in your garden and 1 or more sections of your Growth Clock are filled, you may use an action to remove that magiseed from your garden: if you do, plant a different magiseed among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
es: As long as there is a **magiseed** in your **garden** and **1 or more sections** of your **Growth Clock** are **filled**, you may use an action to **remove** that **magiseed** from your **garden**: if you do, **plant a different magiseed** among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
pt-BR: Enquanto houver um magigrão em seu jardim e pelo menos 1 seção do seu Relógio de Crescimento estiver preenchida, você pode usar uma ação para remover esse magigrão do jardim: se o fizer, plante um magigrão diferente entre aqueles que você já descobriu (mantendo as seções preenchidas do seu Relógio de Crescimento inalteradas).
ru: As long as there is a **magiseed** in your **garden** and **1 or more sections** of your **Growth Clock** are **filled**, you may use an action to **remove** that **magiseed** from your **garden**: if you do, **plant a different magiseed** among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
pl: As long as there is a **magiseed** in your **garden** and **1 or more sections** of your **Growth Clock** are **filled**, you may use an action to **remove** that **magiseed** from your **garden**: if you do, **plant a different magiseed** among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).
zh-CN: 只要你的**花园**中存在**魔种**，并且你的**生长命刻**已**填充**了**1格或更多格**，那么作为一次行动，你可以**移除**你的**花园**中的**魔种**：如果你这样做，**种植你已发现的另一种魔种**（**生长命刻**当前已**填充**的格数保持不变）。

en: When you remove a **magiseed** from your **garden**, you may choose one creature you can see: if that creature is in **Crisis**, they recover **【5 + (SL × 5)】** Hit Points.
it: Quando **rimuovi** un **magiseme** dal tuo **giardino**, puoi scegliere una creatura a te visibile: se quella creatura è in **Crisi**, essa recupera **【5 + (LA × 5)】** Punti Vita.

ru: When you remove a **magiseed** from your **garden**, you may choose one creature you can see: if that creature is in **Crisis**, they recover **【5 + (SL × 5)】** Hit Points.

zh-CN: 当你移除你**花园**中的**魔种**时，你可以选择一个你能看见的生物：如果该生物处于**危机状态**，使其恢复【**5+（技能等级×5**）】的生命值。

en: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Ritualism discipline; additionally, you may use Ritualism to create, animate, and/or control vegetation, pollen, spores, and toxins (but you cannot create nor control plant-Species NPCs this way).
it: Puoi eseguire Rituali i cui effetti rientrino nella disciplina di **Ritualismo; in più**, puoi usare il **Ritualismo** per **creare, animare e/o controllare vegetazione, pollini, spore e tossine** (ma non puoi creare né controllare PNG di Specie **pianta** in questo modo).
de: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; **additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **create**, **animate**, **and/or control vegetation**, **pollen**, **spores**, and **toxins** (but you cannot create nor control **plant**-Species NPCs this way).
fr: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Ritualism discipline; additionally, you may use Ritualism to create, animate, and/or control vegetation, pollen, spores, and toxins (but you cannot create nor control plant-Species NPCs this way).
