pt-BR: Você ganha o poder de realizar Rituais da disciplina de Ritualismo; além disso, pode usar Ritualismo para criar, animar e/ou controlar vegetação, pólen, esporos e toxinas (mas não pode criar nem controlar PNJs da espécie Planta dessa forma).
ru: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; **additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **create**, **animate**, **and/or control vegetation**, **pollen**, **spores**, and **toxins** (but you cannot create nor control **plant**-Species NPCs this way).
pl: You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the **Ritualism** discipline; **additionally**, you may use **Ritualism** to **create**, **animate**, **and/or control vegetation**, **pollen**, **spores**, and **toxins** (but you cannot create nor control **plant**-Species NPCs this way).
zh-CN: 你获得启动仪式系仪式的能力；此外，你可以通过仪式来创造、活化或控制植被、花粉、孢子和毒素（但你不能以这种方式创造或控制物种类型为植物的NPC）。

en: When you **rest** inside a settlement, you gain **【 SL】** ingredients. You may use an action and combine **2 or 3 ingredients** to prepare a **delicacy** and choose one option: you apply its effects to yourself or an ally you can see; **or** you perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply the delicacy’s effects to each enemy hit by the attack. You may carry **up to 10 +【 SL × 5】 ingredients**, and they **will never spoil until you use them**; if you take this Skill during character creation, you begin play with **ten** ingredients with random tastes.
it: Quando riposi in un insediamento, ottieni **【LA】 ingredienti**. Puoi usare un’azione e combinare **2 o 3 ingredienti** per creare una **delizia** e scegliere un’opzione: applichi i suoi effetti a te stesso o un alleato a te visibile; **oppure** esegui un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata. Questo attacco non infligge danno, ma applichi gli effetti della **delizia** a ciascun nemico colpito. Puoi trasportare **fino a 10 +【LA × 5】 ingredienti** e gli ingredienti che trasporti si **conservano finché non vengono utilizzati**. Se acquisisci questa Abilità durante la creazione del personaggio, inizi il gioco con **dieci** ingredienti dal **sapore** casuale.
de: When you **rest** inside a settlement, you gain **【 SL】** ingredients. You may use an action and combine **2 or 3 ingredients** to prepare a **delicacy** and choose one option: you apply its effects to yourself or an ally you can see; **or** you perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply the delicacy’s effects to each enemy hit by the attack. You may carry u**p to 10 +【 SL × 5】 ingredients**, and they **will never spoil until you use them**; if you take this Skill during character creation, you begin play with **ten** ingredients with random tastes.

pt-BR: Quando você descansa dentro de um assentamento, recebe 【NP】 ingredientes (veja a próxima página). Você pode usar uma ação e combinar 2 ou 3 ingredientes para preparar uma iguaria (veja a próxima página) e escolher uma opção: aplicar seus efeitos em si mesmo ou em um aliado que possa ver; ou realizar um ataque gratuito com uma arma equipada. Esse ataque não causa dano, mas aplica os efeitos da iguaria a cada inimigo atingido. Você pode carregar até 10 + 【NP × 5】 ingredientes, e eles nunca estragam até serem usados; se adquirir esta perícia durante a criação de personagem, começa o jogo com dez ingredientes de sabores aleatórios.

zh-CN: 当你在定居点**休息**时，你获得份数等同于**【技能等级】**的食材（见下页）。作为一次行动，你可以组合**2份或3份食材**来制作一份**美食**（见下页），并选择一项：将其效果施加给自身**或**一个你能看见的盟友；**或**你使用已装备的一件武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。这次攻击不造成伤害，但会将**美食**的效果施加给本次攻击命中的所有敌人。你可以携带至多**【10+技能等级×5】**份食材，并且它们**在使用前永不腐坏**。如果你在创建角色时选择此技能，你在开始游戏时拥有**10份**随机风味的食材。

en: When you perform the **free attack** granted by the **Cooking** Skill, if you combined **no more than 2 ingredients**, you may have the attack deal damage as normal. If you do, you treat your **High Roll (HR)** as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.
it: Quando esegui un **attacco gratuito** con l’Abilità **Cucina**, se hai combinato **soltanto 2 ingredienti**, puoi decidere che l’attacco infligga danno normalmente. Se lo fai, considera il tuo **Tiro Maggiore** pari a 0 quando calcoli il danno.

zh-CN: 当你执行**烹饪**技能赋予的**顺势攻击**时，如果你组合的**食材不超过2份**，你可以让这次攻击正常造成伤害。如果你这样做，在计算这次攻击造成的伤害时，将你的**高值**视为0。

it: Quando esegui un’**invocazione**, puoi **spendere fino a 【LA × 10】 Punti Mente addizionali**. Per ogni 10 Punti Mente spesi in questo modo, l’**invocazione** può bersagliare una creatura addizionale a te visibile.

en: After an enemy you can see loses Hit Points due to damage dealt by one of your allies, if that damage was increased by one or more of your **“hex” invocations**, you may perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack may **only** target that enemy, and receives a bonus equal to **【 SL】** to its Accuracy Check; if it is successful, all its damage becomes of the same type dealt by your ally, and **all “hex” invocations** present on its target end immediately after the attack has been resolved. If two or more enemies trigger this Skill at the same time, you can perform a **free attack** against **each** of them, in whatever order you prefer.
it: Dopo che un nemico a te visibile perde Punti Vita a causa di un danno inflitto da un tuo alleato, se quel danno è stato incrementato da una o più tue **invocazioni “marchio”**, puoi eseguire un **attacco gratuito** con un’arma equipaggiata. L’attacco può bersagliare **soltanto** quel nemico e riceve un bonus pari a **【LA】** al Test di Precisione; se ha successo, tutto il suo danno diventa dello stesso tipo inflitto dal tuo alleato e **tutte le invocazioni “marchio”** presenti sul suo bersaglio terminano dopo aver risolto l’attacco. Se due o più nemici innescano questa Abilità contemporaneamente, puoi eseguire un **attacco gratuito** separato contro **ciascuno** di essi, nell’ordine che preferisci.

pt-BR: Depois que um inimigo que você pode ver perde Pontos de Vida devido a dano causado por um de seus aliados, se esse dano foi aumentado por uma ou mais de suas invocações de “maldição”, você pode realizar um ataque gratuito com uma arma equipada. Esse ataque só pode ter esse inimigo como alvo e recebe um bônus de 【NP】 no Teste de Precisão; se for bem-sucedido, todo o dano causado por ele se torna do mesmo tipo que o dano infligido pelo seu aliado, e todas as invocações de “maldição” presentes no alvo terminam imediatamente após a resolução do ataque. Se dois ou mais inimigos ativarem esta perícia ao mesmo tempo, você pode realizar um ataque gratuito contra cada um deles, na ordem que preferir.

zh-CN: 当一个你能看见的敌人因你的盟友造成的伤害而失去生命值时，如果该伤害因你的一项或多项**咒法祈唤**而附加了额外伤害，你可以使用一件你已装备的武器执行一次**顺势攻击**。此次攻击**仅**能以该敌人为目标，并在命中检定中获得等同于【**技能等级**】的修正值；如果成功命中，其所有伤害类型变为你的盟友所造成的伤害类型，并且其目标身上**所有咒法祈唤**在**顺势攻击**的结算后立即终止。如果两个或更多敌人同时触发此技能，你可以对**每个**敌人分别执行一次**顺势攻击**，顺序由你决定。

en: As long as you have a weapon belonging to the **arcane**, **bow**, **brawling**, **flail**, **sword**, or **thrown** Category equipped, your **“blast” invocations** deal **【SL】** extra damage, and the extra damage granted by your **“hex” invocations** is increased by **【 SL】**.

zh-CN: 只要你装备了**魔法类**、**弓类**、**格斗类**、**链枷类**、**剑类**或**投掷类**的武器，你的“**冲击祈唤**”便能造成等同于【**技能等级**】的额外伤害，并且你的“**咒法祈唤**”所提供的额外伤害增加【**技能等级**】点。

en: When a **potion** or **delicacy** you created that **does not** deal damage causes one or more creatures to recover Hit Points, you may instead have it deal **poison** damage equal to **【 half your level + (SL × 10)】** to each of those creatures. This damage’s type cannot change, and it is halved if you are dealing damage to **two or more creatures**.
it: Quando una **pozione** o **delizia** da te creata che **non** infligge danno fa sì che una o più creature recuperino Punti Vita, puoi invece farle infliggere un ammontare di danni da **veleno** pari a **【metà del tuo livello + (LA × 10)】** a ciascuna di esse. en:
**Gifts** can only be used when specific **events** take place. When this happens, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **【the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock, multiplied by 5】** minimum 5 Mind Points) in order to apply the effects of that **gift** to the event.
You may only use a **single gift** per event.
If a gift causes **HP or MP recovery**, or if it causes **MP loss**, the amounts increase by 10
if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**.

When you first acquire the **Psychic Gifts** Skill, you also receive a **Brainwave Clock**.
Your Brainwave Clock has **4 sections**, and it begins each scene **empty**.
After you resolve one of your **gifts, fill 1 section** of your Brainwave Clock (you do so **after** the effects of the **gift** have been calculated and applied).
Your Brainwave Clock determines your **gifts’ cost in Mind Points**, as well as their **effectiveness** (see above). You can still use your **gifts** when the Clock is full.
Sections of your Brainwave Clock may **not be filled** in any way other than described above, and they **may only be erased** through the **Brainwave Discharge** Heroic Skill (see page **171**) or through effects that **expressly** influence Brainwave Clocks.

pt-BR:
**Dons** só podem ser usados quando **eventos** específicos ocorrem. Quando isso acontece, você pode gastar uma quantidade de Pontos de Mente igual a **【o número de seções preenchidas em seu Relógio Mental, multiplicado por 5】** (mínimo de 5 Pontos de Mente) para aplicar os efeitos daquele dom ao evento.
Você só pode usar um **único dom** por evento.

Se um dom causar **recuperação de PV ou PM**, ou se causar **perda de PM**, os valores aumentam em 10 se você for **nível 20 ou superior**, ou em 20 se você for **nível 40 ou superior**.

Quando você adquire o Poder **Dons Psíquicos** pela primeira vez, você também recebe um **Relógio Mental**.
Seu Relógio Mental tem **4 seções**, e começa cada cena **vazio**.
Após você resolver um de seus **dons, preencha 1 seção** de seu Relógio Mental (isso é feito **após** os efeitos do **dom** terem sido calculados e aplicados).

Seu Relógio Mental determina o custo em PM de seus dons, assim como sua efetividade (veja acima). Você ainda pode usar seus dons mesmo quando o Relógio estiver cheio.

Seções do seu Relógio Mental **não podem ser preenchidas** de nenhuma outra forma além da descrita acima, e elas **só podem ser apagadas** por meio do Poder Heroico **Descarga Mental** (veja a página 171) ou por efeitos que explicitamente influenciem Relógios Mentais.

zh-CN: **天赋**仅能在发生特定**事件**时使用。此时，你可以消耗等同于**【你的脑波命刻中已填充的格数×5】**的精神值（精神值消耗最低为5点），将该**天赋**的效果应用于此次**事件**。•每次**事件**中仅能使用**一次天赋**。•如果一个**天赋**会**恢复生命值或精神值**，或**消耗精神值**，那么当你的**等级大于等于20级**时，则恢复量或消耗量增加10点；当你的**等级大于等于40级**时，改为增加20点。**脑波命刻**当你第一次学习**念力天赋**技能时，你会获得一个**脑波命刻**。•你的**脑波命刻**包含**4格**，并在每个场景开始时**清空**。•你每使用**一次天赋**后，将你的**脑波命刻**填充1格（在**天赋**的效果结算完成**之后**）。•你的**脑波命刻**会决定**天赋的精神值消耗**和**效力**（见上方）。当命刻填满后，你依然可以使用**天赋**。•除上述方式之外，你的**脑波命刻无法以其他任何方式填充**，且**只能通过脑波倾泻**英雄技能（见第**171**页）或其他**明确规定**可以影响**脑波命刻**的效果来擦除。
该伤害变为风系或雷系，且**造成**等同于【2+你的脑波命刻已填充格数】的额外伤害。

en:
Once you use the **Theriomorphosis** Skill, the chosen therioforms last until the end of the scene. They also end if you die or fall unconscious, perform the **Guard** action, or use the Theriomorphosis Skill again (this includes using it through **Genoclepsis**).
You may end the effects of your **Theriomorphosis** at any time, but during a conflict you can only do so on your turn, before or after an action.
When a scene ends, if you are under the effects of **Theriomorphosis**, you may spend 10 Mind Points to extend your **current therioforms** to the next scene you will be in.

en: You are able to fly. In addition to the obvious advantages in mobility, your **melee** attacks can target **flying** creatures and you cannot be targeted by **melee** attacks unless the attacker is flying or is somehow able to reach flying targets. These benefits do not apply if you are unable to fly freely (such as when inside a vehicle designed for human-sized creatures, or in a narrow corridor). Additionally, when you suffer **air**, **bolt** or **ice** damage during a conflict scene, you lose these benefits until the start of your next turn.
it:
Sei in grado di **volare**. In aggiunta ai vantaggi in termini di mobilità, i tuoi attacchi in **mischia** possono bersagliare le creature **volanti** e tu non puoi essere bersagliato da attacchi in **mischia** a meno che l'attaccante non voli o non sia in grado di raggiungere bersagli volanti.
Questi benefici non si applicano se non puoi volare liberamente (per esempio se ti trovi in un veicolo progettato per creature di proporzioni umane, oppure uno stretto corridoio). Inoltre, quando subisci danni da **aria**, **fulmine** o **ghiaccio** durante una scena di conflitto, perdi questi benefici fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

en: **Entering** the **personal vehicle** during a conflict requires the **Objective** action. Normally there is no Check required, but the Game Master may introduce a **Clock** if there are serious dangers or obstacles. If the **personal vehicle** is accessible when the conflict begins, characters may **enter it immediately** before the Initiative Check (see **Core Rulebook**, page **59**).  **Leaving** the **personal vehicle** doesn’t require an action, but during a conflict it can only be done on your turn, **before or after** an action.  The **personal vehicle** can contain a variable number of human-sized creatures depending on its **frame** and **modules**, but **only its Pilot may drive it**. Additionally, the other passengers **cannot cover creatures** when they perform the **Guard** action.  The **maximum number of modules enabled at the same time** on a **personal vehicle** is equal to **【3 + its Pilot’s SL in Personal Vehicle】**. The Pilot may freely reassign their personal vehicle’s enabled and disabled modules outside conflicts.

zh-CN: 在冲突场景中**进入个人载具**需要**推进目标**行动。通常来说这无需进行检定，但如果存在严重的危险或阻碍，游戏主持人可以引入一个**命刻**。如果在冲突开始时**个人载具**可用，角色可以在进行先攻检定（**核心规则书**第**59**页）之前**立即进入载具**。•**离开个人载具**不需要消耗行动，但在冲突场景中，你只能在自己的回合内，**不存在其他正在结算中的效果时**这样做。•取决于其**框架**和**模块**的不同，一部**个人载具**可以容纳数量不等的人类体型生物，但**只有其机师能够驾驶它**。此外，其他乘客在执行**防御**行动时，**无法为任何生物提供掩护**。•**个人载具同时能够启用的模块数量上限**等于**【3+机师的个人载具技能等级】**。在冲突场景之外，机师可以自由地重新分配其**个人载具**上已启用和已停用的**模块**。

en: A **personal vehicle** with this module enabled cannot have any other **weapon modules** enabled. Additionally, when you perform the **Attack** action and attack with this weapon module, you may perform two separate attacks instead of one (against the same target or against different targets). If you do, both attacks follow the rules for **two-weapon** fighting: each attack loses the **multi** property and cannot gain it, and you treat the High Roll of each Accuracy Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage.

en: While driving this **personal vehicle**, you gain a +2 bonus to Defense and a +2 bonus to Magic Defense. Additionally, this weapon module does not count as a “weapon”: instead, it counts as an equipped **shield**. This module **cannot** be equipped in your **main hand slot**, unless you have acquired the **Dual Shieldbearer** Skill (see **Core Rulebook**, page **197**). If you have, your **Twin Shields** deal 2 extra damage (this is cumulative if you have two **Shield modules** enabled at the same time).

While you are driving this **personal vehicle**, your **melee** attacks can target **flying** creatures, and none of the creatures inside the **personal vehicle** can be targeted by **melee** attacks unless the attacker is flying or is somehow able to reach flying targets.

en: When you plant a **magiseed**, it takes root in your **garden** until removed. Your **Garden** is an **abstract** space whose appearance varies depending on your character’s look: it might be a pot on their back, a gap along their blade, or even the ground under their feet. Your **garden** can only contain **one magiseed at a time**, and any **magiseeds** in your garden are **automatically removed** at the end of each scene.

zh-CN: 当你种植**魔种**时，它会在你的**花园**中生根，直至移除。你的**花园**是一个**抽象**空间，其外观会随你的角色外观而变化：它可以是你背上的花盆、刀刃中的缝隙，甚至是脚下的地面。你的**花园一次只能容纳一个魔种**，且在每个场景结束时，在你的**花园**中的**魔种**会**自动移除**。

en: **Magiseeds** can have passive effects, or have effects that trigger at the **end** of your turn, **after** your Growth Clock has increased.  The effects of a **magiseed** apply only while it is present in your **garden**, and they vary depending on the current number of filled sections in your **Growth Clock** (T).  You **only** apply the effect corresponding to the **exact number** of currently filled sections in your **Growth Clock**, not any effect above or below it.  If a magiseed’s effect deals damage, it deals 5 extra damage if you are **level 30 or higher**. If a magiseed’s effect causes Hit Point and/or Mind Point loss and/or recovery, the amount increases by 10 if you are **level 30 or higher**.

zh-CN: **魔种**可以具有被动效果，也可以在你的回合**结束**、且**生长命刻**增加**后**触发效果。•**魔种**的效果**仅**在其存在于你的**花园**中时生效，并且其效果会根据你的**生长命刻**中当前已填充的格数（T）而变化。•只有与你的**生长命刻**中当前已填充的格数**正好对应**的效果才会生效，高于或低于该格数的任何效果都不会生效。•当**魔种**的效果造成伤害时，如果你的**等级大于等于30级**，则造成5点额外伤害。当**魔种**的效果使得生命值和/或精神值损失和/或恢复时，如果你的**等级大于等于30级**，则该数值增加10点。

en:
Your deck is an actual **deck** of cards that you can assemble however you prefer, provided their backs are identical and you follow the restrictions below:
- The deck contains exactly **30 cards**: **2 jokers**, plus **28 cards** divided into **4 types**, called **suits**; for instance, in a standard poker deck the **suits** are **clubs** (♣), **diamonds** (♦), **hearts** (♥), and **spades** (♠). When you create your   character's deck, associate each **suit** to a different damage type among **air**, **earth**, **fire**, and **ice**.
- For each suit, the deck contains **7 cards** with **values 1 to 7**.
The simplest approach is to use a poker deck (removing **face cards** and **cards numbered 8 to 10**), but you can also use minor arcana from tarot, cards from collectible card games, and much more. Just make sure the combinations are easy to identify.
- When a **conflict** begins, shuffle all 30 cards in your **deck** and place it **face down** in front of yourself, then draw **5 cards** to form your starting **hand**.
- If you need to draw cards and your deck doesn't have enough, draw as many as you can, shuffle your discard pile into the deck, place it **face down**, then keep drawing.
- When you draw cards, you draw them from your **deck** and add them to your **hand**. Normally only you can see your **hand**, but you can show it to others if you so wish.
- When you discard cards, you do so from your **hand** and place them **face up** into your **discard pile**, in whatever order you prefer. The order of cards in your **discard pile** cannot be modified, but anyone may look at them.
Your **deck**, your **hand**, and your **discard pile** (as well as any Skills and effects related to them) are only available during conflict scenes; at the end of each conflict, shuffle all 30 cards back into your **deck** and put it aside.

pt-BR:
Seu baralho é um **baralho** físico de cartas que você pode montar como preferir, desde que os versos das cartas sejam idênticos e você siga as restrições abaixo:
- O baralho contém exatamente **30 cartas**: **2 curingas** e **28 cartas** divididas em **4 tipos**, chamados **naipes**; por exemplo, em um baralho de pôquer padrão, os **naipes** são **paus** (♣), **ouros** (♦), **copas** (♥) e **espadas** (♠). Ao criar o baralho do seu personagem, associe cada **naipe** a um tipo de dano diferente entre **ar**, **terra**, **fogo** e **gelo**.
- Para cada naipe, o baralho contém **7 cartas** com **valores de 1 a 7**.
A opção mais simples é usar um baralho de pôquer (removendo as **figuras** e as **cartas numeradas de 8 a 10**), mas você também pode usar arcanos menores de tarô, cartas de jogos de cartas colecionáveis e muito mais. Apenas certifique-se de que as combinações sejam fáceis de identificar.
- Quando um **conflito** começar, embaralhe todas as 30 cartas do seu **baralho** e coloque-o **virado para baixo** à sua frente. Em seguida, compre **5 cartas** para formar sua **mão** inicial.
- Se precisar comprar cartas e não houver cartas suficientes no seu baralho, compre quantas puder, embaralhe sua pilha de descarte de volta no baralho, coloque-o **virado para baixo** e continue comprando.
- Ao comprar cartas, retire-as do seu **baralho** e adicione-as à sua **mão**. Normalmente, apenas você pode ver sua **mão**, mas pode mostrá-la aos outros se desejar.
- Ao descartar cartas, retire-as da sua **mão** e coloque-as **viradas para cima** na sua **pilha de descarte**, na ordem que preferir. A ordem das cartas na sua **pilha de descarte** não pode ser alterada, mas qualquer pessoa pode olhar essas cartas.
Seu **baralho**, sua **mão** e sua **pilha de descarte** (assim como quaisquer Poderes e efeitos relacionados a eles) só ficam disponíveis durante cenas de conflito; ao final de cada conflito, embaralhe novamente todas as 30 cartas no seu **baralho** e deixe-o de lado.

zh-CN:
你的**牌库**由一副实体卡牌组成，你可以自行组建，但所有牌背必须相同，并遵循以下限制：
- **牌库**恰好包含**30张牌**：**2张鬼牌**，以及分为**4种花色**的**28张牌**。例如标准扑克牌的**花色**为**梅花**（♣）、**方块**（♦）、**红桃**（♥）和**黑桃**（♠）。创建角色的**牌库**时，将每种**花色**分别对应**风**、**土**、**火**、**冰**中的一种不同伤害类型。
- 每种**花色**包含**7张牌**，**数值为1至7**。
最简单的办法是使用扑克牌，移除**人头牌**以及**8至10**；也可以使用塔罗牌的小阿尔克那、集换式卡牌等，只须确保能够轻松辨认组合。
- **冲突**开始时，将**牌库**中的**30张牌**洗匀，**牌面朝下**置于面前，然后抽取**5张牌**作为起始**手牌**。
- 需要抽牌而**牌库**不足时，先尽可能抽取，再将**弃牌堆**洗入**牌库**，**牌面朝下**放好，然后继续抽牌。
- 抽牌时，将牌从**牌库**加入**手牌**。通常只有你能看见自己的**手牌**，但你可以自愿向他人展示。
- 弃牌时，从**手牌**中弃置，并按你选择的顺序**牌面朝上**放入**弃牌堆**。**弃牌堆**中的顺序不得改变，但任何人都可以查看。
**牌库**、**手牌**、**弃牌堆**及其相关技能和效果仅在**冲突**场景中可用。每场**冲突**结束时，将全部**30张牌**洗回**牌库**并放到一旁。

en:
To produce a given effect, a **set** must match its requirements **exactly** (for instance, resolving a **set of 5 cards with the same value** will not match the requirements of Jackpot; it has to be composed of **exactly 4 cards**).
When you resolve a **set** that includes **jokers**, you choose their **suit** and **value** (**1** to **7**).
If a **set** matches the requirements of two or more effects, you must choose and apply **only one** of those effects.

zh-CN: 使用两种不同类别的武器战斗。

en: You may apply the benefits of **two-weapon fighting** (**Core Rulebook**, page **69**) to weapons belonging to different Categories, even if one is a **melee** weapon and the other is a **ranged** weapon (such as a **dagger** and a **firearm**, for instance). As long as you have **exactly two weapons equipped** and they **share no Categories with each other**, you gain a +2 bonus to Defense and the **second attack** you perform during each of your turns deals 5 extra damage.

zh-CN: 你可以在同时使用不同类型的武器时获得**双持战斗**（见第**69**页）的增益，即使其中一把武器是**近战**武器而另一把是**远程**武器（例如同时使用**匕首**和**枪械**）。如果你**正好装备了两件没有共通类型**的武器，你的物防获得+2的修正值，且你在自身回合内发起的**第二次攻击**将会造成5点额外伤害。

zh-CN: 从新的物种学习法术，并提升记忆法术的数量上限。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Chimerist** Class.\nChoose two creature Species among **construct**, **demon**, **elemental**, and **undead**. You can now use **spell mimic** to learn spells from creatures of the chosen Species. zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**拟兽使**职业。在**构装体**、**恶魔**、**元素**和**不死族**中选择两个生物物种。你现在可以通过**形意咒法**向属于选定物种的生物学习法术。此英雄技能**至多可学习两次**，每次都必须从上述物种中选取两个。每当你习得此技能时，你能够记忆的**拟兽使**法术数量上限将增加2个。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Entropist** Class.
You learn the ultimate **Entropist** spell: **Comet**
**Comet**, **MP:** 50, **Target:** Special, **Duration:** Instantaneous
You rip open a large portal to the Cosmos, calling down astral debris from the gaping void. Choose one option: 
- You deal 60 damage to one creature you can see. 
- You deal 40 damage to every enemy you can see.
These amounts increase by 5 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 10 if you are **level 40 or higher**.
Damage dealt by this spell has no type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**熵术士**职业。你学会了**熵术士**的究极法术：**彗星**。**彗星精神值消耗：**50**目标：**特殊**持续时间：**瞬发你撕开一道连接宇宙的巨大传送门，一块星体碎片在你的呼唤下冲破虚空裂隙而出。选择一项：你对一个你能看见的生物造成60点伤害；或你对所有你能看见的敌人均造成40点伤害。该伤害会在你的**等级大于等于20级**时提升5点，或在你的**等级大于等于40级**时提升10点。此法术所造成的伤害不具有任何伤害类型（因此不会受伤害相性影响）。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Orator** Class.\nDuring a conflict scene, you may use an action and choose a **soldier**-rank creature that can hear and understand you (the Game Master must tell you who is a valid target). If that creature is **shaken** or in **Crisis**, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **【20 + half that creature's level】** to have them peacefully leave the conflict.Describe how you convince them to desist.

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Wayfarer** Class, and must have acquired the **Faithful Companion** Skill.
Your bond with your companion grows stronger.
You gain the following benefits: 
- The companion's maximum Hit Points increase by 10.
- The companion deals 5 extra damage.
- Choose one of the companion's Attributes: **Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**. The chosen Attribute is permanently increased by one die size (up to a maximum size of **d12**).
- The companion gains an additional Skill. When you reach level **40**, or if you have already reached it, the companion gains an additional Skill. Make sure to discuss your Skill choices with the Game Master and the other Players.

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Spiritist** Class.
You learn the ultimate **Spiritist** spell: **Hope**.
**Hope**, **MP:** 40, **Target:** Special, **Duration:** Instantaneous
You rekindle the flames of courage and hope within a defeated hero. Choose a Player Character who **surrendered** but is still present on the scene: that Player Character immediately regains consciousness and recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to their **Crisis** score. Note that this spell will not undo the **consequences** of the character's surrender and is of no use if the character left the scene as part of their surrender — such as if they were captured and dragged away, or if they were trapped in a parallel dimension, and so on.
A Player Character may only be affected by this spell once per scene; if a character is brought back into the conflict by this spell and is subsequently reduced to 0 Hit Points again, they must **sacrifice** themselves or **surrender** as per the normal rules (including a new **consequence** and 2 more Fabula Points if they surrender).

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**御魂使**职业。你学会了**御魂使**的究极法术：**重燃希望**。**重燃希望精神值消耗：**40**目标：**特殊**持续时间：**瞬发你为被击败的英雄重新燃起了勇气和希望的火焰。选择一位已经**放弃抵抗**但在叙事层面上仍处于当前场景中的玩家角色：该玩家角色立即恢复意识，并恢复等同于其**危机**值的生命值。请注意，此法术不会取消因为该角色**放弃抵抗**而带来的**后果**，也无法对因**放弃抵抗**而已离开场景的角色生效（比如角色被俘虏并带走、被困在平行次元，以及其他诸如此类的情况）。一名玩家角色在一个场景中只能被此法术影响一次。如果被此法术重新带回冲突的角色生命值再次归零，就必须按正常规则选择**牺牲自己**或是**放弃抵抗**，并同样会因**放弃抵抗**而获得一项新的**后果**和2点物语点。
扩大单目标法术的作用范围。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Loremaster** Class.\nWhen you cast a spell with a **target** of "One creature", you may choose an Attribute (**Dexterity**, **Insight**, **Might**, or **Willpower**) and a die size (**d6**, **d8**, **d10**, or **d12**). If you do, the spell's **target** becomes "Every creature present on the scene whose current die size in that Attribute matches your choice" and its **total Mind Point cost is doubled**.\nAdditionally, all mentions of "the target" in the spell's text are replaced with "each target"; or they are replaced with "one or more targets" if the spell is **Anomaly**, **Dispel**, **Mercy**, or **Mirror**. When the spell ends on one or more of its targets, it automatically ends on all its targets.If you cast an offensive spell (⚡) this way, you perform a single Magic Check and confront it with the Magic Defense of each target.

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Tinkerer** Class.\nWhen you rest, you may choose any number of **weapons**, **armor**, and/or **shields** among those owned by your group. For each item chosen this way, you may either **add a Quality** to it (if it doesn't have one) or **replace its current Quality** with a different one. These new Qualities must come from the list of default Qualities available for items of that type, and must have an associated cost modifier of **+1000 zenit or lower.** At the end of the rest, you must pay an amount of zenit equal to the total sum of those cost modifiers, reduced by **【your Skill Level in Visionary, multiplied by 100】**. If you do, the items will be modified according to your choices.\nThe default list of **weapon Qualities** can be found on page **269**, while the default list of **armor** and **shield Qualities** can be found on page **280**.

**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Elementalist** Class.

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Commander** and **Sharpshooter**.\nWhen you perform the **Attack** action with a **ranged** weapon that belongs to the **bow** Category, if you have **no other weapon equipped**, you may perform two separate attacks instead of one (against the same target or against different targets). If you do, both attacks follow the rules for **two-weapon fighting**: each attack loses the **multi** property and cannot gain it, and you treat the High Roll of each Accuracy Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage.Note that this Heroic Skill **does not stack** with a custom weapon's **quick** customization (using **Double Arrows** with a **quick** bow doesn't allow more than two attacks, in short).

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Arcanist** Class, and your character must be **level 30 or higher**.
When you summon an Arcanum, you may decide to spend 1 Fabula Point and spend half of your current Hit Points (rounded down) to shape your lifeforce into a full manifestation of their power. If you do, the Arcanum manifests as a **soldier**-rank creature of the **demon** Species under your control (they count as an ally and have their own independent turn during conflicts – if you use this Skill during a conflict scene, the Arcanum joins the scene **at the end** of the current round). You also do not gain any of the **merge** benefits you would normally enjoy when summoning that Arcanum. The summoned creature has the following profile:
- **Level** is equal to your level (thus gaining the bonuses to Checks and damage listed under **steps 8** on page **303** of the **Core Rulebook** ).
- A **d10** in one Attribute of your choice, and a **d8** in all other Attributes.
- **Maximum Hit Points** equal to **【twice the creature's base Might die size, plus half of your maximum Hit Points】** . The creature has **no Mind Points** .
- Resistance to **two** damage types of your choice.
- The creature receives all the **merge** benefits the Arcanum would normally grant you when summoned (damage Affinities, immunity to status effects, increased Attribute sizes, etc.). If a **merge** benefit would cause the Arcanum to be dismissed, this will cause the summoned creature to vanish unless you spend 20 Mind Points.
- A **melee basic attack** whose Accuracy Check relies on **two different Attributes** of your choice and deals **【HR + 8】 physical damage**. Choose **two different options** : the attack is a **ranged** attack; **or** it deals 4 extra damage;** or **it deals damage of a type other than **physical** ; **or** the Accuracy Check relies on a **single Attribute**.
- The creature may perform the **Skill** action to produce one of the **dismiss** effects normally granted by that Arcanum, but doing so will cause the summoned creature to vanish unless you spend 20 Mind Points.
The following rules apply when you **Grand Summon** an Arcanum:
- The creature is always summoned at full Hit Points, with no status effects.
- The creature vanishes if it reaches 0 Hit Points, if you die, lose consciousness or leave the scene, or **if you summon or Grand Summon** an Arcanum again. The creature also vanishes when a scene ends, or if you simply command them to do so (this will **not** trigger the corresponding Arcanum's dismiss effect).
- Take note of all choices made for **Attributes** and **basic attack** during the first time **Summon** a given Arcanum: these choices will remain unchanged whenever you **Grand Summon** that same Arcanum again in the future.

When you summon an Arcanum, you may decide to spend 1 Fabula Point and spend half of your current Hit Points (rounded down) to shape your lifeforce into a full manifestation of their power. If you do, the Arcanum manifests as a **soldier**-rank creature of the **demon** Species under your control (they count as an ally and have their own independent turn during conflicts – if you use this Skill during a conflict scene, the Arcanum joins the scene **at the end** of the current round). You also do not gain any of the **merge** benefits you would normally enjoy when summoning that Arcanum. The summoned creature has the following profile:
- **Level** is equal to your level (thus gaining the bonuses to Checks and damage listed under **steps 8** on page **303** of the **Core Rulebook** ).
- A **d10** in one Attribute of your choice, and a **d8** in all other Attributes.
- **Maximum Hit Points** equal to **【twice the creature's base Might die size, plus half of your maximum Hit Points】** . The creature has **no Mind Points** .
- Resistance to **two** damage types of your choice.
- The creature receives all the **merge** benefits the Arcanum would normally grant you when summoned (damage Affinities, immunity to status effects, increased Attribute sizes, etc.). If a **merge** benefit would cause the Arcanum to be dismissed, this will cause the summoned creature to vanish unless you spend 20 Mind Points.
- A **melee basic attack** whose Accuracy Check relies on **two different Attributes** of your choice and deals **【HR + 8】 physical damage**. Choose **two different options** : the attack is a **ranged** attack; **or** it deals 4 extra damage;** or **it deals damage of a type other than **physical** ; **or** the Accuracy Check relies on a **single Attribute**.
- The creature may perform the **Skill** action to produce one of the **dismiss** effects normally granted by that Arcanum, but doing so will cause the summoned creature to vanish unless you spend 20 Mind Points.
The following rules apply when you **Grand Summon** an Arcanum:
- The creature is always summoned at full Hit Points, with no status effects.
- The creature vanishes if it reaches 0 Hit Points, if you die, lose consciousness or leave the scene, or **if you summon or Grand Summon** an Arcanum again. The creature also vanishes when a scene ends, or if you simply command them to do so (this will **not** trigger the corresponding Arcanum's dismiss effect).
- Take note of all choices made for **Attributes** and **basic attack** during the first time **Summon** a given Arcanum: these choices will remain unchanged whenever you **Grand Summon** that same Arcanum again in the future.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**奥灵使**职业，且你的**等级**必须**大于等于30级**。你在**召唤**奥灵时，可以选择消耗1点物语点以及当前生命值的一半（向下取整），从而将你的生命力塑造成该奥灵完整力量的化身。如果你这样做，那么该奥灵便会显化为一个受你控制的**小兵**级生物，其物种为**恶魔**。该生物视为一个盟友，在冲突中拥有独立的回合。如果你在冲突场景中使用此**技能**，那么该奥灵将会在当前轮次**结束时**加入本场景。你**不**会像正常**召唤**奥灵时那样获得**融合**增益。以此法**召唤**出的生物具有以下规则：•它的**等级**和你相同（会因此依照**核心规则书**第**303**页中的**第8步**获得检定修正值和额外伤害加成）。•它的一项**属性**为**d10**，其他三项为**d8**，由你自行分配。•它的**最大生命值**等于**【其基础力量骰等级×2+你最大生命值的一半】**。该生物**没有精神值**。•它对**两种**伤害类型具有抵抗相性，由你自行选择。•该生物会获得奥灵通常会赋予你的所有**融合**增益（伤害相性、异常状态免疫、**属性**骰**等级**提升等）。如果某项**融合**增益将会**遣散**奥灵，那么除非此时你消耗20点精神值，否则该增益也会使得该**召唤**物消失。•其**基础攻击为近战**，命中检定基于由你选择的**两项不同属性**的组合，并能造成**【高值+8】**的**物理**伤害。你还需要为**基础攻击**再选择**两项不同的效果**：该攻击变为**远程**攻击；**或**造成4点额外伤害；**或**造成一种非**物理**类型的伤害；**或**命中检定可以基于**相同属性**的组合。•该生物可通过**技能**行动触发一项原本由该奥灵赋予**召唤**者的**遣散**效果，除非此时你消耗20点精神值，否则这样做会使该生物消失。当你用**大召唤术召唤**奥灵时，以下规则将会生效：•你**召唤**出的生物总是拥有全部生命值，并且**不**带有任何异常状态。•该生物会在下列情况下消失：它的生命值降为0；你死亡、失去意识**或**离开场景；**或**你**再次用常规方式或大召唤术召唤了奥灵**。在当前场景**结束时**，该生物同样会消失。此外你还可以直接命令该生物主动消失（这**不**会触发相应奥灵的**遣散**效果）。•你需要记录所有有关**属性**和**基础攻击**的选择。当一个奥灵首次被**召唤**时，这些选项便会保持固定**不**变，即使你未来再次用**大召唤术召唤**此奥灵也**不**会发生变化。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Commander** and **Weaponmaster**.\nAfter you hit one or more creatures with a **melee** attack using a weapon that belongs to the **spear** Category, if you have **no other weapon equipped**, you may spend 20 Mind Points and choose one of those creatures. If you do so, the attack deals **half** the normal amount of damage to each of its targets, and you choose one type of action among the following: **Attack**, **Guard**, **Objective**, **Skill**, or **Spell**. From now on, the chosen creature must spend 10 Mind points whenever they wish to perform that type of action. If they can't, they must perform a different type of action. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, or until you use this Skill again.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**指挥官**和**武器大师**中的至少一个职业。当你使用**长柄类**武器进行**近战攻击**命中一个或多个生物后，若你**未装备其他武器**，可以消耗20点精神值并选择其中一个生物。如果你这样做，此次**攻击**对所有目标仅造成原本伤害的**一半**，然后你从下列行动类型中选择一项：**攻击**、**防御**、**推进目标**、**施法**或**技能**。从现在起，每当该生物执行所选类型的行动时，必须消耗10点精神值。若其无法消耗精神值，则必须选择其他行动类型。此效果持续至你的下回合开始，或直至你再次使用本**技能**时。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Chimerist**, **Elementalist**, **Entropist**, and **Spiritist**.\nWhen you perform the **Guard** action, if you choose not to provide cover to another creature, you gain the following benefit until the start of your next turn:When a creature you can see casts a spell, after that creature pays for the spell's MP cost, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to **【10 + the spell's total MP cost】** in order to completely stop the casting of the spell and negate its effects (the spell isn't cast, but the creature is still considered to have spent their action).

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Chanter** Class.\nWhen you sing a **verse** with **medium** or **high** volume, you may may double the **verse**'s cost in Mind Points, **or** spend 1 Fabula Point. If you do, you and every ally that is able to hear you gain the following benefit until the start of your next turn: your Accuracy Checks trigger a **critical success** when both dice show the same number (as long as the Check is not a **fumble**).

en: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
it: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
de: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
fr: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
es: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
pt-BR: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
ru: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
pl: Gain benefits for consecutive attacks with brawling weapons.
zh-CN: 用格斗类武器连续攻击时获得增益。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Fury** and **Weaponmaster**.
When you perform a **melee** attack using a weapon that belongs to the **brawling **Category,** if you have no martial armor and no shields equipped**, you gain **1 Bravery Point**.
As long as you have no **martial armor** and no **shields** equipped, your **melee** attacks with **brawling** weapons deal extra damage equal to **【2 + your current Bravery Points】**.
At the end of each scene, **or** if you have **5 or more Bravery Points** at the end of your turn, you lose all accumulated Bravery Points. Then, if you lost at least 1 point this way, you recover 10 Hit Points **and** 10 Mind Points.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**狂怒斗士和武器大师**中的至少一个职业。当你在**未装备盾牌和职业限定防具**时使用**格斗类**武器进行**近战**攻击，可获得**1点勇气点**。只要你**未装备盾牌和职业限定防具**，你使用**格斗类**武器进行的**近战**攻击可造成等同于**【2+你的当前勇气点数量】**的额外伤害。在当前场景结束时，**或**当你在回合结束时拥有**至少5点勇气点**时，你失去所有积累的勇气点。然后，如果你以此方式失去了至少**1点勇气点**，你恢复10点生命值**和**10点精神值。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Symbolist** Class.\nWhen you perform a Ritual outside a conflict scene, if that Ritual has a **total cost equal to or lower than 60 Mind Points**, you may stop the process immediately before the Magic Check and store the Ritual's effect inside a **Ritual seal** placed on a surface you can touch. If you do, name a **condition** — this can be anything from "when I enter **Crisis**" to "as soon as I snap my fingers". When that condition is met, the **seal** vanishes and the Ritual is unleashed at the **seal**'s location: you perform the Magic Check and resolve the effects as normal (even if you are unconscious or not present on the scene).\nYou may only have **one Ritual seal** active at the same time — if you die or create a new **Ritual seal**, the one you previously created will vanish.

When that condition is met, the **seal** vanishes and the Ritual is unleashed at the **seal**'s location: you perform the Magic Check and resolve the effects as normal (even if you are unconscious or not present on the scene).\nYou may only have **one Ritual seal** active at the same time — if you die or create a new **Ritual seal**, the one you previously created will vanish.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**符印使**职业。当你在冲突场景外启动仪式时，若该仪式的**精神值总消耗不超过60点**，你可以在施法检定前中止进程，并将仪式效果储存在你能够触碰其表面的**仪式印记**中。如果你这样做，则需要指定一个**触发条件**，这可以是“当我进入**危机状态**时”或“当我打响指时”等任意内容。当条件满足时，**印记**将消失，并在**印记**所在位置施放仪式效果，你将正常进行施法检定并结算效果（即使你失去意识或不在场景中）。你在同一时间只能拥有**一个仪式印记**。如果你死亡或者创造了新的**仪式印记**，那么原先的**印记**就会消失。

使用链枷类武器攻击两次。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more classes among **Fury** and **Weaponmaster**.\nWhen you perform the **Attack** action with a **melee** weapon that belongs to the **flail** Category, if you have **no other weapon equipped**, you may perform two separate attacks instead of one (against the same target or against different targets). If you do, both attacks follow the rules for **two-weapon fighting**: each attack loses the **multi** property and cannot gain it, and you treat the High Roll of each Accuracy Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage.\nNote that this Heroic Skill **does not stack** with a custom weapon's **quick** customization (using **Spider's Web** with a **quick** flail doesn't allow more than two attacks, in short).

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**狂怒斗士**和**武器大师**中的至少一个职业。当你使用**链枷类近战**武器执行**攻击**行动时，若你**未装备其他武器**，你可以进行两次独立**攻击**代替原本的单次**攻击**（可针对同一目标或不同目标）。如果你这样做，这两次**攻击**均遵循**双持战斗**规则：这两次**攻击**失去**多重攻击**特性且无法获得该特性，在计算伤害时将命中检定的高值视为0。请注意，此英雄技能**不会和**自定义武器的**迅捷**选项叠加（简而言之，使用**锁链蛛网**搭配**迅捷链枷类**武器单次行动无法进行多于两次**攻击**）。

zh-CN: 用投掷类武器连续攻击时获得增益。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Dancer**, **Fury**, and **Sharpshooter**.
When you perform a **ranged** attack using a weapon that belongs to the **thrown** Category, **if you have no martial armor and no shields equipped**, you gain **1 Momentum Point**.
You may never have more than **5 Momentum Points**.
Your **ranged** attacks using weapons that belong to the **thrown** Category deal extra damage equal to your current **Momentum Points**.
When a creature hits you with an attack targeting your **Defense**, you **must** spend all your accumulated **Momentum Points** and increase your Defense score by an equal amount against that attack (this may turn the hit into a miss).
You also lose all **Momentum Points** at the end of each scene, or if you equip a **shield** or **martial armor**.

zh-CN: **前提：**你**必须**精通**舞者**、**狂怒斗士**和**神射手**中的至少一个职业。当你在**未装备职业限定防具和盾牌**时使用**投掷类**武器进行**远程**攻击，可获得**1点冲量点**。你至多只能积累**5点冲量点**。你使用**投掷类**武器进行的**远程**攻击可造成等同于【你的当前**冲量点**数量】的额外伤害。当一个生物进行攻击命中了你，且本次攻击针对你的**物防**时，你**必须**消耗所有积累的**冲量点**，使自身的**物防**值在本次命中检定中临时提升等同于所消耗**冲量点**的数值（这可能会使得原本的命中改为未命中）。在当前场景结束时，或当你装备**职业限定防具**或**盾牌**时，你失去所有积累的**冲量点**。
你的技能使敌人失去生命值。

en: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
it: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
de: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
fr: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
es: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
pt-BR: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
ru: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
pl: Gain a theme song with a variety of benefits.
zh-CN: 获得一首能提供多种增益的主题曲。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Chanter** Class.
When you acquire this Skill, you obtain a **theme song** – give it a name and assign it a **key** from the ones you have learned (you can also choose a real-world song for this).
Once per conflict scene after you sing a **verse** in your theme song's key, you may start your **theme song** — if it's a real song, it's a great idea to play it in the background!
While singing your theme song, you gain the following benefits:
- You gain Resistance to **【theme song's key type】** damage.
- When you deal **【theme song's key type】** damage, you deal 5 extra damage and the type of that damage cannot be changed.
- The MP cost for singing **verses** in the same key as your **theme song** is halved. This benefit applies to you and to **any** of your allies who are able to sing **verses**. 

The **theme song** lasts until the end of the scene or until you leave the scene, die, or fall unconscious. The **theme song** also ends as soon as you sing a **verse** in a **key** other than the **theme song**'s, if your turn ends and you have not sung any **verse**, or if another character starts their **theme song**.

**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Chanter** Class.
When you acquire this Skill, you obtain a **theme song** – give it a name and assign it a **key** from the ones you have learned (you can also choose a real-world song for this).
Once per conflict scene after you sing a **verse** in your theme song's key, you may start your **theme song** — if it's a real song, it's a great idea to play it in the background!
While singing your theme song, you gain the following benefits:
- You gain Resistance to **【theme song's key type】** damage.
- When you deal **【theme song's key type】** damage, you deal 5 extra damage and the type of that damage cannot be changed.
- The MP cost for singing **verses** in the same key as your **theme song** is halved. This benefit applies to you and to **any** of your allies who are able to sing **verses**. 

The **theme song** lasts until the end of the scene or until you leave the scene, die, or fall unconscious. The **theme song** also ends as soon as you sing a **verse** in a **key** other than the **theme song**'s, if your turn ends and you have not sung any **verse**, or if another character starts their **theme song**.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**咏唱师**职业。你在习得此技能时会获得一首**主题曲**。你需要为它起名，并为它分配一种你已掌握的**调式**（可以选择真实世界中的歌曲）。每个冲突场景中限一次，当你演唱一首**乐章**之后，如果该**乐章**采用和你的**主题曲**相同的**调式**，你便可以开始演唱自己的**主题曲**。（如果这是首真实存在的歌曲，那么此时把它作为BGM会是个很棒的主意！）在演唱这首**主题曲**时，你会获得以下增益：•你获得针对**【主题曲调式对应的伤害类型】**的抵抗相性。•如果你造成的伤害属于**【主题曲调式对应的伤害类型】**，那么你还将造成5点额外伤害，此伤害的类型无法改变。•咏唱与**主题曲调式**相同的**乐章**时，精神值消耗减半。该效果对你及**任何**能咏唱**乐章**的盟友均生效。**主题曲**的效果持续至当前场景结束，或持续至你离开场景、死亡或失去意识为止。若你咏唱与**主题曲调式**不同的**乐章**、在一回合中未咏唱**任何乐章**且回合结束，或其他角色开始他的**主题曲**时，你的**主题曲**也将立即终止。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Dancer** and **Weaponmaster**.\nAs long as you have a one-handed **melee** weapon that belongs to the **dagger** or **sword**Categories equipped in each of your normal hand slots, you may treat your **armor**slot as if it were a second **off-hand** slot. You may only use this special slot to equip a one-handed **melee** weapon that belongs to the **dagger** or **sword** Categories — note that the **Monkey Grip** Skill does not turn two-handed weapons into one-handed weapons, and thus cannot be used in combination with **Triple Slash**.\nWhen you perform the **Attack** action while you have three **daggers** and/or **swords** equipped, you may attack once with each weapon. This follows the normal rules for **two-weapon fighting**: each of the three attacks loses the multi property and cannot gain it, and you treat the **High Roll (HR)** of each Accuracy Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**舞者**和**武器大师**中的至少一个职业。只要你的常规手部栏位各装备了一把**匕首类**或**剑类**的**近战**单手武器，就可以将**防具**栏位视为第二个**副手**栏位。该特殊栏位仅能装备**匕首类**或**剑类**的**近战**单手武器。请注意，**灵猴握**技能无法将双手武器转为单手武器，因此不能与**三连斩**组合使用。当你在装备三把**匕首类**和/或**剑类**武器的情况下执行**攻击**行动时，可以用每把武器各**攻击**一次。这些**攻击**都将如常遵循**双持战斗**规则：这些**攻击**都会失去多重**攻击**特性且无法获得该特性，其命中检定**高值**在计算伤害时均被视为0。

zh-CN: 攻击后施放一个攻击性法术。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes out of **Elementalist**, **Sharpshooter**, and **Weaponmaster**, and must know at least two offensive spells (⚡).\nYou may use an action to perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped. This attack must target **a single enemy**. If the attack is successful, treat your **High Roll** as 0 when determining damage dealt by it. After the attack has been resolved, if it was successful, you may immediately perform the **Spell** action for free: the spell you cast this way **must** be an offensive (⚡) spell with a total MP cost **equal to or lower than 20,** and it may **only** target the enemy you attacked (you must still spend the appropriate Mind Points and perform the Magic Check). Treat your Magic Check's **High Roll** as 0 when determining damage or other effects caused by this spell.

zh-CN: **前提：**你**必须**精通**元素使**、**神射手**和**武器大师**中的至少一个职业，且**必须**习得至少两个攻击性法术（OO）。作为一次行动，你可以使用你正装备的一件武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。这次攻击的目标**必须**是**单个敌人**。若攻击成功，在计算伤害时将**高值**视为0。在攻击结算之后，若攻击成功，你可以立刻执行一次类型为**施法**的顺势行动。以此方式施放的法术**必须**是攻击性法术（OO），其精神值总消耗**不得高于20点**，且目标**只能**是你之前攻击的那个敌人（你依然需要消耗相应的精神值并进行**施法**检定）。在计算此法术造成的伤害或其他效果时，将**施法**检定的**高值**视为0。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Esper** Class.
While your **Brainwave Clock** is **full**, you may use an action to erase all of its sections. If you do, you may choose one option:
- You deal 20 **physical** damage to every enemy that is present on the scene.
- You deal 30 **physical** damage to a single enemy you can see.This amount increases by 10 if you are **level 20 or higher**, or by 20 if you are **level 40 or higher**.

pl: Hawkeye creates a decoy and grants a punishing attack.
zh-CN: 鹰眼创造诱饵，并使你能发动强力攻击。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Sharpshooter** Class, and must have acquired the **Hawkeye** Skill.
When you use your **Hawkeye** Skill and choose the **first option**, if no **decoy bait** is present on the scene, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, you create a **decoy bait** with Hit Points equal to **【half your level + (your SL in Hawkeye, multiplied by 5)】**.
When an enemy who can see your **decoy bait** deals damage to one or more creatures, your **decoy bait** automatically suffers damage **in place of one of those creatures**, chosen **randomly** (your **decoy bait** is always treated as having neutral Affinity towards all damage types, and cannot gain any other Affinity).
When an enemy reduces your **decoy bait** to 0 Hit Points, your **decoy bait** is automatically destroyed and you roll [[/r 1d10]]. If the number rolled is equal to or lower than **【3 + your SL in Hawkeye】**, you may immediately perform a **free attack** with a **bow** or **firearm** weapon you have equipped. This attack may **only** target that enemy, gains a bonus equal to **【your SL in Hawkeye】** to its Accuracy Check, and its damage ignores Immunities and Resistances.
Your **decoy bait** cannot recover Hit Points and is automatically destroyed at the end of the scene. Make sure to describe what it looks like!

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**神射手**职业，且必须习得**鹰眼**技能。当你使用**鹰眼**技能并选择**第一个选项**时，如果当前场景中没有**伪装诱饵**，你可以消耗10点精神值，生成一个**伪装诱饵**，其生命值等同于**【你的等级÷2+（你的鹰眼技能等级×5）】**。当一个能够看见你的**伪装诱饵**的敌人对一个或多个生物造成伤害时，你的**伪装诱饵**会自动**代替那些生物其中之一**（**随机**选择代替目标）承受伤害。你的**伪装诱饵**对所有类型伤害均没有相性，也无法获得任何相性。当敌人使你的**伪装诱饵**的生命值降为0时，**伪装诱饵**会自动被摧毁，然后你需要掷1d10。若掷出的点数小于等于**【3+你的鹰眼技能等级】**，你可以使用你装备的**弓类**或**枪械类**武器进行一次**顺势攻击**。此次攻击的目标**只能**是该敌人，且命中检定获得等同于**【你的鹰眼技能等级】**的修正值，造成的伤害无视免疫和抵抗。你的**伪装诱饵**无法恢复生命值，并会在场景结束时自动摧毁。请记得描述它的外观如何！

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Darkblade** and **Esper**.\nWhen you hit one or more creatures with an attack from your **Shadow Strike** Skill using a weapon that belongs to the **sword** Category, each of those creatures loses an amount of Mind Points equal to **【the number you rolled on your Might die for Shadow Strike】**.\nThen, if **【the number you rolled on your Might die for Shadow Strike】 was 8 or higher**, you may choose one creature hit by the attack: if that creature is your **focus** or you have a **Bond** towards them, that creature will perform one fewer action during their next turn (to a minimum of zero actions).

en: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
it: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
de: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
fr: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
es: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
pt-BR: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
ru: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
pl: Synchronize with another pilot or passenger to join forces.
zh-CN: 与另一名机师或乘客同步并协力作战。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Pilot** Class.
At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose one option: you **synchronize** with another Player Character who is present on the scene and driving their own **personal vehicle**; **or** you **synchronize** with another Player Character who is a passenger on your **personal vehicle**. Describe how you join forces! You and the chosen character **both** receive the following benefits as long as the **synchronization** remains active:
- When you perform a Check, you may use the current Attribute die sizes of the other Player Character in place of yours (for one or both dice).
- When you deal damage, deal extra damage equal to **【the strength of your Bond towards the other PC, plus the strength of their Bond towards you】**.
- You may use an action to perform a **free attack** with one **enabled or disabled weapon module** present on the **personal vehicle** the other PC is currently on.
- When your turn ends, if the other PC has yet to take their turn during this round, they may take their turn **immediately** after yours.This **synchronization** lasts until the end of the scene, or until you or the other Player Character die, fall unconscious, leave the scene, **synchronize** again or are no longer aboard a **personal vehicle**.

- When you perform a Check, you may use the current Attribute die sizes of the other Player Character in place of yours (for one or both dice).
- When you deal damage, deal extra damage equal to **【the strength of your Bond towards the other PC, plus the strength of their Bond towards you】**.
- You may use an action to perform a **free attack** with one **enabled or disabled weapon module** present on the **personal vehicle** the other PC is currently on.
- When your turn ends, if the other PC has yet to take their turn during this round, they may take their turn **immediately** after yours.This **synchronization** lasts until the end of the scene, or until you or the other Player Character die, fall unconscious, leave the scene, **synchronize** again or are no longer aboard a **personal vehicle**.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**机师**职业。在冲突中你的回合开始时，如果你正在驾驶你的**个人载具**，你可以从以下选项中选择一项：你与另一名位于场景中，且也在驾驶自己的**个人载具**的玩家角色**同步**；**或**你与搭乘你的**个人载具**的另一名玩家角色**同步**。请描述你们二人是如何实现协同的！只要保持**同步**状态，你和选中的角色都会获得以下效果：•当你进行检定时，你可以用**同步**中的角色的当前属性骰等级来代替你自己的（一个**或**全部**两个**骰子）。•当你造成伤害时，造成等同于**【你对该玩家角色的羁绊强度+该玩家角色对你的羁绊强度】**的额外伤害。•作为一次行动，你可以用**同步**中的角色当前搭乘的**个人载具**上安装的一个**已启用或已停用武器模块**进行一次**顺势攻击**。•当你的回合结束时，如果**同步**中的角色在当前轮中尚未执行自己的回合，那么其可以在你的回合之后**立刻**执行自己的回合。此**同步**状态持续到当前场景结束时，**或**直到你**或同步**中的角色死亡、失去意识、离开场景、与其他角色**同步或**不再搭乘**个人载具**时。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Mutant** Class, and must have acquired the **Akromorphosis** Skill.
You gain the following benefits based on the current Category of your **unarmed strikes**.
- **Arcane, brawling, dagger, thrown**: your attacks with unarmed strikes treat the Defense of each target as being equal to their current Insight die size.
- **Bow, sword**: your attacks with **unarmed strikes** that target **two or more creatures** deal 5 extra damage.
- **Firearm, heavy**: your **unarmed strikes** deal 5 extra damage to **constructs**, and deal 5 extra damage to non-**construct** creatures who have at least one **shield** and/or **martial armor** equipped.
- **Flail, spear**: you gain a +2 bonus to Defense, and your attacks with **unarmed strikes** may target **flying** creatures.If your **unarmed strikes** are treated as belonging to **more than one Category** (for instance due to the **Blade Adept** Heroic Skill), you gain all the benefits of the corresponding Categories.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**变种人**职业，且必须习得**肢端变异**技能。你会根据你的**徒手攻击**的当前类型获得以下效果：•**魔法类**、**格斗类**、**匕首类**、**投掷类**：你的**徒手攻击**会将每个目标的物防视作其当前的洞察骰等级。•**弓类**、**剑类**：若你进行的**徒手攻击**目标为**两个或更多生物**，则造成5点额外伤害。•**枪械类**、**重型**：你的**徒手攻击**对**构装体**造成5点额外伤害，且对装备了至少一个**盾牌**或**职业限定防具**的非**构装体**生物造成5点额外伤害。•**链枷类**、**长柄类**：你的物防获得+2修正值，且你的**徒手攻击**可以选择**飞行**生物作为目标。如果你的**徒手攻击**被视为属于**多于一个类型**（例如因**刃器能手**英雄技能所致；参见《史诗奇幻设定集》第154页），你将获得这些对应类型提供的所有效果。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Darkblade** and **Fury**.
Before you perform an Accuracy Check, you may declare **"make it or break it!"**. If you do, the Check's **High Roll** is **doubled** when determining damage, but if the Result is an **even** number, you apply the following penalties after the attack is resolved:
- If the weapon you used is **transforming**, it **immediately changes form** and **it cannot change form again** until the end of the scene.
- If the weapon you used **is not transforming,** or if it is a **transforming** weapon that **cannot change form** (see above), it is **placed inside your backpack** and **cannot be equipped** until the end of the scene; however, you may **immediately** perform the **Equipment** action **for free**.This Heroic Skill does not apply to attacks with **unarmed strikes**, **improvised weapons**, **weapon modules**, or **Twin Shields**.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**暗刃骑士**和**狂怒斗士**中的至少一个职业。当你使用武器攻击时，你可以在进行命中检定之前宣布“**舍身成仁**”。如果你这样做，在计算伤害时，这次检定的**高值翻倍**，但如果结算值是**偶数**时，应用以下惩罚：•如果你使用的武器是**变形**武器（见第113页），它会**立刻改变形态**，并且在当前场景结束之前**无法再次改变形态**。•如果你使用的武器**不是变形武器**，或者是一件**无法改变形态**的**变形**武器（见上一条），那么它会被**放入你的背包**，且直到场景结束前**无法再次装备**。不过此时你可以执行一次类型为**装备**的**顺势行动**。此英雄技能无法用于**徒手攻击**、**临时武器**、**武器模块**（见第161页）或**双盾**（见核心规则书第197页）。

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**拟兽使**或**变种人**中的至少一个职业，且必须习得**基因融合**和**形意咒法**这两个技能。当你对一个NPC使用**基因融合**技能时，如果该NPC的物种是你能够使用**形意咒法**学习**法术**的物种之一，游戏主持人必须披露该NPC所知晓的全部**法术**。然后，如果该NPC知晓一个或多个**法术**，你可以学习**其中一个法术**作为你的**拟兽使法术**。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Tinkerer** Class, and must have acquired the **advanced Alchemy** benefit from the **Gadget** Skill.
When you create a **potion**, you gain **1 Nebulization Point**, or **2 Nebulization Points** if that potion was created via the **Alchemy** benefit of the **Gadget** Skill.Potions and elemental shards you create deal extra damage equal to **twice** your current Nebulization Points.
Potions you create that restore Hit Points and/or Mind Points restore additional HP and/or MP equal to **【your current Nebulization Points, multiplied by 5】**.
You may never have more than **5 Nebulization Points**, and you lose all of them at the end of each scene.

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Pilot** Class, and must have acquired the **Compression Tech** Skill.\nChoose a damage type among **bolt**, **dark**, **fire**, **ice**, and **light**.\nWhen you are reduced to 0 Hit Points for the first time during a scene, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose to be reduced to exactly 1 Hit Point instead. If you do, you and any passengers **leave** your **personal vehicle**, which **disappears** from the game world. Then, you may deal an amount of damage equal to your **Crisis** score to a single creature you can see. This damage is of the type you have chosen from the list above. If your **personal vehicle** disappears from the game world this way, the next use of your **Compression Tech** Skill will have an additional cost of 1 Fabula Point. *Alter this Skill's damage type to match the one chosen.

zh-CN: 强化魔法加农炮，并用它发动爆发攻击。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Tinkerer** Class, and must have acquired the **advanced Magitech** benefit from the **Gadget** Skill.
Your attacks with the **Magicannon** deal 5 extra damage.
When you perform the **Attack** action with your **magicannon**, , if you have no other weapon equipped, you may choose one option:
- Destroy the **magicannon**, then create and equip a new one **for free** (ignore the IP cost), using this newly equipped **magicannon** for your attack.
- The attack gains **multi (3)**.
- You perform two separate attacks instead of one, following the rules for **two-weapon fighting** (**Core Rulebook**, page **69**).

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Pilot** Class.
After you cast the **first** spell of your turn during a conflict, if you are driving your **personal vehicle**, you may choose one option (after the spell has been resolved):
- Choose one enabled module and **disable** it, then choose one disabled module and **enable** it.
- The next spell you cast before the end of this scene that deals damage deals 5 extra damage.
- The next spell you cast before the end of this scene that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures restores 10 additional Hit Points to each of those creatures.

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Arcanist** and **Spiritist**, and must have learned the **Aura** spell and/or the **Barrier** spell.\nChoose a damage type among **air, bolt, earth, fire, ice,** and **light**.\nWhen an enemy you can see deals damage to one or more creatures who are affected by an **Aura** and/or **Barrier** spell you cast, the damage suffered by each of those creatures is reduced by an amount equal to **【half your level in the Spiritist Class】** **or** to **【your level, divided by 10】** (use whichever value is **higher**; this reduction is applied **before** damage Affinities). Then, you may deal an amount of damage of the chosen type equal to **【half your level】** to that enemy. If you do, you cannot deal damage this way until the start of your next turn. *Replace below damage type with type chosen.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**奥灵使**和**御魂使**中的至少一个职业，且必须习得**护卫灵气或屏障**法术。选择一种伤害类型：**风系**、**雷系**、**土系**、**火系**、**冰系或光系**。当一个你能看见的敌人对受到你施放的**护卫灵气或屏障**法术影响的一个**或**多个生物造成伤害时，这些生物所受的伤害量减少等同于**【你的御魂使职业等级的一半】或【你的等级÷10】**（取其中**较高**的值；此次伤害减少在相性**之前**计算）。然后，你可以对该敌人造成等同于**【你的等级的一半】**的所选类型伤害。如果你这样做，直到你下个回合开始前，你不能再以这种方式造成伤害。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Elementalist**, **Entropist**, **Invoker**, and **Symbolist**, and must have acquired the **Invocation** Skill.\nAfter an enemy you can see hits or misses you with an offensive spell (⚡), if the Result of their Magic Check was an **even number**, you may immediately use the **Invocation** Skill for free (after the spell has been fully resolved) to perform an **invocation** you have access to against that enemy, without spending Mind Points. This invocation must not be a "**hex**", and it may target **only** that enemy (you cannot use the **Linked Invocation** Skill with it).

If you do, your **Shadow Strike** deals extra damage equal to **【twice the number of filled sections in your Growth Clock】**.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**暗刃骑士**和**园艺师**中的至少一个职业，且必须习得**植生术**技能。你对**光系**和**毒系**伤害具有抵抗相性。当你失去生命值时，如果你处于**危机状态**并且你的**花园**中存在**魔种**，你可以填充你的**生长命刻**的**1格**。此外，当你使用**暗影击**技能时，你可以让你的攻击造成**毒系**伤害而非**暗系**伤害（无法再次改变伤害类型）。如果你这样做，你的**暗影击**将造成等同于**【生长命刻已填充格数×2】**的额外伤害。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Commander**, **Guardian**, and **Weaponmaster**.\nWhen you use the **Bone Crusher** Skill, if your attack targets **only one creature** and you have a **shield** equipped, you may **challenge** that creature until the end of your next turn. The **challenge** also ends if that creature is challenged by someone else, or if you **challenge** another creature.\nThe creature you are **challenging** must include you among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (⚡), if able; additionally, once per turn (including other creatures' turns), when you deal damage to the creature you are **challenging** with a **free attack** using a **one-handed melee** weapon or a **custom weapon** belonging to the **dagger** or **sword** Category, you may deal 5 extra damage to that creature.

zh-CN: 施放拟兽使法术时，根据物种获得增益。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Chimerist** and **Mutant**, and must have acquired the **Spell Mimic** Skill.
When you cast one of your Chimerist spells, you gain a benefit based on the **Species** of the creature you originally learned that spell from. Choose one option:
- You gain Resistance to both damage types associated with that Species.
- When you deal damage of a type associated with that Species, you deal 5 extra damage.
The chosen benefit lasts until the end of the scene, or until you cast a Chimerist spell again.
The damage types associated to each Species are **air** and **ice** (**beast**), **earth** and **poison** (**construct**), **fire** and **ice** (**demon**), **air** and **bolt** (**elemental**), **bolt** and **fire** (**monster**), **earth** and **light** (**plant**), **dark** and **poison** (**undead**).

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Dancer**, **Esper**, **Rogue**, **Spiritist**, and **Symbolist**.\nWhen you cast the **Hallucination** or **Torpor** spells, you may apply **both** status effects to each target hit by the spell.\nDuring a conflict, you may use an action and spend up to 20 Mind Points. Then, you recover 20 Mind Points for each of those enemies that entered **Crisis** or was reduced to 0 Hit Points by this effect.

For every 10 Mind Points spent this way, you may choose a different enemy you can see who is suffering from **two or more status effects**. Every enemy chosen this way recovers from all status effects and loses an amount of Hit Points equal to **【half your level + (the number of status effects that enemy recovered from this way, multiplied by 10)】**. Then, you recover 20 Mind Points for each of those enemies that entered **Crisis** or was reduced to 0 Hit Points by this effect.
zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**舞者**（见史诗奇幻设定集第142页）、**念力师**（见科技奇幻设定集第150页）、**浪客**、**御魂使**和**符印使**（见史诗奇幻设定集第146页）中的至少一个职业。当你施放**幻觉**或**怠惰**法术时（见核心规则书第208~209页），你可以对法术命中的每个目标施加法术提及的两种异常状态，而非原本的一种。在冲突场景中，作为一次行动，你可以消耗至多20点精神值。每以此方式消耗10点精神值，你便可以选择一个你能看见且处于**两个或更多异常状态**影响下的不同敌人。以此方式选择的每个敌人都会解除所有异常状态，并失去等同于**【你等级的一半+（该敌人以此方式解除的异常状态数量×10）】**的生命值。然后，每有一个因此效果进入**危机状态**或生命值降至0的敌人，你便恢复20点精神值。

zh-CN: 用贸易点代替物语点，并通过捐赠改善定居点。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Merchant** Class, and must have acquired the **Real Treasure** and **Winds of Trade** Skills.
When you need to spend one or more Fabula Points, if you are **not** spending them to **alter the story**, you may spend that many **Trade Points** instead. Describe which memories of your trades and journeys give you strength!Additionally, when you gain **two or more** Trade Points through the **Real Treasure** or **Winds of Trade** Skills, you may choose to gain **exactly 1 Trade Point** instead. If you do, choose a settlement within **1 travel day** of your position and increase its **prosperity** by an amount equal to **【your Skill Level in Winds of Trade + your Skill Level in Real Treasure】**; a settlement's **prosperity** starts at 0 and has no upper limit.
The chart below indicates the effects of your donations on the settlement and on anything within **1 travel day** of it.
**Prosperity**, **Effects within 1 travel day of the settlement**
**10 or more**, When you or an ally need to pay a cost in zenit, whatever the reason, that cost is **halved**.
**15 or more**, People gladly accommodate you and your allies: while in this area, you can always **rest** freely, without spending zenit. Furthermore, any **travel rolls** made in this area never use a die greater than **d8**.
**20 or more**, When a Villain in this area spends Ultima Points, they must spend **twice** as many Ultima Points.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**商人**职业，且必须习得**真正宝藏**和**贸易之风**技能。当你需要消耗一个或多个物语点时，如果你没有将其用于**改变故事**（见核心规则书第98页），你可以改为消耗等量的**贸易点**。请描述你的贸易和旅程中的哪些记忆给了你力量！此外，当你通过**真正宝藏**或**贸易之风**技能获得**两个或更多贸易点**时，你可以选择改为只获得**1点贸易点**。如果你这样做，选择距离你**1个旅行日**内的一处定居点，为其增加等同于**【你的贸易之风技能等级+你的真正宝藏技能等级】**的**繁荣**度。定居点的**繁荣**度从0开始，没有上限。下表显示了你的捐赠对定居点以及距离其**1个旅行日**内事物的效果。**繁荣**度**位于距离定居点1个旅行日内的地点的效果10及以上**当你或盟友需要支付金币消耗时，无论何种原因，该消耗都**减半**。**15及以上**人们乐意接待你和你的盟友。在该区域内，你总是可以自由**休息**，无需花费金币。此外，在该区域进行的任何**旅行掷骰**都**不**会使用大于**d8**的骰子。**20及以上**位于该区域的反派消耗终结点时，必须消耗**两倍**的终结点。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Floralist** Class.
When **you fill 1 or more sections of your Growth Clock**, you may choose one option:
- You fill **1 additional section** of your Growth Clock.
- You fill **1 fewer section** of your Growth Clock (to a minimum of 0 sections filled).
If you do, you cannot use this effect again until after your **Growth Clock** has become completely empty.
Additionally, damage dealt by your **magiseeds** ignores Resistances.

pt-BR: Carry an elemental wellspring of your choice within yourself.

pl: Carry an elemental wellspring of your choice within yourself.
zh-CN: 将一种自选元素源泉融入自身。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Invoker** Class.
When you acquire this Heroic Skill and whenever you **rest**, you may choose one **wellspring: air, earth, fire, lightning,** or **water**. If you do, you gain the following benefits until your next **rest**:
- You **always** treat the chosen **wellspring** as being available during each scene, in addition to whatever **wellsprings** are already available.
- You may perform Rituals of the **Elementalism** discipline, but only if those Rituals manipulate the element of the chosen **wellspring**.
- You gain Resistance to the damage type corresponding to the chosen **wellspring**.
- When you deal damage, you may change its type to the one corresponding to the chosen **wellspring**. If you do, that damage ignores Resistances.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**唤灵师**职业。当你习得此英雄技能以及每次**休息**时，你可以选择一个**源泉**：风系、**土系**、**火系**、雷系或**水系**。如果你这样做，直到你下次**休息**前，你获得以下增益：•除去当前场景中任何可用的**源泉**之外，你**总是**将所选**源泉**视为在每个场景中可用。•你可以启动**元素系**仪式，仪式范围限定为操纵所选**源泉**的对应元素。•你获得对所选**源泉**对应伤害类型的抵抗相性。•当你造成伤害时，你可以将其伤害类型更改为所选**源泉**对应的类型。如果你这样做，该伤害无视抵抗相性。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Guardian**, **Merchant**, and **Wayfarer**.\nOn your turn during a conflict, you may use an action to recover an amount of Hit Points and Mind Points equal to **【20 + half your level】** and also recover from all status effects. If you do, your turn ends **immediately**, you lose the ability to **hear and see**, and your **Defense and Magic Defense** scores become **equal to 5** and cannot be modified in any way (but you may still use the **Protect** Skill from the **Guardian** Class, if you have acquired it!).\nThese penalties last until the start of your next turn, until after you **lose Hit Points**, or until after you **are hit by an attack or offensive spell** (⚡).

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**守护者**、**商人**和**旅人**中的至少一个职业。在冲突场景中你的回合内，作为一次行动，你可以恢复等同于**【20+你等级的一半】**的生命值和精神值，并解除所有异常状态。如果你这样做，你的回合**立即**结束，你失去**听觉和视觉**，**物防和魔防**变为**5**且无法以任何方式再次变化（但如果你已获得**守护者**职业的**挺身守护**技能，你仍然可以使用它！）。这些惩罚将会持续直到你下个回合开始，或直到你**失去生命值**，或直到你**被攻击或攻击性法术（OO）命中**后（以其中先触发的情形为准）。

zh-CN: 强化你与忠诚伙伴的协同。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Wayfarer** Class, and must have acquired the **Faithful Companion** Skill.
When your companion deals damage, they deal 5 extra damage.
When your companion performs a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and **invoke** one of your companion's **Traits** in order to let them reroll one or both dice (as per the rules on page **46** of the **Core Rulebook**).
After you use the **Faithful Companion** Skill to have your companion perform an action during your turn, you may choose one option (after the companion's action has been resolved):
- You and your companion each recover 10 Mind Points.
- The first time you or your companion perform a Check before the end of your next turn, that Check gains a bonus equal to **【your Skill Level in Faithful Companion】**.

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Gourmet**, **Loremaster**, **Merchant**, and **Tinkerer**.\nPotions and delicacies you create, as well as **spells** you cast, can now cause creatures to recover Hit Points and Mind Points beyond their **maximum HP and MP** scores, up to 150% of the respective scores. At the end of each scene, if the **current Hit Points and/or Mind Points** of a creature are still above the maximum scores, they become equal to the maximum score.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**美食家**、**博学家**、**商人**和**造物使**中的至少一个职业。你制作的药剂和美食，以及你施放的**法术**，现在可以使生物的**生命值和精神值超出最大值**。这不能导致生物的**当前生命值或精神值**超过各自最大值的150%；在每个场景结束时，若生物的**当前生命值或精神值**仍高于其最大值，则将其调整至最大值。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Gourmet** Class.
When you acquire this Heroic Skill, choose **three different tastes** among **bitter, salty, sour, sweet,** and **umami.** Then, choose **three different effects** among the following:
- You deal 20 **(choose one: **dark**, **light**)** damage to each of this **delicacy**'s targets. This amount increases to 30 damage if you are **level 30 or higher**. Choose the type of this effect when you acquire this Heroic Skill.
- During the next turn of each of this **delicacy**'s targets, all damage they deal becomes **(choose one: **dark, light**)** and its type cannot change. Choose the type of this effect when you acquire this Heroic Skill.
- For each of this **delicacy**'s targets, if they are affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of ""Scene"", instead they are no longer affected by any of those spells.
- Choose yourself or an ally you can see. For each of this **delicacy**'s targets, the next time that target performs an attack or cast an offensive spell ( ⚡ ) before the end of this scene, they must include the chosen creature among the targets of that attack or spell (if able).
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets suffers **enraged**.
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets suffers **poisoned**.
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets recovers 30 Hit Points and 30 Mind Points, or 40 Hit Points and 40 Hit Points if you are **level 30 or higher**.
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets recovers from a single status of their choice.
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets recovers from **dazed**, **enraged**, and **shaken**.
- Each of this **delicacy**'s targets recovers from **poisoned**, **slow**, and **weak**.
When you create a **delicacy** using **exactly 3 ingredients** during a conflict, if each ingredient matches one of the **tastes** you chose when you acquired this Heroic Skill, you may ignore **all** of that **delicacy**'s normal effects. If you do, you may instead apply **one**, **two**, or **all** the effects you chose when you acquired this Heroic Skill.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**美食家**职业。当你习得此英雄技能时，从**苦味、咸味、酸味、甜味**和**鲜味**中选择**三种不同风味**。然后，从以下效果中选择**三种不同效果**：•你对该**美食**的每个目标造成20点特定类型**（选择一个：暗系，光系）**的伤害。如果你**大于等于30级**，此伤害量增加到30点。当你习得此英雄技能时，决定此效果的类型。•在该**美食**的每个目标各自的下个回合中，他们造成的所有伤害变为特定类型**（选择一个：暗系，光系）**，且其类型无法改变。当你习得此英雄技能时，决定此效果的类型。•对于该**美食**的每个目标，如果他们受到**一个**或多个**持续时间**为“场景”的法术影响，则他们不再受到这些法术的影响。•选择你自己或**一个**你能看见的盟友。对于该**美食**的每个目标，在场景结束前，当该目标执行攻击或施放攻击性法术（OO）时，如可能则必须将所选生物包含在该攻击或法术的目标中。•你对该**美食**的每个目标施加**激怒**。•你对该**美食**的每个目标施加**中毒**。•该**美食**的每个目标恢复30点生命值和30点精神值，如果你**大于等于30级**，则改为恢复40点生命值和40点精神值。•该**美食**的每个目标分别使其自身解除由其选择的单个异常状态。•该**美食**的每个目标解除**眩晕**、**激怒**和**动摇**。•该**美食**的每个目标解除**中毒**、**迟缓**和**虚弱**。当你在冲突场景中制作一份**美食**时，如果**正好使用了3份食材**，并且所用食材与你习得此英雄技能时选择的**风味**完全相同，你可以忽略该**美食**的所有常规效果。如果你这样做，你可以改为结算你习得此英雄技能时所选效果中的**一个**、**两个**或**全部**效果。

en: **Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Invoker** Class.\nAfter you perform an **invocation** during a conflict, you **and** up to one ally you can see increase one of your Attributes' die sizes by one (up to a maximum of **d12**). This increase lasts until the end of the scene or until you use this Skill again, and the Attribute is based on the **wellspring** you invoked: **air (Insight)**, **earth (one Attribute of your choice)**, **fire (Dexterity)**, **lightning (Might)**, or **water (Willpower)**.

zh-CN: 你的支援检定为队长提供额外增益。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Commander**, **Loremaster**, and **Orator**.
When you perform a **Support Check**, if the **leader** of the Group Check can hear and understand you, you may use **【INS + INS】**,**【 INS + WLP】**, or **【WLP + WLP】** instead of the normal Attributes required by the **Support Check**.
Describe how you offer your advice!
Additionally, when you use the **teamwork** option (see **Core Rulebook**, page **76**) to support another Player Character's Check during their turn in a conflict scene, you may spend 10 Mind Points you may choose **up to two** of the following benefits:
- That character recovers 20 Mind Points.
- That character recovers from **dazed**, **enraged**, and **shaken**.
- At the end of that character's turn, choose one option: perform a **free attack** with a weapon you have equipped; **or** perform the **Spell** action for free, casting a spell whose total MP cost is **equal to or lower than 20**.
- If that character succeeds on their Check and the Check allows them to fill or erase one or more sections of a Clock, they may fill or erase 1 additional section of it.

zh-CN: **前提：**你必须精通**指挥官**（见史诗奇幻设定集第140页）、**博学家**和**游说家**中的至少一个职业。当你执行一次**支援检定**时，如果团队检定的**队长**能听到并理解你的言语，你可以使用【**洞察+洞察**】、【**洞察+意志**】**或**【**意志+意志**】代替**支援检定**原本所需的属性组合。你需要描述你是如何提供建议的！此外，当你通过**团队合作**规则（见**核心规则书**第**76**页），在冲突场景中其他玩家角色的回合中支援他的检定时，你可以消耗10点精神值。如果你这样做，你可以选择以下增益中的**至多两项**：•该玩家角色恢复20点精神值。•该玩家角色解除**眩晕**、**激怒**和**动摇**。•在该玩家角色的回合结束时，你选择一项：你使用一件你已装备的武器执行一次**顺势攻击**；**或**执行一次类型为**施法**的顺势行动，施放一个精神值总消耗**不高于20**的法术。•如果该玩家角色此次检定成功，并且该检定将使得他填充**或**擦除命刻的1格**或**多格，他可以额外填充**或**擦除1格。

zh-CN: 与特定物种的生物战斗时获得特殊增益。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Fury**, **Loremaster**, **Sharpshooter** and **Weaponmaster**, and have acquired the **Knowledge is Power** Skill.
Whenever you acquire this Heroic Skill, choose **two** Species among **beast**, **construct**, **demon**, **elemental**, **monster**, **plant**, and **undead**.
When you deal damage to a creature belonging to the **humanoid** Species or to a Species you have chosen for this Heroic Skill, you may choose one option:
- You deal 5 extra damage to that creature.
- That creature becomes **reeling** until the end of the scene. When a **reeling** creature recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points, instead that creature recovers **half** the normal amount of HP and/or MP and is no longer **reeling**.
This Heroic Skill can be acquired **up to three times**.

**前提：**你必须精通**狂怒斗士**、**博学家**、**神射手**和**武器大师**中的至少一个职业，且必须习得**知识就是力量**技能。
每当你习得此英雄技能时，从**野兽**、**构装体**、**恶魔**、**元素**、**怪物**、**植物**和**不死族**中选择**两个**物种。
当你对**人形**生物，或你为此英雄技能选定的物种的生物造成伤害时，可以选择一项：
- 对该生物造成5点额外伤害。
- 该生物陷入**踉跄**，持续至场景结束。**踉跄**生物恢复生命值和／或精神值时，改为只恢复正常数量的**一半**，然后解除**踉跄**。
此英雄技能**至多可习得三次**。
