en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Necromancer** Class.
When a non-**Villain** NPC you can see that belongs to the **beast**, **humanoid**, **monster**, or **plant** Species dies, you may spend 2 Grave Points and **reduce your maximum Hit Points and Mind Points** by an amount equal to that NPC's **level**. If you do, their corpse becomes a **minion** who obeys your telepathic commands:
- Its **Species** becomes **undead** and it receives all **undead rules** (see **Core Rulebook**, page **305**). The new Affinities to **dark**, **light**, and **poison** damage overwrite any preexisting Affinity, but the original Species' rules are otherwise **maintained**.
- Its **Rank** becomes **soldier**; if the original creature was an **elite** or **champion**, the GM must reduce the minion's HP and MP accordingly (Skills are **maintained**).
- The newly created minion is a completely new creature and has full HP, full MP, and no status effects. It retains the original creature's **equipment** (if any).
- Your minion takes its own turn during conflicts, and the Game Master must count it as an **additional Player Character** when designing a conflict.
- When you **rest**, your minion also gains the full benefits of resting.
- If your minion is reduced to 0 Hit Points, if you are **more than 1 travel day** away from it, or if you die or fall unconscious, it is immediately destroyed.
- You may also destroy your minion **at any time**; but during a conflict scene you can only do so on your turn, while no other effect is being resolved. If you want to create a new minion, you must first destroy the current one.
- If your minion is destroyed, your maximum HP and MP scores **return to normal**.

zh-CN:
**前提：**你必须精通**死灵法师**职业。
当一个你能看见、并非**反派**，且**物种**为**野兽**、**人形**、**怪物**或**植物**的非玩家角色死亡时，你可以消耗2点墓穴点，并使你的**最大生命值和最大精神值各降低**等同于该角色**等级**的数值。如果你这样做，其尸体变为服从你心灵指令的**仆从**：
- 其**物种**变为**不死族**，并获得所有**不死族规则**（见**核心规则书第305页**）。新获得的**暗系**、**光系**和**毒系**相性覆盖原有相性，但原**物种**的其他规则**保留**。
- 其**阶级**变为**小兵**；若原生物为**精英**或**大将**，游戏主持人必须相应降低其生命值和精神值（**技能保留**）。
- 新**仆从**是全新的生物，拥有全部生命值和精神值，且无异常状态。其**保留**原生物的**装备**（若有）。
- **仆从**在冲突中拥有独立回合。游戏主持人设计冲突时，必须将其视为**额外一名玩家角色**。
- 你**休息**时，**仆从**也获得**休息**的全部收益。
- **仆从**生命值降至0、与你**相距超过1个旅行日**，或你死亡或失去意识时，**仆从**立即被摧毁。
- 你也可以**随时**摧毁**仆从**，但冲突中只能在自己的回合内、没有其他效果正在结算时这样做。创造新**仆从**前，必须先摧毁当前**仆从**。
- **仆从**被摧毁后，你的最大生命值和最大精神值**恢复正常**。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Commander** and **Guardian**.
After an enemy you can see performs an **Accuracy Check** or a **Magic Check** for an offensive spell (⚡) on their turn during a conflict, you may grant them a +3 bonus to the Result of the Check. If you do, choose one option:
- You and every ally who is able to hear you gain Resistance to all damage types until the end of this turn.
- You and every ally who is able to hear you deal 5 extra damage until the end of this turn.
Once you use this Skill, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.

zh-CN:
**前提：**你必须精通**指挥官**和**守护者**中的至少一个职业。
在冲突中，一个你能看见的敌人于其回合内进行**命中检定**或攻击性法术（⚡）的**施法检定**后，你可以使此次检定结算值获得+3修正值。如果你这样做，选择一项：
- 你和所有能听见你的言语的盟友对所有伤害类型获得抵抗相性，持续至当前回合结束。
- 你和所有能听见你的言语的盟友造成5点额外伤害，持续至当前回合结束。
使用后，直到你的下个回合开始前无法再次使用此技能。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered the **Ace of Cards** Class.
When you discard cards due to the **Magic Cards** Skill, you may choose 1 of them and place it face down in front of you as a **vanguard card** instead of putting it into your **discard pile**. You may only do so if you have **two or fewer vanguard cards** in play.
When a source deals damage to you and/or one or more allies you can see, you may reveal one of your **vanguard cards** in play. If you do and that card is a **joker** or its **suit** matches the damage type dealt by that source, you and every ally you can see gain Resistance to that damage type until the end of the current turn; then, put the revealed **vanguard card** on top of your **discard pile**, and it stops being a **vanguard card**.
You may look at your **vanguard cards** at any time. At the end of each conflict, if you have one or more **vanguard cards** in play, shuffle them back into your deck.

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Dancer**, **Elementalist**, **Esper**, and **Invoker**.
When you deal **dark**, **earth**, **ice**, or **physical** damage for the first time during a turn, you gain **1 Yin Point** and, if you have **at least 1 Yang Point**, you deal 5 extra damage.
When you deal **air**, **bolt**, **fire**, or **light** damage for the first time during a turn, you gain **1 Yang Point** and, if you have **at least 1 Yin Point**, you deal 5 extra damage.
At the end of your turn, if you have **3 or more Yin and/or Yang points** and have **at least 1 point of each type**, you lose all **Yin and Yang Points** and perform one of the following effects based on the points you lost (perform **both** in case of a tie):
- **Yin majority**: every enemy present on the scene loses an amount of Mind Points equal to **【half your level】**.
- **Yang majority**: one creature you can see that is present on the scene recovers an amount of Mind Points equal to **【your level】**.
You may gain and use **Yin and Yang Points** only during conflicts, and you lose all your **Yin and Yang Points** at the end of each scene.

zh-CN:
**前提：**你必须精通**舞者**、**元素使**、**念力师**和**唤灵师**中的至少一个职业。
当你在一个回合内首次造成**暗系**、**土系**、**冰系**或**物理**伤害时，获得**1点阴点**；若你拥有**至少1点阳点**，还会造成5点额外伤害。
当你在一个回合内首次造成**风系**、**雷系**、**火系**或**光系**伤害时，获得**1点阳点**；若你拥有**至少1点阴点**，还会造成5点额外伤害。
在你的回合结束时，若**阴点与阳点合计至少3点**，且**每种至少1点**，失去所有**阴点和阳点**，根据失去的点数触发以下效果（相等则**两项均触发**）：
- **阴点较多**：场景中每个敌人失去等同于**【你的等级的一半】**的精神值。
- **阳点较多**：场景中一个你能看见的生物恢复等同于**【你的等级】**的精神值。
**阴点和阳点**只能在冲突中获得和使用；每个场景结束时失去全部**阴点和阳点**。

en:
**Requirements:** you must have mastered one or more Classes among **Chimerist**, **Entropist**, **Gourmet** and **Mutant**.
When you cast the **Dispel** spell, its **MP** cost becomes "10 × T" and its **target** becomes "Up to three creatures".
When you cause one or more enemies to stop being affected by one or more spells with a **duration** of "Scene", choose **one** option:
- You recover 20 Mind Points for each different spell whose effects ended on at least one of those enemies this way.
- For each different spell whose effects ended on at least one of those enemies this way, apply a copy of that spell on yourself (if a spell allowed for choices upon casting it, you must retain the same choices that were made for this casting of the spell). This copying effect does not require actions, Mind Points, or Checks, and is not treated as "casting a spell".

**前提：**你必须精通**拟兽使**、**熵术士**、**美食家**和**变种人**中的至少**一个**职业。

当你使**一个**或多个敌人不再受到**一个**或多个**持续时间**为“**场景**”的法术影响时，选择**一项**：
- 每有**一个**不同法术以此方式结束对至少**一个**敌人的影响，你恢复20点**精神值**。
- 每有**一个**不同法术以此方式结束对至少**一个**敌人的影响，你便将该法术的一份复制效果应用于自身（若施放该法术时需要选择，必须保留此次施放所作的选择）。此复制效果不需要行动、**精神值**或检定，也不视为“施放法术”。
